"""
LM Studio Client for NeonRoute
Communicates with local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1).
Auto-detects active model ID from GET /v1/models, constructs valid JSON payload,
emits streaming and final signals, supports cancellation, Keep-Alive connection pooling,
and Structured Outputs (response_format).
"""

import re
import json
import logging
import threading
import time
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import QObject, pyqtSignal

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.LMStudio")

_LMS_SOCKET_LOCK = threading.RLock()


class ModelNotFoundError(RuntimeError):
    """Выбрасывается, когда запрашиваемая модель отсутствует в локальном хранилище LM Studio."""
    def __init__(self, model_name: str):
        self.model_name = model_name
        super().__init__(f"Модель '{model_name}' не найдена в хранилище LM Studio.")



def _get_vram_telemetry_str() -> str:
    """Возвращает строку с текущим состоянием VRAM через NVML или пустую строку при ошибке."""
    try:
        import pynvml
        pynvml.nvmlInit()
        handle = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(0)
        mem = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo(handle)
        free_mb = int(mem.free / 1024 / 1024)
        used_mb = int(mem.used / 1024 / 1024)
        return f"[VRAM: Free={free_mb}MB, Used={used_mb}MB]"
    except Exception:
        return "[VRAM: N/A]"


def _is_rtx_gpu_available() -> bool:
    """Проверяет наличие видеокарты NVIDIA RTX (Compute Capability >= 7.5)."""
    try:
        import pynvml
        pynvml.nvmlInit()
        h = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(0)
        name = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetName(h)
        if isinstance(name, bytes):
            name = name.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        return "rtx" in str(name).lower()
    except Exception:
        return False


class LMStudioClient(QObject):
    """
    Client for LM Studio local REST API.
    Implemented as a thread-safe Singleton to enforce a Single Source of Truth
    for model lifecycle and VRAM allocation across all threads.
    """
    response_received = pyqtSignal(str)
    token_streamed = pyqtSignal(str)
    error_occurred = pyqtSignal(str)

    _instance = None
    _singleton_lock = threading.Lock()

    def __new__(cls, *args, **kwargs):
        if cls._instance is None:
            with cls._singleton_lock:
                if cls._instance is None:
                    cls._instance = super().__new__(cls)
                    cls._instance._initialized = False
        return cls._instance

    def __init__(self, base_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1", parent=None):
        if getattr(self, "_initialized", False):
            return
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self._init_session()
        self._current_session: Optional[requests.Session] = None
        self._active_response: Optional[requests.Response] = None
        self._is_aborted = False
        self._is_model_unloaded = False
        self._current_ctx: int = 0
        self._current_loaded_ctx: int = 8192
        self._current_loaded_gpu: str = "1.0"
        self._last_loaded_model_id: Optional[str] = None
        self.process_manager: Optional[Any] = None
        self._reload_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._initialized = True

    def set_process_manager(self, pm: Any) -> None:
        """Injects ProcessManager dependency for headless server coordination."""
        self.process_manager = pm

    def _init_session(self):
        self._persistent_session = requests.Session()
        adapter = HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=5, pool_maxsize=10, max_retries=1)
        self._persistent_session.mount("http://", adapter)
        self._persistent_session.mount("https://", adapter)

    def is_model_loaded(self, model_name: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
        """Проверяет готовность целевой модели в VRAM по состоянию жизненного цикла клиента."""
        if getattr(self, "_is_model_unloaded", False):
            return False

        target = model_name or getattr(self, "_last_loaded_model_id", None)
        last_id = getattr(self, "_last_loaded_model_id", None)
        if not target or not last_id:
            return False

        t_clean = str(target).lower().strip()
        l_clean = str(last_id).lower().strip()
        if t_clean == l_clean:
            return True

        # Сравнение по Path(..).stem.lower()
        if Path(t_clean).stem.lower() == Path(l_clean).stem.lower():
            return True

        # Сравнение по нормализованному имени без .gguf / -gguf
        def _clean_stem(s: str) -> str:
            name = s.replace("\\", "/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            if name.endswith(".gguf"):
                name = name[:-5]
            if name.endswith("-gguf"):
                name = name[:-5]
            return name

        if _clean_stem(t_clean) == _clean_stem(l_clean):
            return True

        # Если доступен ServerConfigResolver в связке с ProcessManager, сверяем резолв
        if self.process_manager and hasattr(self.process_manager, "has_headless_server") and self.process_manager.has_headless_server():
            try:
                from services.server_config import ServerConfigResolver
                p1 = ServerConfigResolver.resolve_model_path(t_clean)
                p2 = ServerConfigResolver.resolve_model_path(l_clean)
                if p1 and p2 and p1 == p2:
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass

        return False

    def check_health(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Быстрая неблокирующая проверка доступности сервера (Keep-Alive, таймаут 1.2 сек)."""
        try:
            resp = self._persistent_session.get(f"{self.base_url}/models", timeout=1.2)
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                return True, "LM Studio Online"
            return False, f"HTTP {resp.status_code}"
        except requests.exceptions.ConnectionError:
            return False, "LM Studio Offline (Connection Refused)"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Offline ({str(e)})"

    def get_models(self) -> List[str]:
        """Возвращает список активных моделей через пул соединений."""
        try:
            resp = self._persistent_session.get(f"{self.base_url}/models", timeout=2.0)
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                data = resp.json().get("data", [])
                return [m.get("id") for m in data if m.get("id")]
            return []
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to fetch models from LM Studio: {e}")
            return []

    def get_active_model_id(self, preferred_model: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        """Определяет ID активной модели из GET /v1/models."""
        endpoint = f"{self.base_url}/models"
        try:
            resp = self._persistent_session.get(endpoint, timeout=2.5)
        except requests.exceptions.ConnectionError:
            raise ConnectionError(
                f"Не удалось подключиться к LM Studio на {self.base_url}. Убедитесь, что сервер включен в LM Studio."
            )
        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Ошибка запроса списка моделей к {endpoint}: {e}")

        if resp.status_code != 200:
            raise RuntimeError(f"LM Studio /models вернул HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}")

        data = resp.json().get("data", [])
        if not data:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "В LM Studio не загружена ни одна модель! Загрузите модель в Local Server LM Studio."
            )

        available_ids = [m.get("id") for m in data if m.get("id")]
        if not available_ids:
            raise RuntimeError("LM Studio вернул пустой список идентификаторов моделей.")

        if preferred_model and not preferred_model.startswith("default"):
            return preferred_model

        chosen_id = available_ids[0]
        logger.info(f"Auto-selected active LM Studio model: '{chosen_id}'")
        return chosen_id

    def abort(self):
        """Немедленно прерывает активный HTTP-запрос."""
        self._is_aborted = True
        active_resp = getattr(self, "_active_response", None)
        if active_resp:
            try:
                active_resp.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def unload_models_cli(self) -> bool:
        """Полная выгрузка моделей из VRAM с обновлением флага состояния."""
        logger.info("Unloading LM Studio / LLM models to free VRAM...")

        if self.process_manager and hasattr(self.process_manager, "has_headless_server") and self.process_manager.has_headless_server():
            try:
                self.process_manager.evict_llm_for_forge_sync()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Failed to evict LLM via process_manager: {e}")
        else:
            try:
                clean_root = self.base_url.strip().rstrip("/")
                if clean_root.endswith("/v1"):
                    clean_root = clean_root[:-3].rstrip("/")
                for ep in (f"{clean_root}/api/v0/model/unload", f"{clean_root}/api/v0/models/unload"):
                    try:
                        r = requests.post(ep, json={}, timeout=0.8)
                        if r.status_code in (200, 204):
                            break
                    except Exception:
                        continue
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                import subprocess
                import sys
                startupinfo = None
                creationflags = 0
                if sys.platform == "win32":
                    startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
                    startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
                    startupinfo.wShowWindow = 0
                    creationflags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW

                res_unl = subprocess.run(
                    ["lms", "unload", "--all"],
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    timeout=15.0,
                    startupinfo=startupinfo,
                    creationflags=creationflags
                )
                logger.info(f"CLI unload completed (code {res_unl.returncode}): {res_unl.stdout.strip() or res_unl.stderr.strip()} {_get_vram_telemetry_str()}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Failed to unload LMS models via CLI: {e}")

        self._is_model_unloaded = True
        self._current_ctx = 0
        self._current_loaded_ctx = 0
        self._current_loaded_gpu = ""
        # СТРОГО СОХРАНЯЕМ self._last_loaded_model_id для автоматического возврата LLM после генерации в Forge
        return True

    def safe_unload_models(self) -> bool:
        """Безопасная выгрузка моделей (REST + CLI fallback)."""
        return self.unload_models_cli()

    def unload_models(self) -> bool:
        """Безопасная выгрузка моделей (REST + CLI fallback)."""
        return self.unload_models_cli()

    def unload_model(self) -> bool:
        """Выгрузка текущей модели из VRAM (обратная совместимость)."""
        return self.unload_models_cli()

    def ensure_model_loaded(self, preferred_model: Optional[str] = None, context_length: Optional[int] = None, gpu_ratio: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> bool:
        """
        Гарантирует загрузку строго одной модели в VRAM с заданными параметрами контекста и GPU ratio.
        """
        with self._reload_lock:
            target_model = preferred_model or getattr(self, "_last_loaded_model_id", None)
            if not target_model or str(target_model).startswith("default"):
                if self.process_manager and hasattr(self.process_manager, "has_headless_server") and self.process_manager.has_headless_server():
                    try:
                        from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager
                        app_cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
                        target_model = app_cfg.get("active_model")
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                if not target_model or str(target_model).startswith("default"):
                    catalog = self.get_models()
                    target_model = catalog[0] if catalog else None

            if not target_model:
                logger.warning("[LMStudio] Нет доступных моделей для загрузки.")
                raise ModelNotFoundError("активная модель")

            model_name = target_model

            from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager
            from config import HARDWARE_MAX_CONTEXT_LENGTH, MASTER_MAX_RESPONSE_TOKENS, MODE_PROFILES
            app_cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()

            m_key = "engineer" if kwargs.get("is_engineer") else ("roleplay" if kwargs.get("is_roleplay") else "assistant")
            def_ctx = MODE_PROFILES.get(m_key, {}).get("context_length", 14336)

            if context_length:
                target_ctx = int(context_length)
            else:
                target_ctx = int(app_cfg.get(f"context_length_{m_key}", def_ctx))
            target_ctx = min(target_ctx, HARDWARE_MAX_CONTEXT_LENGTH)
            target_gpu = str(gpu_ratio) if gpu_ratio is not None else "1.0"

            current_ctx = getattr(self, "_current_loaded_ctx", 0)
            current_gpu = getattr(self, "_current_loaded_gpu", "1.0")

            # Защита от частых перезагрузок (Reload Loop):
            # Перезагрузка не требуется, если модель активна, текущей ёмкости контекста достаточно и сервер доступен
            if (
                not getattr(self, "_is_model_unloaded", False)
                and self.is_model_loaded(model_name)
                and current_ctx >= target_ctx
                and current_gpu == target_gpu
                and self.check_health()[0]
            ):
                self._last_loaded_model_id = model_name
                return True

            # Headless server путь через ProcessManager
            if self.process_manager and hasattr(self.process_manager, "has_headless_server") and self.process_manager.has_headless_server():
                logger.info(f"[LMStudio] Шлюз: запуск/перезапуск headless сервера для '{model_name}' (CTX={target_ctx}, GPU={target_gpu})...")
                ngl = 0 if target_gpu in ("0", "0.0", "cpu", "CPU Only") else None
                if ngl is None:
                    try:
                        from services.server_config import ServerConfigResolver
                        ngl = ServerConfigResolver.load_ini().get("gpu_layers", 99)
                    except Exception:
                        ngl = 99

                ok = self.process_manager.start_llama_server_sync(
                    model_identifier=model_name,
                    context_length=target_ctx,
                    gpu_layers=ngl
                )
                if not ok:
                    logger.warning(f"[LMStudio] Headless сервер не смог запустить модель '{model_name}'.")
                    raise ModelNotFoundError(str(model_name))

                self._is_model_unloaded = False
                self._last_loaded_model_id = model_name
                self._current_loaded_ctx = target_ctx
                self._current_loaded_gpu = target_gpu
                logger.info(f"[LMStudio] Headless модель '{model_name}' готова к работе ({target_ctx // 1024}K, GPU layers: {ngl}).")
                return True

            # Legacy путь через subprocess lms load
            logger.info(f"[LMStudio] Подготовка VRAM перед загрузкой '{model_name}' (сброс старых слотов)...")
            self.unload_models_cli()

            # Аппаратная пауза: стабилизация VRAM после выгрузки
            try:
                import pynvml
                pynvml.nvmlInit()
                h = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(0)
                prev_free = 0
                for _ in range(6):
                    m_info = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo(h)
                    free_mb = m_info.free / 1024 / 1024
                    if free_mb >= 3800 or (prev_free > 0 and (free_mb - prev_free) > 500):
                        break
                    prev_free = free_mb
                    time.sleep(0.15)
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(0.2)

            try:
                import subprocess
                import sys

                startupinfo = None
                creationflags = 0
                if sys.platform == "win32":
                    startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
                    startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
                    startupinfo.wShowWindow = 0
                    creationflags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW

                logger.info(f"[LMStudio] Шлюз: чистая загрузка '{model_name}' ({target_ctx // 1024}K, GPU: {target_gpu})...")

                lms_bin = "lms"
                try:
                    from services.process_manager import ProcessManager
                    resolved = ProcessManager.locate_lms()
                    if resolved:
                        lms_bin = resolved
                except Exception:
                    pass

                cmd = [
                    lms_bin, "load", model_name,
                    "--gpu", target_gpu,
                    "--context-length", str(target_ctx),
                    "-y"
                ]
                res = subprocess.run(
                    cmd,
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    timeout=90,
                    startupinfo=startupinfo,
                    creationflags=creationflags
                )
                out = res.stdout or ""
                err = res.stderr or ""

                if "Model not found" in out or "No model found" in out or "not found" in err.lower() or "not found" in out.lower():
                    logger.warning(f"[LMStudio] Модель '{model_name}' не найдена на диске.")
                    raise ModelNotFoundError(model_name)

                if res.returncode == 0:
                    self._is_model_unloaded = False
                    self._last_loaded_model_id = model_name
                    self._current_loaded_ctx = target_ctx
                    self._current_loaded_gpu = target_gpu
                    logger.info(f"[LMStudio] Модель '{model_name}' готова к работе ({target_ctx // 1024}K, GPU: {target_gpu}).")
                    return True
                else:
                    logger.warning(f"[LMStudio] CLI warning: {err.strip()[:160]}")
                    raise ModelNotFoundError(model_name)
            except ModelNotFoundError:
                raise
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"[LMStudio] Ошибка CLI загрузки: {e}")
                raise ModelNotFoundError(model_name)

    def chat_completion(
        self,
        messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        model: Optional[str] = None,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
        max_tokens: int = 1024,
        context_length: Optional[int] = None,
        gpu_ratio: Optional[str] = None,
        emit_signal: bool = True,
        stream: bool = True,
        stop: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        is_roleplay: Optional[bool] = None,
        **kwargs
    ) -> str:
        """
        Sends chat completion request to LM Studio with streaming and tool interception.
        Supports Structured Outputs (response_format) for strict JSON validation.
        """
        is_eng = kwargs.pop("is_engineer", False)
        with _LMS_SOCKET_LOCK:
            target_m = model or getattr(self, "_last_loaded_model_id", None)
            if not target_m or target_m.startswith("default"):
                target_m = self.get_active_model_id(None)

            current_ctx = getattr(self, "_current_loaded_ctx", 8192)
            current_gpu = getattr(self, "_current_loaded_gpu", "1.0")

            from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager
            from config import HARDWARE_MAX_CONTEXT_LENGTH, MASTER_MAX_RESPONSE_TOKENS, MODE_PROFILES
            app_cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
            m_key = "engineer" if is_eng else ("roleplay" if is_roleplay else "assistant")
            def_ctx = MODE_PROFILES.get(m_key, {}).get("context_length", 14336)

            if context_length:
                target_ctx = int(context_length)
            else:
                target_ctx = int(app_cfg.get(f"context_length_{m_key}", def_ctx))
            target_ctx = min(target_ctx, HARDWARE_MAX_CONTEXT_LENGTH)
            target_gpu = str(gpu_ratio) if gpu_ratio is not None else "1.0"

            # Модель перезагружается только при смене модели, сбросе VRAM или нехватке контекста
            needs_reload = (
                getattr(self, "_is_model_unloaded", False)
                or not self.is_model_loaded(target_m)
                or current_ctx < target_ctx
                or current_gpu != target_gpu
            )
            if needs_reload:
                self.ensure_model_loaded(target_m, context_length=target_ctx, gpu_ratio=target_gpu)

            self._is_aborted = False
        self._current_session = self._persistent_session

        active_model_id = target_m
        self._last_loaded_model_id = active_model_id
        t_start = time.time()
        first_token_time = None
        tokens_count = 0
        logger.info(f"Sending chat completion to LM Studio for '{active_model_id}' (stream={stream}) {_get_vram_telemetry_str()}...")

        from services.session_manager import SessionManager

        est_tokens = sum(SessionManager._estimate_message_tokens(m) for m in messages if isinstance(m, dict))

        context_limit = max(target_ctx, getattr(self, "_current_loaded_ctx", target_ctx))
        requested = min(int(max_tokens or 1536), MASTER_MAX_RESPONSE_TOKENS)
        available_tokens = context_limit - est_tokens - 64
        safe_max_tokens = max(128, min(requested, max(128, available_tokens)))

        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": active_model_id,
            "messages": messages,
            "temperature": float(temperature),
            "stream": stream
        }
        if stop:
            payload["stop"] = stop
        if safe_max_tokens > 0:
            payload["max_tokens"] = safe_max_tokens
            payload["max_completion_tokens"] = safe_max_tokens

        # Поддержка синтаксиса LM Studio / llama.cpp REST
        rep_val = kwargs.get("repetition_penalty") or kwargs.get("repeat_penalty")
        if rep_val is not None:
            payload["repetition_penalty"] = float(rep_val)
            payload["repeat_penalty"] = float(rep_val)

        if "min_p" in kwargs and kwargs["min_p"] is not None:
            payload["min_p"] = float(kwargs["min_p"])

        for extra_k in ("presence_penalty", "frequency_penalty", "top_p", "top_k", "response_format"):
            if extra_k in kwargs and kwargs[extra_k] is not None:
                payload[extra_k] = kwargs[extra_k]

        logger.info(
            f"[LMS-PARAMS] model='{active_model_id}', temp={payload.get('temperature')}, "
            f"top_p={payload.get('top_p')}, min_p={payload.get('min_p')}, "
            f"rep_pen={payload.get('repetition_penalty')}, "
            f"max_tokens={payload.get('max_tokens')} (context_limit={context_limit})"
        )

        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        endpoint = f"{self.base_url}/chat/completions"

        try:

            resp = self._current_session.post(
                endpoint,
                json=payload,
                headers=headers,
                stream=stream,
                timeout=180.0
            )
            self._active_response = resp
            resp.encoding = "utf-8"

            if self._is_aborted:
                raise InterruptedError("Запрос к LM Studio был прерван пользователем.")

            if resp.status_code != 200:
                resp_text = resp.text
                resp_lower = resp_text.lower()
                has_image = any(isinstance(m.get("content"), list) for m in payload.get("messages", []))
                if has_image and (
                    resp.status_code == 400
                    or "vision" in resp_lower
                    or "image" in resp_lower
                    or "support" in resp_lower
                    or "multimodal" in resp_lower
                ):
                    err_text = (
                        "⚠️ Текущая модель не поддерживает распознавание изображений. "
                        "Выберите Vision-модель (например, Qwen2.5-VL)."
                    )
                    logger.warning(err_text)
                    self.error_occurred.emit(err_text)
                if "No models loaded" in resp_text or "not found" in resp_lower or "model not loaded" in resp_lower:
                    logger.warning(f"[LMStudio] Модель '{active_model_id}' не найдена или не загружена: {resp_text}")
                    raise ModelNotFoundError(model or active_model_id or "активная модель")

                err_text = f"Ошибка LM Studio [HTTP {resp.status_code}]: {resp.text}"
                logger.error(err_text)
                self.error_occurred.emit(err_text)
                raise RuntimeError(err_text)

            content = ""
            if stream:
                accumulated = []
                first_token_time = None
                tokens_count = 0

                try:
                    for line_bytes in resp.iter_lines(decode_unicode=False):
                        if self._is_aborted:
                            raise InterruptedError("Запрос к LM Studio был прерван пользователем.")
                        if not line_bytes:
                            continue

                        line = line_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
                        if line.startswith("data: "):
                            data_str = line[6:].strip()
                            if data_str == "[DONE]":
                                break
                            try:
                                chunk = json.loads(data_str)
                                choices = chunk.get("choices", [])
                                if not choices:
                                    continue
                                delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
                                content_piece = delta.get("content", "")
                                if not content_piece:
                                    continue

                                if content_piece:
                                    if first_token_time is None:
                                        first_token_time = time.time()
                                        ttft = first_token_time - t_start
                                        logger.info(f"[LMS-TELEMETRY] Time to First Token (TTFT): {ttft:.2f} сек {_get_vram_telemetry_str()}")
                                    tokens_count += 1

                                accumulated.append(content_piece)

                                if emit_signal:
                                    self.token_streamed.emit(content_piece)

                            except Exception:
                                continue
                    if self._is_aborted:
                        raise InterruptedError("Запрос к LM Studio был прерван пользователем.")
                except Exception as stream_err:
                    if self._is_aborted:
                        raise InterruptedError("Запрос к LM Studio был прерван пользователем.")
                    raise stream_err
                finally:
                    try:
                        resp.close()
                    except Exception:
                        pass

                content = "".join(accumulated)

            finish_reason = "unknown"
            prompt_tokens = 0
            if not content:
                try:
                    raw_text = resp.content.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                    data = json.loads(raw_text)
                    choices = data.get("choices", [])
                    if choices:
                        content = choices[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "") or ""
                    usage = data.get("usage", {})
                    prompt_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
                    completion_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)
                    finish_reason = choices[0].get("finish_reason", "unknown") if choices else "unknown"
                    if completion_tokens > 0:
                        tokens_count = completion_tokens
                except Exception:
                    pass


            content = str(content)
            t_total = time.time() - t_start
            ttft_val = (first_token_time - t_start) if first_token_time else 0.0
            gen_duration = max(0.05, t_total - ttft_val)
            tok_per_sec = (tokens_count / gen_duration) if tokens_count > 0 else (len(content) / 3.5 / gen_duration)
            
            logger.info(
                f"[LMS-TELEMETRY] Готово: {len(content)} симв, ~{tokens_count} токенов за {t_total:.2f} с "
                f"(TTFT: {ttft_val:.2f} с, Генерация: {gen_duration:.2f} с | Скорость: {tok_per_sec:.1f} tok/s) "
                f"finish_reason={finish_reason}, prompt_tokens={prompt_tokens} "
                f"{_get_vram_telemetry_str()}"
            )

            if emit_signal:
                self.response_received.emit(content)
            return content

        except ModelNotFoundError:
            raise
        except requests.exceptions.HTTPError as http_err:
            resp_text = getattr(http_err.response, "text", "")
            if "No models loaded" in resp_text or "not found" in resp_text.lower():
                raise ModelNotFoundError(model or "активная модель")
            raise RuntimeError(f"Ошибка LM Studio [HTTP {http_err.response.status_code}]: {resp_text}")
        except requests.exceptions.ConnectionError:
            err_msg = (
                f"Не удалось подключиться к LM Studio на {self.base_url}.\n"
                f"Убедитесь, что сервер запущен в LM Studio на порту 1234."
            )
            logger.error(err_msg)
            self.error_occurred.emit(err_msg)
            raise ConnectionError(err_msg)
        except Exception as e:
            if not self._is_aborted:
                self.error_occurred.emit(str(e))
            raise
        finally:
            self._current_session = None
            self._active_response = None

"""
Macro Engine for NeonRoute.
Parses dynamic roleplay macros: {{user}}, {{char}}, {{random: ...}}, {{roll: ...}}, and Tavern/Chub standard tags.
Zero VRAM overhead, pure CPU execution.
"""

import re
import random
from typing import Optional


class MacroEngine:
    _RE_USER = re.compile(r'\{\{\s*(?:user|user_name)\s*\}\}|<(?:USER|USER_NAME)>', re.IGNORECASE)
    _RE_CHAR = re.compile(r'\{\{\s*(?:char|char_name|bot)\s*\}\}|<(?:CHAR|CHAR_NAME|BOT)>', re.IGNORECASE)
    _RE_START = re.compile(r'<START>', re.IGNORECASE)
    _RE_RANDOM = re.compile(r'\{\{\s*random\s*:\s*([^}]+)\}\}', re.IGNORECASE)
    _RE_ROLL = re.compile(r'\{\{\s*roll\s*:\s*(\d+)d(\d+)(?:\s*([+-])\s*(\d+))?\s*\}\}', re.IGNORECASE)

    @classmethod
    def process(
        cls,
        text: Optional[str],
        user_name: str = "User",
        char_name: str = "Assistant"
    ) -> str:
        if not text:
            return ""

        result = str(text)

        # 1. Замена разделителя примеров диалогов Chub / Tavern на маркер сцены
        result = re.sub(r'(?:\r?\n)*\s*<START>\s*(?:\r?\n)*', '\n--- [Пример сцены] ---\n', result, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        result = result.lstrip('\r\n')

        # 2. Подстановка имён игрока и персонажа
        if user_name:
            result = cls._RE_USER.sub(user_name, result)
        if char_name:
            result = cls._RE_CHAR.sub(char_name, result)

        # 3. Обработка рандомных списков: {{random: opt1, opt2, opt3}}
        def _pick_random(match: re.Match) -> str:
            raw_options = match.group(1)
            options = [opt.strip() for opt in raw_options.split(',') if opt.strip()]
            return random.choice(options) if options else ""

        result = cls._RE_RANDOM.sub(_pick_random, result)

        # 4. Обработка бросков костей: {{roll: XdY[+Z]}}
        def _eval_roll(match: re.Match) -> str:
            count = min(max(1, int(match.group(1))), 20)
            sides = min(max(1, int(match.group(2))), 1000)
            sign = match.group(3)
            mod = int(match.group(4)) if match.group(4) else 0

            total = sum(random.randint(1, sides) for _ in range(count))
            if sign == "+":
                total += mod
            elif sign == "-":
                total -= mod
            return str(total)

        result = cls._RE_ROLL.sub(_eval_roll, result)
        return result

r"""
Local Long-Term User Memory Service for NeonRoute.
Backed by SQLite (C:\\NeonRoute\data\memory.db) and LanceDB vector store.
Runs strictly on CPU via FastEmbed ONNX to preserve 8GB VRAM for LLM & Forge.
Features semantic and exact deduplication and pronoun normalization.
"""

import os
import re
import sqlite3
import logging
import time
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import atexit
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple

from config import MEMORY_DB_PATH, DATA_DIR

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.MemoryDB")

_EMBED_INIT_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_LANCE_LOCK = threading.RLock()
_EMBED_MODEL = None
_LANCE_TABLE = None
_RP_LANCE_TABLE = None

def _get_embedding_engine():
    global _EMBED_MODEL, _LANCE_TABLE, _RP_LANCE_TABLE
    with _EMBED_INIT_LOCK:
        if _EMBED_MODEL is None:
            try:
                from fastembed import TextEmbedding
                import lancedb
                _EMBED_MODEL = TextEmbedding(model_name="sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2")
                lance_path = DATA_DIR / "vector_memory"
                lance_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                db = lancedb.connect(str(lance_path))
                
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    raw_tables = db.list_tables() if hasattr(db, "list_tables") else db.table_names()
                    tables_iter = getattr(raw_tables, "tables", raw_tables)
                    table_names = set(tables_iter) if isinstance(tables_iter, (list, tuple, set)) else set()

                    # 1. Глобальная память ассистента
                    try:
                        if "facts" in table_names:
                            _LANCE_TABLE = db.open_table("facts")
                        else:
                            dummy_vec = list(_EMBED_MODEL.embed(["init"]))[0].tolist()
                            _LANCE_TABLE = db.create_table("facts", data=[{"id": "init_id", "text": "init", "vector": dummy_vec}])
                    except Exception:
                        _LANCE_TABLE = db.open_table("facts")

                    # 2. Изолированная сессионная память для ролевых чатов
                    try:
                        if "rp_memories" in table_names:
                            _RP_LANCE_TABLE = db.open_table("rp_memories")
                        else:
                            dummy_vec = list(_EMBED_MODEL.embed(["init"]))[0].tolist()
                            _RP_LANCE_TABLE = db.create_table(
                                "rp_memories",
                                data=[{
                                    "id": "init_id",
                                    "session_id": "init_sess",
                                    "text": "init",
                                    "vector": dummy_vec,
                                    "timestamp": "0"
                                }]
                            )
                    except Exception:
                        _RP_LANCE_TABLE = db.open_table("rp_memories")

                logger.info("FastEmbed CPU ONNX and LanceDB (facts + rp_memories) ready.")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"LanceDB/FastEmbed initialization fallback: {e}")
                _EMBED_MODEL = False
                _LANCE_TABLE = False
                _RP_LANCE_TABLE = False
    return _EMBED_MODEL, _LANCE_TABLE, _RP_LANCE_TABLE

_LAST_LANCE_CLEANUP = 0.0
_WRITE_OP_COUNT = 0
_CLEANUP_EVERY_N_WRITES = 20

def _maybe_cleanup_lance_tables(force: bool = False):
    """
    Периодическая очистка старых версий и фрагментов LanceDB.
    Срабатывает раз в 300 секунд или каждые N операций записи, не блокируя запуск.
    """
    global _LAST_LANCE_CLEANUP, _WRITE_OP_COUNT
    _WRITE_OP_COUNT += 1
    now = time.time()
    if not force and (_WRITE_OP_COUNT < _CLEANUP_EVERY_N_WRITES) and (now - _LAST_LANCE_CLEANUP < 300):
        return
    _LAST_LANCE_CLEANUP = now
    _WRITE_OP_COUNT = 0
    try:
        if "memory_db" in globals() and globals()["memory_db"] is not None:
            globals()["memory_db"].optimize_tables()
        else:
            _, facts_t, rp_t = _get_embedding_engine()
            for tbl_name, tbl in [("facts", facts_t), ("rp_memories", rp_t)]:
                if not tbl:
                    continue
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    try:
                        # 1. Объединение мелких фрагментов данных в крупные блоки
                        if hasattr(tbl, "compact_files"):
                            try:
                                tbl.compact_files()
                            except Exception as e_compact:
                                logger.debug(f"[MemoryDB] compact_files fallback for '{tbl_name}': {e_compact}")
                        # 2. Очистка старых снимков и транзакций (оставляем только актуальное состояние)
                        if hasattr(tbl, "cleanup_old_versions"):
                            try:
                                tbl.cleanup_old_versions(older_than=timedelta(0), delete_unverified=True)
                            except Exception:
                                try:
                                    tbl.cleanup_old_versions()
                                except Exception as e_clean:
                                    logger.debug(f"[MemoryDB] cleanup_old_versions fallback for '{tbl_name}': {e_clean}")
                        # 3. Нативная оптимизация LanceDB (компактизация + очистка версий и транзакций)
                        if hasattr(tbl, "optimize"):
                            try:
                                tbl.optimize(cleanup_older_than=timedelta(0), delete_unverified=True)
                            except Exception as e_opt:
                                logger.debug(f"[MemoryDB] optimize fallback for '{tbl_name}': {e_opt}")
                        logger.info(f"Таблица LanceDB '{tbl_name}' успешно оптимизирована.")
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.warning(f"Ошибка при компактизации таблицы LanceDB '{tbl_name}': {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug(f"[MemoryDB] LanceDB cleanup error: {e}")

SAVE_TRIGGERS = [
    "занеси в память", "сохрани факт", "save fact", "запомни", "запиши", "remember"
]
VIEW_TRIGGERS = [
    "что ты обо мне знаешь", "покажи память", "список памяти", "мои факты", "show memory",
    "память", "моя память", "список фактов", "все факты"
]
CLEAR_TRIGGERS = [
    "забудь всё", "забудь все", "очисти память", "clear memory", "forget all"
]

_SAVE_PATTERN_STR = (
    r"^\s*(?:" + "|".join(re.escape(t) for t in sorted(SAVE_TRIGGERS, key=len, reverse=True)) + r")"
    r"(?:[:,\s\-–—]+|\s+что\s+|\s+то,\s*что\s*|\s+)+(.*)$"
)
_SAVE_REGEX = re.compile(_SAVE_PATTERN_STR, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
_STANDALONE_SAVE_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(?:" + "|".join(re.escape(t) for t in sorted(SAVE_TRIGGERS, key=len, reverse=True)) + r")\s*[:,\-–—]?\s*$",
    re.IGNORECASE
)
_VIEW_PATTERN_STR = r"^\s*(?:" + "|".join(re.escape(t) for t in sorted(VIEW_TRIGGERS, key=len, reverse=True)) + r")[\s?!.]*$"
_VIEW_REGEX = re.compile(_VIEW_PATTERN_STR, re.IGNORECASE)
_CLEAR_PATTERN_STR = r"^\s*(?:" + "|".join(re.escape(t) for t in sorted(CLEAR_TRIGGERS, key=len, reverse=True)) + r")[\s.!]*(.*)$"
_CLEAR_REGEX = re.compile(_CLEAR_PATTERN_STR, re.IGNORECASE)
_DELETE_ID_REGEX = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:забудь(?:\s+факт)?|удали(?:\s+факт)?|forget(?:\s+fact)?|delete(?:\s+fact)?)\s*#?(\d+)[\s.]*$", re.IGNORECASE)
_DELETE_KEYWORD_REGEX = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:забудь(?:\s+факт)?|удали(?:\s+факт)?|forget(?:\s+fact)?|delete(?:\s+fact)?)\s+(.+)$", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)

def normalize_fact_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Normalizes 1st person pronouns into 3rd person to prevent model identity confusion."""
    cleaned = text.strip()
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^(?:я\s+|мне\s+|меня\s+)', 'Пользователь ', cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^(?:мой\s+|мое\s+|моё\s+)', 'Проект/предпочтение пользователя: ', cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'\s+я\s+', ' пользователь ', cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'\s+мне\s+', ' пользователю ', cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'\s+мой\s+', ' пользователя ', cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return cleaned.strip()

def parse_memory_trigger(text: str) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:
    if not text:
        return False, None
    cleaned = text.strip()
    match = _SAVE_REGEX.match(cleaned)
    if match:
        fact = match.group(1).strip()
        fact = re.sub(r"^(?:что|то,\s*что)\s+", "", fact, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()
        if (fact.startswith('"') and fact.endswith('"')) or (fact.startswith("'") and fact.endswith("'")):
            fact = fact[1:-1].strip()
        return True, fact
    if _STANDALONE_SAVE_REGEX.match(cleaned):
        return True, ""
    return False, None

class MemoryDB:
    def __init__(self, db_path: Optional[Path | str] = None):
        self.db_path = Path(db_path) if db_path else MEMORY_DB_PATH
        self._init_db()

    def _get_connection(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        self.db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        conn = sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path), timeout=30.0)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000;")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;")
        return conn

    def _init_db(self):
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_memory (
                        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                        fact TEXT NOT NULL,
                        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
                    );
                    """
                )
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reminders (
                        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                        text TEXT NOT NULL,
                        remind_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                        status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
                        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
                    );
                    """
                )
                conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reminders_status_time ON reminders(status, remind_at);")
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rp_memory (
                        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                        session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                        fact TEXT NOT NULL,
                        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
                    );
                    """
                )
                conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rp_memory_sess ON rp_memory(session_id);")
                conn.execute("CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS memories AS SELECT id, fact, created_at FROM user_memory;")
                conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to initialize MemoryDB schema: {e}")

    @property
    def table(self):
        """Возвращает дескриптор таблицы 'facts' LanceDB."""
        _, facts_t, _ = _get_embedding_engine()
        return facts_t if facts_t else None

    @property
    def rp_table(self):
        """Возвращает дескриптор таблицы 'rp_memories' LanceDB."""
        _, _, rp_t = _get_embedding_engine()
        return rp_t if rp_t else None

    def optimize_tables(self):
        """Выполняет объединение мелких фрагментов и очистку устаревших версий."""
        for table_name, table in [("facts", self.table), ("rp_memories", self.rp_table)]:
            if table is None:
                continue
            try:
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    # 1. Объединение мелких фрагментов данных в крупные блоки
                    if hasattr(table, "compact_files"):
                        try:
                            table.compact_files()
                        except Exception as e_compact:
                            logger.debug(f"[LanceDB] compact_files fallback for '{table_name}': {e_compact}")

                    # 2. Очистка старых снимков и транзакций (оставляем только актуальное состояние)
                    if hasattr(table, "cleanup_old_versions"):
                        try:
                            table.cleanup_old_versions(older_than=timedelta(0), delete_unverified=True)
                        except Exception:
                            try:
                                table.cleanup_old_versions()
                            except Exception as e_clean:
                                logger.debug(f"[LanceDB] cleanup_old_versions fallback for '{table_name}': {e_clean}")

                    # 3. Нативная оптимизация LanceDB (компактизация + очистка версий и транзакций)
                    if hasattr(table, "optimize"):
                        try:
                            table.optimize(cleanup_older_than=timedelta(0), delete_unverified=True)
                        except Exception as e_opt:
                            logger.debug(f"[LanceDB] table.optimize fallback for '{table_name}': {e_opt}")

                logger.info(f"Таблица LanceDB '{table_name}' успешно оптимизирована.")
            except Exception as e:
                # Логируем, но не прерываем работу приложения
                logger.warning(f"Ошибка при компактизации таблицы LanceDB '{table_name}': {e}")

    def cleanup(self):
        """Штатная очистка и оптимизация ресурсов памяти."""
        self.optimize_tables()

    def close(self):
        """Штатное закрытие MemoryDB с оптимизацией таблиц."""
        self.cleanup()

    def add_rp_memory(self, session_id: str, text: str) -> int:
        """
        Сохраняет сюжетную веху в векторную память конкретной сессии.
        Проверяет дедупликацию и удерживает лимит до 100 воспоминаний на сессию.
        """
        if not session_id or not text or not text.strip():
            return -1

        clean_text = text.strip()
        clean_lower = clean_text.lower()

        # 1. Проверка дубликатов в SQLite для этой сессии
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT id, fact FROM rp_memory WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC;",
                    (session_id,)
                )
                existing = cursor.fetchall()
                for ef in existing:
                    f_low = ef["fact"].lower()
                    if clean_lower in f_low or f_low in clean_lower:
                        return ef["id"]

                # Скользящий лимит: максимум 100 воспоминаний на диалог (для длинных сюжетов)
                if len(existing) >= 100:
                    oldest_id = existing[-1]["id"]
                    conn.execute("DELETE FROM rp_memory WHERE id = ?;", (oldest_id,))
                    _, _, rp_table = _get_embedding_engine()
                    if rp_table:
                        try:
                            with _LANCE_LOCK:
                                rp_table.delete(f'id = "{oldest_id}"')
                        except Exception:
                            pass
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[RPMemory] Ошибка проверки дубликатов: {e}")

        # 2. Семантическая проверка в LanceDB
        try:
            embed_model, _, rp_table = _get_embedding_engine()
            if embed_model and rp_table:
                safe_sid = str(session_id).replace("'", "''")
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    vec = list(embed_model.embed([clean_text]))[0].tolist()
                    sim_res = rp_table.search(vec).where(f"session_id = '{safe_sid}'").limit(1).to_list()
                if sim_res:
                    top_m = sim_res[0]
                    dist = top_m.get("_distance", 1.0)
                    if top_m.get("id") != "init_id" and dist < 0.20:
                        return int(top_m.get("id")) if top_m.get("id", "").isdigit() else -1
        except Exception:
            pass

        # 3. Сохранение в SQLite
        row_id = -1
        date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cur = conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO rp_memory (session_id, fact, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?);",
                    (session_id, clean_text, date_str)
                )
                conn.commit()
                row_id = cur.lastrowid
                logger.info(f"[NeonRoute.RPMemory] Сохранена сюжетная веха [Сессия {session_id[:8]} | ID {row_id}]: «{clean_text}»")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[RPMemory] Ошибка сохранения в SQLite: {e}")
            return -1

        # 4. Сохранение в LanceDB
        try:
            embed_model, _, rp_table = _get_embedding_engine()
            if embed_model and rp_table:
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    vec = list(embed_model.embed([clean_text]))[0].tolist()
                    rp_table.add([{
                        "id": str(row_id),
                        "session_id": str(session_id),
                        "text": clean_text,
                        "vector": vec,
                        "timestamp": str(time.time())
                    }])
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"[RPMemory] LanceDB insert error: {e}")

        _maybe_cleanup_lance_tables()
        return row_id

    def search_rp_memories(self, session_id: str, query: str, top_k: int = 4, max_distance: float = 0.42) -> List[str]:
        """
        Ищет семантически релевантные воспоминания строго внутри активной сессии.
        Логирует совпадения и дистанции.
        """
        if not session_id or not query or not query.strip():
            return []

        try:
            embed_model, _, rp_table = _get_embedding_engine()
            if embed_model and rp_table:
                safe_sid = str(session_id).replace("'", "''")
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    query_vec = list(embed_model.embed([query.strip()]))[0].tolist()
                    res = rp_table.search(query_vec).where(f"session_id = '{safe_sid}'").limit(top_k * 2).to_list()
                
                relevant = []
                for r in res:
                    if r.get("id") == "init_id":
                        continue
                    dist = r.get("_distance", 1.0)
                    if dist <= max_distance:
                        relevant.append((r["text"], dist))

                if relevant:
                    # Сортировка по минимальной дистанции и срез top_k
                    relevant.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
                    top_matches = relevant[:top_k]
                    
                    log_hits = "\n".join(f"  • (dist={d:.3f}): «{txt}»" for txt, d in top_matches)
                    logger.info(
                        f"[NeonRoute.RPMemory] [Recall-Hit] Сессия [{session_id[:8]}]: "
                        f"найдено {len(top_matches)} воспоминаний по запросу «{query[:40]}...»:\n{log_hits}"
                    )
                    return [txt for txt, _ in top_matches]
                else:
                    logger.debug(f"[NeonRoute.RPMemory] Сессия [{session_id[:8]}]: воспоминаний не найдено (порог <= {max_distance}).")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"[RPMemory] Ошибка поиска: {e}")

        return []

    def clear_rp_session_memory(self, session_id: str):
        """Очищает всю память сессии при удалении диалога."""
        if not session_id:
            return
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM rp_memory WHERE session_id = ?;", (session_id,))
                conn.commit()
            _, _, rp_table = _get_embedding_engine()
            if rp_table:
                safe_sid = str(session_id).replace("'", "''")
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    rp_table.delete(f"session_id = '{safe_sid}'")
            logger.info(f"[NeonRoute.RPMemory] Очищена память сессии [{session_id[:8]}].")
            _maybe_cleanup_lance_tables()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"[RPMemory] Ошибка очистки сессии: {e}")

    def add_fact(self, text: str) -> int:
        """
        Adds a fact with automatic 3rd person normalization,
        exact duplicate check, and semantic similarity check.
        """
        raw_fact = text.strip() if text else ""
        if not raw_fact:
            return -1

        clean_fact = normalize_fact_text(raw_fact)
        clean_fact_lower = clean_fact.lower()

        # 1. Exact duplicate check in SQLite
        existing_facts = self.get_all_facts()
        for ef in existing_facts:
            ef_lower = ef["fact"].strip().lower()
            if ef_lower == clean_fact_lower or clean_fact_lower in ef_lower or ef_lower in clean_fact_lower:
                logger.info(f"Duplicate fact ignored (exact/substring match): '{clean_fact}' matches #{ef['id']}")
                return ef["id"]

        # 2. Semantic similarity check via LanceDB (distance < 0.20 means near identical)
        try:
            embed_model, table, _ = _get_embedding_engine()
            if embed_model and table:
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    vec = list(embed_model.embed([clean_fact]))[0].tolist()
                    sim_res = table.search(vec).limit(1).to_list()
                if sim_res:
                    top_match = sim_res[0]
                    dist = top_match.get("_distance", 1.0)
                    if top_match.get("id") != "init_id" and dist < 0.22:
                        logger.info(f"Semantic duplicate ignored (dist={dist:.3f}): '{clean_fact}' ~ '{top_match.get('text')}'")
                        return int(top_match.get("id")) if top_match.get("id", "").isdigit() else -1
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Semantic deduplication skipped: {e}")

        # 3. Insert new unique fact into SQLite
        date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%d.%m.%Y")
        row_id = -1
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute("INSERT INTO user_memory (fact, created_at) VALUES (?, ?);", (clean_fact, date_str))
                conn.commit()
                row_id = cursor.lastrowid
                logger.info(f"Saved new unique fact [ID: {row_id}]: '{clean_fact}'")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error saving fact to SQLite: {e}")
            return -1

        # 4. Insert into LanceDB
        try:
            embed_model, table, _ = _get_embedding_engine()
            if embed_model and table:
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    vec = list(embed_model.embed([clean_fact]))[0].tolist()
                    table.add([{"id": str(row_id), "text": clean_fact, "vector": vec}])
            _maybe_cleanup_lance_tables()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"LanceDB insert error: {e}")

        return row_id

    def search_relevant_facts(self, query: str, top_k: int = 5, max_distance: float = 0.48) -> List[str]:
        """
        Возвращает только семантически релевантные факты (порог max_distance).
        Если совпадений нет, возвращает пустой список, исключая галлюцинации контекста.
        """
        if not query or not query.strip():
            return []
        try:
            embed_model, table, _ = _get_embedding_engine()
            if embed_model and table:
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    query_vec = list(embed_model.embed([query.strip()]))[0].tolist()
                    res = table.search(query_vec).limit(top_k).to_list()
                # Фильтрация по дистанции: отсекаем семантический шум
                relevant = [
                    r["text"] for r in res 
                    if r.get("id") != "init_id" and r.get("_distance", 1.0) <= max_distance
                ]
                return relevant
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Search error in LanceDB: {e}")

        return []

    def get_all_facts(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute("SELECT id, fact, created_at FROM user_memory ORDER BY id ASC;")
                return [{"id": r["id"], "fact": r["fact"], "date": r["created_at"]} for r in cursor.fetchall() if r["fact"]]
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error fetching facts: {e}")
            return []

    def get_all_records(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.get_all_facts()

    def get_all_memories_formatted(self) -> str:
        """
        Форматирование вывода списка фактов строго от 1 по порядку
        без вывода технических ID базы.
        """
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                try:
                    cursor.execute("SELECT id, fact FROM memories ORDER BY id ASC;")
                except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                    cursor.execute("SELECT id, fact FROM user_memory ORDER BY id ASC;")
                rows = cursor.fetchall()
                lines = [f"{idx}. {row['fact']}" for idx, row in enumerate(rows, start=1)]
                return "\n".join(lines) if lines else "Я пока ничего о вас не знаю."
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error fetching formatted memories: {e}")
            return "Я пока ничего о вас не знаю."

    def delete_fact_by_number(self, n: int | str) -> str:
        """
        Детерминированное удаление по порядковому номеру через OFFSET
        с fallback-поиском по id.
        """
        try:
            n_int = int(n)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return f"Факт под номером {n} не найден."

        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                row = None
                table_name = "memories"
                try:
                    conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM memories LIMIT 1;")
                except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                    table_name = "user_memory"

                # 1. Сначала ищем запись по порядковому номеру (OFFSET N-1)
                if n_int >= 1:
                    cursor.execute(
                        f"SELECT id, fact FROM {table_name} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET ?",
                        (n_int - 1,)
                    )
                    row = cursor.fetchone()

                # 2. Если запись по смещению не найдена, пробуем прямой поиск по id (fallback)
                if not row:
                    cursor.execute(f"SELECT id, fact FROM {table_name} WHERE id = ?", (n_int,))
                    row = cursor.fetchone()

                if row:
                    target_id = row["id"]
                    deleted_fact = row["fact"]
                    # Удаляем из SQLite и LanceDB по target_id
                    self.delete_fact_by_id(target_id)
                    return f"Забыла: «{deleted_fact}»."
                else:
                    return f"Факт под номером {n} не найден."
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error deleting fact by number {n}: {e}")
            return f"Факт под номером {n} не найден."

    def delete_fact_by_id(self, fact_id: int) -> bool:
        deleted = False
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM user_memory WHERE id = ?;", (fact_id,))
                conn.commit()
                deleted = cursor.rowcount > 0
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error deleting fact #{fact_id}: {e}")

        try:
            _, table, _ = _get_embedding_engine()
            if table:
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    table.delete(f'id = "{fact_id}"')
        except Exception:
            pass
        return deleted

    def delete_fact(self, fact_id: int) -> bool:
        return self.delete_fact_by_id(fact_id)

    def delete_fact_by_keyword(self, keyword: str) -> int:
        clean_kw = keyword.strip() if keyword else ""
        if not clean_kw:
            return 0
        clean_kw = re.sub(r"^(?:про|о|об|about)\s+", "", clean_kw, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip().strip('"\'')
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM user_memory WHERE fact LIKE ?;", (f"%{clean_kw}%",))
                m_ids = [r["id"] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
                cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM user_memory WHERE fact LIKE ?;", (f"%{clean_kw}%",))
                conn.commit()
                count = cursor.rowcount

            _, table, _ = _get_embedding_engine()
            if table and m_ids:
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    for mid in m_ids:
                        try:
                            table.delete(f'id = "{mid}"')
                        except Exception:
                            pass
            return count
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error deleting by keyword: {e}")
            return 0

    def clear_all(self) -> bool:
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM user_memory;")
                try:
                    conn.execute("DELETE FROM sqlite_sequence WHERE name = 'user_memory';")
                except Exception:
                    pass
                conn.commit()

            _, table, _ = _get_embedding_engine()
            if table:
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    table.delete('id != "init_id"')
            _maybe_cleanup_lance_tables()
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error clearing memory: {e}")
            return False

    def clear_all_facts(self) -> bool:
        return self.clear_all()

    def add_reminder(self, text: str, remind_at_iso: str) -> int:
        """Добавляет напоминание в очередь планировщика."""
        now_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO reminders (text, remind_at, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'pending', ?);",
                    (text.strip(), remind_at_iso.strip(), now_str)
                )
                conn.commit()
                r_id = cursor.lastrowid
                logger.info(f"Saved new reminder [ID: {r_id}] for {remind_at_iso}: '{text}'")
                return r_id
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error adding reminder: {e}")
            return -1

    def get_due_reminders(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Возвращает список напоминаний, срок которых наступил."""
        now_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT id, text, remind_at FROM reminders WHERE status = 'pending' AND remind_at <= ? ORDER BY remind_at ASC;",
                    (now_str,)
                )
                rows = cursor.fetchall()
                return [{"id": r["id"], "text": r["text"], "remind_at": r["remind_at"]} for r in rows]
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error getting due reminders: {e}")
            return []

    def mark_reminder_done(self, reminder_id: int) -> bool:
        """Помечает напоминание как выполненное."""
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute("UPDATE reminders SET status = 'done' WHERE id = ?;", (reminder_id,))
                conn.commit()
                return cursor.rowcount > 0
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error marking reminder done #{reminder_id}: {e}")
            return False

    def get_all_reminders(self, limit: int = 20) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Возвращает последние напоминания."""
        try:
            with self._get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT id, text, remind_at, status, created_at FROM reminders ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?;",
                    (limit,)
                )
                return [{"id": r["id"], "text": r["text"], "remind_at": r["remind_at"], "status": r["status"]} for r in cursor.fetchall()]
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error getting all reminders: {e}")
            return []

memory_db = MemoryDB()

# Автоматическая оптимизация таблиц памяти при штатном завершении процесса
try:
    atexit.register(memory_db.close)
except Exception:
    pass

def optimize_tables(db: Optional[MemoryDB] = None):
    """Выполняет оптимизацию таблиц для указанного или глобального экземпляра MemoryDB."""
    active_db = db or memory_db
    active_db.optimize_tables()

def get_all_memories_formatted(db: Optional[MemoryDB] = None) -> str:
    active_db = db or memory_db
    return active_db.get_all_memories_formatted()

def delete_fact_by_number(n: int | str, db: Optional[MemoryDB] = None) -> str:
    active_db = db or memory_db
    return active_db.delete_fact_by_number(n)

def handle_memory_command(text: str, db: Optional[MemoryDB] = None) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:
    if not text:
        return False, None
    active_db = db or memory_db
    cleaned = text.strip()

    if _VIEW_REGEX.match(cleaned):
        return True, active_db.get_all_memories_formatted()

    if _CLEAR_REGEX.match(cleaned):
        active_db.clear_all()
        return True, "Очистила всю память о тебе."

    id_match = _DELETE_ID_REGEX.match(cleaned)
    if id_match:
        n = id_match.group(1)
        reply = active_db.delete_fact_by_number(n)
        return True, reply

    kw_match = _DELETE_KEYWORD_REGEX.match(cleaned)
    if kw_match:
        raw_kw = kw_match.group(1).strip()
        if not any(raw_kw.lower().startswith(t) for t in SAVE_TRIGGERS):
            clean_kw = re.sub(r"^(?:про|о|об|about)\s+", "", raw_kw, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip().strip('"\'')
            if clean_kw:
                cnt = active_db.delete_fact_by_keyword(clean_kw)
                if cnt > 0:
                    return True, f"Удалила из памяти {cnt} факт(ов), содержащих «{clean_kw}»."
                return True, f"Не нашла в памяти записей, содержащих «{clean_kw}»."

    is_save, fact_text = parse_memory_trigger(cleaned)
    if is_save:
        if fact_text and fact_text.strip():
            clean_content = re.sub(r"^[\s.]+|[\s.]+$", "", fact_text)
            if not clean_content:
                return True, "Пожалуйста, укажите факт. Например: «Запомни, меня зовут...»"
            row_id = active_db.add_fact(clean_content)
            if row_id == -1:
                return True, "Этот факт уже есть в моей памяти. Дубликат не сохранен."
            return True, "Записала в долговременную память. Буду учитывать в ответах."
        return True, "Пожалуйста, укажите факт. Например: «Запомни, меня зовут...»"

    return False, None

# Фоновый прогрев FastEmbed и LanceDB при запуске (устраняет микрофриз первого сообщения)
import threading

def warmup_memory_engine():
    """Централизованный фоновый прогрев FastEmbed и LanceDB."""
    def _run():
        try:
            _get_embedding_engine()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Async warmup exception: {e}")

    threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True, name="FastEmbedWarmup").start()
