"""
Tavern / Chub Character Card Parser for NeonRoute
Supports TavernCard V1, TavernCard V2 (chara_card_v2), and Chub.ai JSON card formats.
Extracts persona data, greetings, examples, and formats roleplay system prompts.
"""

import json
import re
import uuid
import base64
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict, is_dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple, Union, List
from config import CHARACTERS_DIR

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.TavernParser")



# Facade Re-export (Zero-Breaking-Changes)
from services.tavern_models import LoreEntry, CharacterCard

__all__ = [
    "TavernParser",
    "LoreEntry",
    "CharacterCard",
]


class TavernParser:
    """Parses Tavern and Chub.ai character JSON cards."""

    @staticmethod
    def extract_lore_entries(data: dict) -> list[LoreEntry]:
        """
        Унифицированно извлекает статьи из character_book.entries, world_info.entries или корневого entries
        (поддерживая как list, так и dict.values()). Фильтрует пустые записи, заполняет keys, content, comment, enabled, constant.
        """
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            return []

        target = data
        if isinstance(target.get("data"), dict):
            target = target["data"]
        if isinstance(target.get("character"), dict):
            target = target["character"]
        elif isinstance(target.get("definition"), dict):
            target = target["definition"]

        candidate_dicts = [target]
        if isinstance(data.get("data"), dict):
            candidate_dicts.append(data["data"])
        if isinstance(data.get("character"), dict):
            candidate_dicts.append(data["character"])
        if isinstance(data.get("definition"), dict):
            candidate_dicts.append(data["definition"])
        candidate_dicts.append(data)

        cb = None
        for d in candidate_dicts:
            if not isinstance(d, dict):
                continue
            for k in ("character_book", "lorebook", "world_info"):
                container = d.get(k)
                if isinstance(container, dict) and "entries" in container:
                    cb = container
                    break
            if cb:
                break
            if "entries" in d and isinstance(d["entries"], (dict, list)):
                cb = d
                break

        if not cb:
            return []

        raw_entries = cb.get("entries")
        if not raw_entries:
            return []

        if isinstance(raw_entries, dict):
            items = list(raw_entries.values())
        elif isinstance(raw_entries, list):
            items = raw_entries
        else:
            return []

        entries: list[LoreEntry] = []
        for item in items:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue

            raw_keys = item.get("keys") or item.get("key") or []
            if isinstance(raw_keys, list):
                keys = [str(k).strip() for k in raw_keys if str(k).strip()]
            elif isinstance(raw_keys, str):
                keys = [k.strip() for k in raw_keys.split(",") if k.strip()]
            else:
                keys = []

            content = str(item.get("content") or item.get("text") or "").strip()
            comment = str(item.get("comment") or item.get("name") or "").strip()
            enabled = bool(item.get("enabled", True))
            constant = bool(item.get("constant", False) or item.get("always_active", False))

            if not content:
                continue

            entries.append(LoreEntry(
                keys=keys,
                content=content,
                comment=comment,
                enabled=enabled,
                constant=constant,
                raw=item
            ))

        return entries

    @staticmethod
    def extract_physical_dna_regex(text: str) -> str:
        if not text:
            return ""
        patterns = [
            r'\[(?:Appearance|Face|Eyes|Hair|Body|Build)\s*[:=]\s*([^\]]+)\]',
            r'(?:Appearance|Looks)\s*\(([^)]+)\)'
        ]
        clothing_stop = {"armor", "plate", "dress", "cloak", "robe", "boots", "skirt", "suit", "jacket", "доспех", "броня", "платье", "плащ"}
        tokens = []
        for p in patterns:
            for m in re.finditer(p, text, re.IGNORECASE):
                for t in m.group(1).replace('"', '').replace("'", "").split(','):
                    c = t.strip()
                    if c and not any(s in c.lower() for s in clothing_stop):
                        tokens.append(c)
        seen, clean = set(), []
        for t in tokens:
            if t.lower() not in seen:
                seen.add(t.lower())
                clean.append(t)
        return ", ".join(clean)

    @staticmethod
    def extract_scenery_dna_regex(text: str) -> str:
        if not text:
            return ""
        # Поиск явных тегов локации [Location: ...] или Setting (...)
        patterns = [
            r'\[(?:Location|Setting|Environment|Place|Scene)\s*[:=]\s*([^\]]+)\]',
            r'(?:Setting|Location)\s*\(([^)]+)\)'
        ]
        # Стоп-слова времени суток и освещения (они должны определяться световым слоем, а не фоном)
        lighting_time_stops = {
            "night", "day", "dark", "bright", "sunset", "sunrise", "noon", "morning", "evening",
            "midnight", "dim", "light", "lighting", "shadow", "ночь", "день", "утро", "вечер", "свет", "тьма"
        }
        tokens = []
        for p in patterns:
            for m in re.finditer(p, text, re.IGNORECASE):
                for t in m.group(1).replace('"', '').replace("'", "").split(','):
                    c = t.strip()
                    if c and not any(s in c.lower() for s in lighting_time_stops):
                        tokens.append(c)
        seen, clean = set(), []
        for t in tokens:
            if t.lower() not in seen:
                seen.add(t.lower())
                clean.append(t)
        return ", ".join(clean)

    @classmethod
    def parse_json_file(cls, filepath: Union[str, Path]) -> Optional[CharacterCard]:
        filepath = Path(filepath)
        try:
            with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            return cls.parse_dict(data, source_path=str(filepath.resolve()))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[TavernParser] Ошибка парсинга JSON '{filepath}': {e}")
            return None

    @classmethod
    def parse_image_file(cls, filepath: Union[str, Path]) -> Optional[CharacterCard]:
        filepath = Path(filepath)
        try:
            from PIL import Image
            with Image.open(filepath) as img:
                meta = getattr(img, "text", {}) or {}
                raw_meta = meta.get("chara") or meta.get("ccv3")
                if not raw_meta and hasattr(img, "info"):
                    raw_meta = img.info.get("chara") or img.info.get("ccv3")
                if not raw_meta:
                    logger.error(f"[TavernParser] Метаданные персонажа ('chara') не найдены в изображении: {filepath.name}")
                    return None
                if isinstance(raw_meta, bytes):
                    raw_meta = raw_meta.decode("utf-8")
                try:
                    decoded_json = base64.b64decode(raw_meta).decode("utf-8")
                    data = json.loads(decoded_json)
                except Exception:
                    data = json.loads(raw_meta)
            avatar_path = str(filepath.resolve())
            return cls.parse_dict(data, avatar_path=avatar_path, source_path=str(filepath.resolve()))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[TavernParser] Ошибка чтения изображения карточки персонажа '{filepath}': {e}")
            return None

    @classmethod
    def parse_file(cls, filepath: Union[str, Path]) -> Optional[CharacterCard]:
        filepath = Path(filepath)
        if not filepath.exists():
            logger.error(f"[TavernParser] Файл карточки не найден: {filepath}")
            return None

        resolved_path = str(filepath.resolve())
        logger.info(f"[TavernParser] Чтение карточки персонажа: '{resolved_path}'")
        suffix = filepath.suffix.lower()
        if suffix == ".json":
            return cls.parse_json_file(filepath)
        elif suffix in [".png", ".webp"]:
            return cls.parse_image_file(filepath)
        else:
            logger.warning(f"[TavernParser] Неподдерживаемый формат карточки: {suffix}")
            return None

    @classmethod
    def parse_dict(
        cls,
        data: Dict[str, Any],
        source_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
        avatar_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
    ) -> CharacterCard:
        """Extracts character metadata across V1, V2, Chub, and Pygmalion schemas."""
        src_path = Path(source_path) if source_path else None
        raw_data = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}

        # 1. Многоуровневый поиск целевого словаря (Каскад):
        # Разворачиваем возможные обёртки Chub / Venus / V2
        target = raw_data
        candidate_dicts = [raw_data]
        if isinstance(target.get("data"), dict):
            target = target["data"]
            candidate_dicts.append(target)
        if isinstance(target.get("character"), dict):
            target = target["character"]
            candidate_dicts.append(target)
        elif isinstance(target.get("definition"), dict):
            target = target["definition"]
            candidate_dicts.append(target)

        # Поддержка вложенного definition внутри character (формат Chub API)
        if isinstance(target.get("definition"), dict) and target["definition"] not in candidate_dicts:
            target = target["definition"]
            candidate_dicts.append(target)

        # Вспомогательный поиск с фоллбэком на промежуточные узлы и корень raw_data
        def get_field(*keys, default=""):
            for key in keys:
                # Сначала ищем в распакованном target
                if isinstance(target, dict):
                    val = target.get(key)
                    if val and isinstance(val, str) and val.strip():
                        return val.strip()
                # Проверяем промежуточные словари каскада (от глубоких к корню)
                for d in reversed(candidate_dicts):
                    if isinstance(d, dict):
                        v = d.get(key)
                        if v and isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
                            return v.strip()
                # Если не нашли, проверяем корень raw_data
                if isinstance(raw_data, dict):
                    val_root = raw_data.get(key)
                    if val_root and isinstance(val_root, str) and val_root.strip():
                        return val_root.strip()
            return default

        def get_list_field(*keys):
            for key in keys:
                if isinstance(target, dict):
                    v = target.get(key)
                    if isinstance(v, list) and v:
                        return list(v)
                for d in reversed(candidate_dicts):
                    if isinstance(d, dict):
                        v = d.get(key)
                        if isinstance(v, list) and v:
                            return list(v)
                if isinstance(raw_data, dict):
                    v = raw_data.get(key)
                    if isinstance(v, list) and v:
                        return list(v)
            return []

        # Companions extraction (data.extensions.neonroute.companions or target.extensions...)
        ext_comps = None
        for d in (target, *reversed(candidate_dicts), raw_data):
            if isinstance(d, dict) and isinstance(d.get("extensions"), dict):
                ext_comps = d.get("extensions", {}).get("neonroute", {}).get("companions")
                if ext_comps:
                    break
        if not ext_comps:
            for d in (target, *reversed(candidate_dicts), raw_data):
                if isinstance(d, dict) and isinstance(d.get("companions"), list) and d.get("companions"):
                    ext_comps = d.get("companions")
                    break
        if not isinstance(ext_comps, list):
            ext_comps = []

        # Group Card Detection
        raw_card_tags = get_list_field("tags")
        tags = [str(t).lower() for t in raw_card_tags]
        group_keywords = {"multiple characters", "duo", "group", "party", "trio", "twins", "группа", "дуэт"}
        is_group = (
            bool(group_keywords.intersection(tags))
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and (d.get("group_only") is True or d.get("is_group") is True) for d in candidate_dicts)
            or (len(ext_comps) > 1)
        )

        # Standalone World Info / Lorebook Detection
        raw_entries = None
        for d in (target, *reversed(candidate_dicts), raw_data):
            if isinstance(d, dict) and "entries" in d:
                raw_entries = d.get("entries")
                break
        has_entries = isinstance(raw_entries, (dict, list)) and len(raw_entries) > 0
        has_char_identity = bool(
            get_field("first_mes", "greeting", "first_message", "char_greeting") or
            get_field("personality", "char_persona", "persona")
        )
        is_lorebook = has_entries and not has_char_identity

        if not is_lorebook and src_path:
            p_lower = src_path.stem.lower()
            if ("world_info" in p_lower or "lorebook" in p_lower) and (has_entries or not has_char_identity):
                is_lorebook = True

        if is_lorebook:
            is_group = False

        # Asset Parsing (CCv3 & Expression Packs)
        backgrounds = []
        expressions = {}
        assets = get_list_field("assets")
        for asset in assets:
            if isinstance(asset, dict):
                a_type = str(asset.get("type", "")).lower()
                a_uri = asset.get("uri") or asset.get("path")
                a_name = str(asset.get("name", "")).lower()
                if a_type in ("background", "scene", "bg") and a_uri:
                    backgrounds.append(str(a_uri))
                elif a_type in ("emotion", "expression", "sprite") and a_uri:
                    expressions[a_name] = str(a_uri)

        # Also check Chub alt_expressions
        alt_expr = None
        for d in (target, *reversed(candidate_dicts), raw_data):
            if isinstance(d, dict) and isinstance(d.get("alt_expressions"), dict):
                alt_expr = d.get("alt_expressions")
                break
        if isinstance(alt_expr, dict):
            for expr_name, expr_url in alt_expr.items():
                if expr_name not in expressions:
                    expressions[str(expr_name).lower()] = str(expr_url)

        # Имя персонажа
        raw_name = get_field("name", "char_name")
        name_lower = str(raw_name).lower()
        tags_set = set(tags)

        # DM / Game Master Detection (rpg removed to prevent false positives)
        dm_tags = {"dungeon master", "game master", "dm", "gm", "narrator", "storyteller", "ttrpg", "text adventure", "cyoa", "мастер игры", "гейммастер", "ведущий", "мастер подземелий"}
        dm_name_tokens = set(re.findall(r'\b[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ]+\b', name_lower))
        is_dm = (
            bool(dm_tags.intersection(tags_set))
            or bool({"dm", "gm", "storyteller", "narrator", "гейммастер", "ведущий"}.intersection(dm_name_tokens))
            or "dungeon master" in name_lower
            or "game master" in name_lower
            or "мастер игры" in name_lower
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("is_dm") is True for d in candidate_dicts)
        )

        # Scenario / Survival Simulator Detection
        scen_tags = {"scenario", "survival", "simulator", "симулятор", "выживание", "катастрофа", "апокалипсис"}
        is_scenario = (
            bool(scen_tags.intersection(tags_set))
            or "simulator" in name_lower
            or "симулятор" in name_lower
            or "survival" in name_lower
            or "выживание" in name_lower
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and (d.get("is_scenario") is True or d.get("is_simulator") is True) for d in candidate_dicts)
        )

        # LitRPG / Isekai / System Interface Detection
        sys_tags = {"litrpg", "system", "isekai", "литрпг", "система", "исекай", "status window", "battle song", "интерфейс системы"}
        is_system = (
            bool(sys_tags.intersection(tags_set))
            or "litrpg" in name_lower
            or "литрпг" in name_lower
            or "isekai" in name_lower
            or "исекай" in name_lower
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("is_system") is True for d in candidate_dicts)
        )

        # Dating Sim / Romance Progression Detection
        dating_tags = {"dating-sim", "dating sim", "romance", "yandere", "tsundere", "affection", "waifu", "love", "романтика", "дейт-сим"}
        is_dating = (
            bool(dating_tags.intersection(tags_set))
            or "dating sim" in name_lower
            or "dating-sim" in name_lower
            or "дейт-сим" in name_lower
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("is_dating") is True for d in candidate_dicts)
        )

        # Psychological Horror / Sanity Detection
        horror_tags = {"horror", "psychological horror", "cosmic horror", "lovecraft", "sanity", "хоррор", "ужасы", "безумие"}
        is_horror = (
            bool(horror_tags.intersection(tags_set))
            or "horror" in name_lower
            or "хоррор" in name_lower
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("is_horror") is True for d in candidate_dicts)
        )

        # CYOA / Visual Novel Detection
        cyoa_tags = {"cyoa", "choose your own adventure", "visual novel", "interactive fiction", "текстовый квест", "новелла"}
        is_cyoa = (
            bool(cyoa_tags.intersection(tags_set))
            or "cyoa" in name_lower
            or "visual novel" in name_lower
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("is_cyoa") is True for d in candidate_dicts)
        )

        # Reverse Roleplay / Interrogation / Mentorship Detection
        reverse_tags = {"reverse roleplay", "interrogation", "captive", "prisoner", "submissive", "student", "допрос", "пленник", "ученик", "подсудимый"}
        is_reverse_rp = (
            bool(reverse_tags.intersection(tags_set))
            or "interrogation" in name_lower
            or "допрос" in name_lower
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("is_reverse_rp") is True for d in candidate_dicts)
        )

        # Detective / Investigation Detection
        detective_tags = {"detective", "investigation", "mystery", "crime", "courtroom", "детектив", "расследование", "улики"}
        is_detective = (
            bool(detective_tags.intersection(tags_set))
            or "detective" in name_lower
            or "детектив" in name_lower
            or any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("is_detective") is True for d in candidate_dicts)
        )

        if is_lorebook:
            is_group = False
            is_dm = False
            is_scenario = False
            is_system = False
            is_dating = False
            is_horror = False
            is_cyoa = False
            is_reverse_rp = False
            is_detective = False

        if raw_name:
            name = raw_name
        elif src_path and src_path.stem.lower() not in ("exported", "character_exported", "card", "exported.json", "character"):
            name = src_path.stem.replace("_", " ").title()
        else:
            name = "Персонаж"

        # Извлечение основных атрибутов через get_field с алиасами (макросы {{char}}, {{user}}, <START> не модифицируются)
        description = get_field("description", "char_persona", "persona")
        personality = get_field("personality", "char_persona", "persona")
        scenario = get_field("scenario", "world_scenario", "situation", "context")
        first_mes = get_field("first_mes", "greeting", "first_message", "char_greeting", "initial_message")
        mes_example = get_field("mes_example", "example_dialogue", "examples", "mes_examples")
        system_prompt = get_field("system_prompt", "post_history_instructions")
        post_history_instructions = get_field("post_history_instructions")

        # RU локализации
        first_mes_ru = get_field("first_mes_ru")
        description_ru = get_field("description_ru")
        personality_ru = get_field("personality_ru")
        scenario_ru = get_field("scenario_ru")
        mes_example_ru = get_field("mes_example_ru")

        # Заметки
        creator_notes = get_field("creator_notes", "creatorcomment")
        card_tags = list(tags)

        # Альтернативные приветствия
        alternate_greetings = get_list_field("alternate_greetings", "alt_greetings")
        alternate_greetings_ru = get_list_field("alternate_greetings_ru")

        if not first_mes and alternate_greetings:
            first_mes = str(alternate_greetings[0] or "").strip()

        depth_prompt = (
            get_field("depth_prompt")
            or (target.get("extensions") or {}).get("depth_prompt", {}).get("prompt", "")
            or (data.get("extensions") or {}).get("depth_prompt", {}).get("prompt", "")
            or get_field("character_note")
            or ""
        )

        if not avatar_path and src_path:
            parent_dir = src_path.parent
            safe_clean_name = "".join(c for c in name if c.isalnum() or c in (' ', '_', '-')).strip()
            candidate_stems = [
                src_path.stem, name, safe_clean_name,
                f"{safe_clean_name}_avatar", f"{src_path.stem}_avatar"
            ]
            for stem in candidate_stems:
                if not stem:
                    continue
                for ext in [".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".PNG", ".JPG", ".JPEG", ".WEBP"]:
                    candidate = parent_dir / f"{stem}{ext}"
                    if candidate.exists() and candidate.is_file():
                        avatar_path = candidate
                        break
                if avatar_path:
                    break

        if not avatar_path:
            avatar_b64 = None
            for d in (target, *reversed(candidate_dicts), raw_data):
                if isinstance(d, dict):
                    b = d.get("avatar") or d.get("image")
                    if b and isinstance(b, str) and len(b) > 100:
                        avatar_b64 = b
                        break
            if avatar_b64 and isinstance(avatar_b64, str) and len(avatar_b64) > 100:
                try:
                    if "," in avatar_b64:
                        avatar_b64 = avatar_b64.split(",", 1)[1]
                    img_data = base64.b64decode(avatar_b64)
                    CHARACTERS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    safe_name = "".join(c for c in name if c.isalnum() or c in (' ', '_', '-')).strip() or "character"
                    extracted_path = CHARACTERS_DIR / f"{safe_name}_avatar.png"
                    with open(extracted_path, "wb") as f_img:
                        f_img.write(img_data)
                    avatar_path = extracted_path
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Could not extract embedded avatar: {e}")

        created_at = (
            get_field("created_at", "create_date")
            or datetime.now().isoformat()
        )

        # Full Ingestion of Embedded Lorebook (character_book / world_info / lorebook)
        entries = cls.extract_lore_entries(data)

        # Сохранение исходной структуры character_book / lorebook
        raw_char_book = None
        for d in (target, *reversed(candidate_dicts), raw_data):
            if isinstance(d, dict):
                for k in ("character_book", "lorebook", "world_info"):
                    b = d.get(k)
                    if isinstance(b, dict) and b:
                        raw_char_book = b
                        break
            if raw_char_book:
                break

        extra_rpg_blocks = []
        rpg_keys = (
            'character_creation', 'core_mechanics', 'system_info', 'rules', 'dm_role',
            'mechanics', 'reputation_system', 'classes', 'races', 'skills', 'archetypes',
            'inventory_system', 'spells', 'threat_levels', 'progression'
        )
        for key in rpg_keys:
            val = None
            for d in (target, *reversed(candidate_dicts), raw_data):
                if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get(key):
                    val = d.get(key)
                    break
            if val and isinstance(val, (dict, list)):
                extra_rpg_blocks.append(f"\n### ПРАВИЛА И МЕХАНИКА [{key.upper()}]:\n" + json.dumps(val, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

        rpg_mechanics_str = "\n".join(extra_rpg_blocks).strip() if extra_rpg_blocks else ""
        if extra_rpg_blocks:
            scenario = (scenario or "") + "\n" + "\n".join(extra_rpg_blocks)

        visual_dna = get_field("visual_dna")
        if not visual_dna:
            visual_dna = TavernParser.extract_physical_dna_regex(description)

        scenery_dna = get_field("scenery_dna")
        if not scenery_dna:
            scenery_dna = TavernParser.extract_scenery_dna_regex(scenario or description)

        if is_lorebook and not description:
            entries_cnt = len(entries) if entries else (len(raw_entries) if isinstance(raw_entries, (dict, list)) else 0)
            description = (
                f"Модуль правил и энциклопедия мира (Лорбук).\n"
                f"Содержит {entries_cnt} статей/записей.\n\n"
                f"Подключается к активным диалогам через окно «📜 Правила мира и Лор»."
            )

        resolved_source_path = str(src_path.resolve()) if src_path else (str(source_path) if source_path else None)
        avatar_path_val = str(avatar_path.resolve()) if isinstance(avatar_path, Path) else (str(avatar_path) if avatar_path else None)

        card = CharacterCard(
            name=name,
            description=description,
            personality=personality,
            scenario=scenario,
            first_mes=first_mes,
            first_mes_ru=first_mes_ru,
            description_ru=description_ru,
            personality_ru=personality_ru,
            scenario_ru=scenario_ru,
            mes_example_ru=mes_example_ru,
            mes_example=mes_example,
            creator_notes=creator_notes,
            tags=card_tags,
            alternate_greetings=alternate_greetings,
            alternate_greetings_ru=alternate_greetings_ru,
            avatar_path=avatar_path_val,
            raw_data=data,
            created_at=created_at,
            source_path=resolved_source_path,
            visual_dna=visual_dna,
            scenery_dna=scenery_dna,
            system_prompt=system_prompt,
            post_history_instructions=post_history_instructions,
            depth_prompt=depth_prompt,
            rpg_mechanics_block=rpg_mechanics_str,
            is_group=is_group,
            is_lorebook=is_lorebook,
            is_dm=is_dm,
            is_scenario=is_scenario,
            is_system=is_system,
            is_dating=is_dating,
            is_horror=is_horror,
            is_cyoa=is_cyoa,
            is_reverse_rp=is_reverse_rp,
            is_detective=is_detective,
            backgrounds=backgrounds,
            expressions=expressions,
            lore_entries=entries,
            companions=ext_comps,
            character_book=raw_char_book
        )

        from services.minor_safety import MinorSafetyDetector

        # Определение статуса для основной карточки
        full_text = f"{card.name} {card.description} {card.personality} {card.scenario}"
        card.is_minor = MinorSafetyDetector.is_minor(full_text)

        # Определение статуса для каждого спутника в companions
        if card.companions:
            for comp in card.companions:
                if isinstance(comp, dict):
                    c_text = f"{comp.get('name', '')} {comp.get('description', '')} {comp.get('visual_dna', '')} {comp.get('facts', '')}"
                    comp["is_minor"] = MinorSafetyDetector.is_minor(c_text)
                    if comp.get("is_minor"):
                        card.is_minor = True

        return card

    @staticmethod
    def save_card_companions(card: CharacterCard, json_path: Union[Path, str]) -> bool:
        """Сохраняет сопартийцев карточки по стандарту Tavern в data -> extensions -> neonroute -> companions."""
        try:
            p = Path(json_path)
            if not p.exists():
                logger.warning(f"[TavernParser] Файл карточки для сохранения спутников не найден: {p}")
                return False
            with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)

            target = data.get("data") if ("spec" in data or "data" in data) and isinstance(data.get("data"), dict) else data

            if "extensions" not in target or not isinstance(target["extensions"], dict):
                target["extensions"] = {}
            if "neonroute" not in target["extensions"] or not isinstance(target["extensions"]["neonroute"], dict):
                target["extensions"]["neonroute"] = {}

            target["extensions"]["neonroute"]["companions"] = getattr(card, "companions", [])

            from utils.file_utils import atomic_write_json
            if not atomic_write_json(p, data):
                return False

            if hasattr(card, "raw_data") and isinstance(card.raw_data, dict):
                card.raw_data = data
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[TavernParser] Ошибка сохранения сопартийцев в '{json_path}': {e}")
            return False

    @staticmethod
    def save_card_scenery_dna(card: CharacterCard, json_path: Union[Path, str]) -> bool:
        """Сохраняет card.scenery_dna в JSON файл карточки на диске."""
        try:
            p = Path(json_path)
            if not p.exists():
                return False
            with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            target = data.get("data", data) if ("spec" in data or "data" in data) else data
            target["scenery_dna"] = getattr(card, "scenery_dna", "")
            if "scenery_dna" in data and data is not target:
                data["scenery_dna"] = getattr(card, "scenery_dna", "")
            from utils.file_utils import atomic_write_json
            return atomic_write_json(p, data)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Could not persist scenery_dna to {json_path}: {e}")
            return False

    @staticmethod
    def _save_card_visual_dna(card: CharacterCard, json_path: Union[Path, str]) -> bool:

            with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            target = data.get("data", data) if ("spec" in data or "data" in data) else data
            target["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
            if "visual_dna" in data and data is not target:
                data["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
            from utils.file_utils import atomic_write_json

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Could not persist visual_dna to {json_path}: {e}")

    save_card_visual_dna = _save_card_visual_dna

    @staticmethod
    def save_card_translations(card: CharacterCard, file_path: Optional[Path | str] = None) -> bool:
        if file_path:
            p = Path(file_path)
        elif getattr(card, "source_path", None):
            src_p = Path(card.source_path)
            p = src_p if src_p.suffix.lower() == ".json" else (CHARACTERS_DIR / f"{src_p.stem}.json")
        else:
            safe_name = "".join(c for c in card.name if c.isalnum() or c in (' ', '_', '-')).strip() or "character"
            p = CHARACTERS_DIR / f"{safe_name}.json"

        try:
            data = dict(card.raw_data) if isinstance(card.raw_data, dict) and card.raw_data else {}
            if not data and p.exists():
                try:
                    with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        data = json.load(f)
                except Exception:
                    data = {}

            if not data or not any(k in data for k in ("name", "data")):
                data = {
                    "spec": "chara_card_v2",
                    "spec_version": "2.0",
                    "data": {
                        "name": card.name,
                        "description": card.description,
                        "personality": card.personality,
                        "scenario": card.scenario,
                        "first_mes": card.first_mes,
                        "mes_example": card.mes_example,
                        "system_prompt": card.system_prompt,
                        "post_history_instructions": getattr(card, "post_history_instructions", ""),
                        "scenery_dna": getattr(card, "scenery_dna", "")
                    }
                }
            target = data.get("data", data) if ("spec" in data or "data" in data) else data
            target["description_ru"] = card.description_ru
            target["personality_ru"] = card.personality_ru
            target["scenario_ru"] = card.scenario_ru
            target["mes_example_ru"] = card.mes_example_ru
            target["first_mes_ru"] = card.first_mes_ru
            target["alternate_greetings_ru"] = card.alternate_greetings_ru or []
            target["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
            target["scenery_dna"] = getattr(card, "scenery_dna", "")
            if "scenery_dna" in data and data is not target:
                data["scenery_dna"] = getattr(card, "scenery_dna", "")
            if getattr(card, "companions", None):
                if "extensions" not in target or not isinstance(target["extensions"], dict):
                    target["extensions"] = {}
                if "neonroute" not in target["extensions"] or not isinstance(target["extensions"]["neonroute"], dict):
                    target["extensions"]["neonroute"] = {}
                target["extensions"]["neonroute"]["companions"] = list(card.companions)

            from utils.file_utils import atomic_write_json
            ok = atomic_write_json(p, data)
            if ok:
                card.source_path = str(p.resolve())
                card.raw_data = data
            return ok
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to save card translations: {e}")
        return False


save_card_companions = TavernParser.save_card_companions
save_card_scenery_dna = TavernParser.save_card_scenery_dna

"""
Token Budget Manager for NeonRoute.
Provides token estimation and traffic light styling for character cards and lorebooks.
"""

import re
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Tuple, Optional


class TokenBudgetManager:
    """Manages token estimation and traffic light thresholds for character cards and lorebooks."""

    @staticmethod
    def estimate_text_tokens(text: str) -> int:
        """
        Estimates token count for arbitrary text.
        Cyrillic: ~2.0 chars/token, Latin/other: ~3.3 chars/token.
        Includes 12% safety margin for fragmentation and punctuation.
        """
        if not text:
            return 0
        
        # Подсчет кириллицы и латиницы/спецсимволов
        cyrillic = sum(1 for c in text if '\u0400' <= c <= '\u04FF')
        other = len(text) - cyrillic
        
        # Реалистичные коэффициенты для Qwen/Llama BPE:
        # Кириллица: ~2.0 символа на токен
        # Латиница/Спецсимволы/Синтаксис: ~3.3 символа на токен
        raw_tokens = (cyrillic / 2.0) + (other / 3.3)
        
        # Буфер безопасности 12% на фрагментацию редких слов и пунктуацию
        return int(raw_tokens * 1.12) + 2

    @classmethod
    def estimate_message_tokens(cls, message: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        """
        Estimates token count for a single message dictionary {"role": ..., "content": ...}.
        Adds 5 service tokens for dialogue format tags (<|im_start|>role ... <|im_end|>).
        """
        if not isinstance(message, dict) or not message:
            return 0
        content = message.get("content", "")
        if content is None:
            content = ""
        if isinstance(content, list):
            text_parts = [str(p.get("text", "")) for p in content if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type") == "text"]
            # 800 токенов на изображение + 5 токенов на служебные теги диалогового формата
            return cls.estimate_text_tokens(" ".join(text_parts)) + 800 + 5
        if not isinstance(content, str):
            return 0
        # 5 токенов на служебные теги диалогового формата (<|im_start|>role ... <|im_end|>)
        return cls.estimate_text_tokens(content) + 5

    @classmethod
    def estimate_card_budget(
        cls,
        card_fields: Dict[str, Any],
        lore_texts: Optional[List[str]] = None
    ) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """
        Estimates base card tokens and lore tokens.
        Returns (base_tokens, lore_tokens).
        """
        if isinstance(card_fields, dict):
            base_parts = [str(v) for v in card_fields.values() if v]
        elif isinstance(card_fields, (list, tuple)):
            base_parts = [str(v) for v in card_fields if v]
        else:
            base_parts = [str(card_fields or "")]

        base_text = " ".join(base_parts)
        base_tokens = cls.estimate_text_tokens(base_text)

        lore_tokens = 0
        if lore_texts:
            lore_text = " ".join(str(t) for t in lore_texts if t)
            lore_tokens = cls.estimate_text_tokens(lore_text)

        return base_tokens, lore_tokens

    @staticmethod
    def get_traffic_light(
        effective_tokens: int,
        is_lorebook: bool = False,
        entry_count: int = 0
    ) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """
        Returns traffic light style and status dictionary:
        {"color": str, "border": str, "badge": str, "status": str}
        Thresholds:
        - <= 2300: 🟢 (#00FF66, "rgba(0, 255, 102, 0.3)")
        - <= 4500: 🟡 (#FFE600, "rgba(255, 230, 0, 0.4)")
        - < 7000:  🟡 (#F59E0B, "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4)")
        - >= 7000: 🔴 (#FF007F, "rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.5)")
        """
        if effective_tokens <= 2300:
            color = "#00FF66"
            border = "rgba(0, 255, 102, 0.3)"
            badge = "🟢"
            if is_lorebook:
                status = f"🟢 Оптимальный объем лорбука: ~{effective_tokens} токенов ({entry_count} статей)"
            else:
                status = f"🟢 Оптимальный объем: ~{effective_tokens} токенов"
        elif effective_tokens <= 4500:
            color = "#FFE600"
            border = "rgba(255, 230, 0, 0.4)"
            badge = "🟡"
            if is_lorebook:
                status = f"🟡 Умеренный лорбук: ~{effective_tokens} токенов ({entry_count} статей)"
            else:
                status = f"🟡 Умеренный объем: ~{effective_tokens} токенов"
        elif effective_tokens < 7000:
            color = "#F59E0B"
            border = "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4)"
            badge = "🟡"
            if is_lorebook:
                status = f"🟡 Плотный лорбук: ~{effective_tokens} токенов ({entry_count} статей)"
            else:
                status = f"🟡 Плотный лор: ~{effective_tokens} токенов"
        else:
            color = "#FF007F"
            border = "rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.5)"
            badge = "🔴"
            if is_lorebook:
                status = f"🔴 Объемный лорбук: ~{effective_tokens} токенов ({entry_count} статей, 7000+)"
            else:
                status = f"🔴 Объемный лор: ~{effective_tokens} токенов (7000+)"

        return {
            "color": color,
            "border": border,
            "badge": badge,
            "status": status
        }


================================================================================

"""
Tool Engine for Mini-Antigravity in NeonRoute
Parses, dispatches, and executes autonomous tools inside Sandbox Workspace (C:\\NeonRoute\\workspace)
and Read-Only System Storage.
"""

import os
import re
import sys
import time
import shutil
import logging
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, Tuple

from services.sandbox_manager import SandboxManager, ScriptExecutionResult
from services.code_engine import ASTSkeletonizer, PatchApplier, SelfHealingEngine
from services.tool_parser import ToolCall, ToolResult, ToolParser
from config import OUTPUTS_DIR

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.ToolEngine")

__all__ = ["ToolEngine", "ToolCall", "ToolResult", "ToolParser"]


class ToolEngine:
    """
    Dispatcher and execution engine for Mini-Antigravity tools.
    Strictly isolated to C:\\NeonRoute\\workspace for writes/scripts.
    """

    @classmethod
    def set_active_session_id(cls, session_id: Optional[str]) -> None:
        SandboxManager.set_active_session_id(session_id)

    @classmethod
    def get_active_session_id(cls) -> Optional[str]:
        return SandboxManager.get_active_session_id()

    @classmethod
    def write_file(cls, filename: str, content: str) -> ToolResult:
        try:
            # Дешёвый in-memory AST-чекер перед записью на диск и запуском песочницы
            clean_name = SandboxManager.clean_workspace_filename(filename)
            if clean_name.lower().endswith((".py", ".pyw")):
                from services.code_engine import ExecutionSandbox
                is_valid, lint_msg = ExecutionSandbox.preflight_lint(content)
                if not is_valid:
                    err_msg = f"[Ошибка синтаксиса до записи]: {lint_msg}"
                    logger.warning(f"ToolEngine: {err_msg} в {clean_name}")
                    return ToolResult(
                        tool_name="write_file",
                        success=False,
                        output=err_msg,
                        stderr=err_msg,
                        exit_code=1
                    )

            msg = SandboxManager.write_file(filename, content)
            is_err = msg.startswith("Ошибка:") or msg.startswith("[Ошибка")
            target_path = (SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir() / clean_name).resolve()
            if is_err:
                logger.warning(msg)
            else:
                logger.info(msg)
            return ToolResult(
                tool_name="write_file",
                success=not is_err,
                output=msg,
                artifact_path=target_path
            )
        except Exception as e:
            err_msg = f"Ошибка записи файла: {e}"
            logger.error(err_msg)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="write_file", success=False, output=err_msg)

    @classmethod
    def run_script(cls, filename: str) -> ToolResult:
        """Делегирует исполнение в изолированный SandboxManager."""
        res = SandboxManager.run_script(filename)
        return ToolResult(
            tool_name="run_script",
            success=res.success,
            output=res.output,
            artifact_path=res.artifact_path,
            is_script_run=True,
            stdout=res.stdout,
            stderr=res.stderr,
            exit_code=res.return_code
        )

    @classmethod
    def find_files(
        cls,
        query: str = "",
        ext: Optional[str] = None,
        search_root: Optional[str] = None,
        content_query: Optional[str] = None,
        **kwargs
    ) -> ToolResult:
        try:
            q_lower = query.strip().lower() if query else ""
            c_lower = content_query.strip().lower() if content_query else ""
            target_ext = f".{ext.lstrip('.').lower()}" if ext else None

            matches: List[Path] = []
            seen_paths = set()
            MAX_CONTENT_FILE_SIZE = 15 * 1024 * 1024

            def match_content(p_file: Path) -> bool:
                if not c_lower:
                    return True
                if p_file.name.startswith("~$") or p_file.name.startswith("."):
                    return False

                try:
                    f_size = p_file.stat().st_size
                    if f_size > MAX_CONTENT_FILE_SIZE or f_size == 0:
                        return False
                except Exception:
                    return False

                f_suffix = p_file.suffix.lower()
                c_clean = " ".join(c_lower.split())

                zip_office_exts = {".docx", ".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".pptx", ".odt", ".ods"}
                if f_suffix in zip_office_exts:
                    try:
                        import zipfile
                        import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
                        with zipfile.ZipFile(p_file) as z:
                            xml_parts = [n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith(".xml")]
                            full_chunks = []
                            for part in xml_parts:
                                try:
                                    xml_bytes = z.read(part)
                                    tree = ET.fromstring(xml_bytes)
                                    text_nodes = [elem.text for elem in tree.iter() if elem.text]
                                    if text_nodes:
                                        full_chunks.append(" ".join(text_nodes))
                                except Exception:
                                    continue

                            combined = " ".join(" ".join(full_chunks).lower().split())
                            if c_clean in combined:
                                return True
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    return False

                if f_suffix in {".doc", ".xls", ".ppt", ".rtf"}:
                    try:
                        raw_bytes = p_file.read_bytes()
                        for enc in ("cp1251", "utf-16le", "utf-8"):
                            try:
                                dec_text = raw_bytes.decode(enc, errors="ignore").lower()
                                dec_text = " ".join(dec_text.split())
                                if c_clean in dec_text:
                                    return True
                            except Exception:
                                continue
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    return False

                code_exts = {
                    ".py", ".pyw", ".ipynb", ".json", ".csv", ".tsv", ".txt", ".md",
                    ".sql", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".ini", ".cfg", ".conf", ".log",
                    ".html", ".htm", ".xml", ".css", ".scss", ".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx",
                    ".bat", ".cmd", ".ps1", ".sh", ".bash", ".zsh",
                    ".c", ".cpp", ".cc", ".cxx", ".h", ".hpp", ".cs", ".rs", ".go", ".java", ".kt"
                }

                if f_suffix in code_exts or f_suffix == "" or len(f_suffix) <= 5:
                    for enc in ("utf-8", "cp1251", "latin-1", "utf-16"):
                        try:
                            with open(p_file, "r", encoding=enc, errors="ignore") as f:
                                sample = f.read(5 * 1024 * 1024).lower()
                                sample = " ".join(sample.split())
                                if c_clean in sample:
                                    return True
                            break
                        except Exception:
                            continue

                return False

            def check_file(p_file: Path):
                if p_file in seen_paths or p_file.name.startswith("~$"):
                    return
                f_name = p_file.name.lower()
                matches_query = not q_lower or (q_lower in f_name)
                matches_ext = not target_ext or p_file.suffix.lower() == target_ext
                if matches_query and matches_ext and match_content(p_file):
                    seen_paths.add(p_file)
                    matches.append(p_file)

            user_home = Path.home()
            target_roots: List[Path] = []

            if search_root:
                sr_norm = str(search_root).strip().lower()
                if sr_norm in ("documents", "документы", "docs", "~/documents"):
                    target_roots.append(user_home / "Documents")
                elif sr_norm in ("desktop", "рабочий стол", "~/desktop"):
                    target_roots.append(user_home / "Desktop")
                elif sr_norm in ("downloads", "загрузки", "~/downloads"):
                    target_roots.append(user_home / "Downloads")
                elif sr_norm in ("workspace", "песочница"):
                    target_roots.append(SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir())
                else:
                    r_cand = Path(search_root).resolve()
                    if r_cand.exists():
                        target_roots.append(r_cand)

            if not target_roots:
                active_sid = SandboxManager.get_active_session_id()
                sess_dir = (OUTPUTS_DIR / "sessions" / active_sid).resolve() if active_sid else None
                target_roots = [
                    user_home / "Documents",
                    SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir(),
                    user_home / "Downloads",
                    user_home / "Desktop"
                ]
                if sess_dir and sess_dir.exists():
                    target_roots.insert(1, sess_dir)

            for p_dir in target_roots:
                if not p_dir.exists():
                    continue
                try:
                    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(str(p_dir)):
                        try:
                            rel_depth = len(Path(root).relative_to(p_dir).parts)
                            if rel_depth >= 3:
                                dirs.clear()
                        except ValueError:
                            pass

                        ignored_custom = {
                            "neonroute", ".git", "venv", ".venv", "__pycache__",
                            "history", "logs", "node_modules", "appdata", "site-packages"
                        }
                        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not SandboxManager.is_ignored_directory(d) and d.lower() not in ignored_custom]

                        for f in files:
                            check_file(Path(root) / f)
                            if len(matches) >= 50:
                                break
                        if len(matches) >= 50:
                            break
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Error scanning dir {p_dir}: {e}")
                if len(matches) >= 50:
                    break

            if not matches:
                desc = []
                if query:
                    desc.append(f"по имени '{query}'")
                if content_query:
                    desc.append(f"с содержимым '{content_query}'")
                desc_str = " ".join(desc) if desc else "по заданным критериям"
                res_text = f"Файлы {desc_str} не найдены."
                return ToolResult(tool_name="find_files", success=True, output=res_text)

            nl = chr(10)
            lines = [f"Найдено совпадений: {len(matches)}"]
            for m_path in matches:
                lines.append(f"- {m_path}")

            return ToolResult(tool_name="find_files", success=True, output=nl.join(lines))
        except Exception as e:
            err = f"Ошибка поиска файлов: {e}"
            logger.error(err)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="find_files", success=False, output=err)

    @classmethod
    def read_file(
        cls,
        filename: str,
        start_line: int = 1,
        max_lines: int = 100,
        session_id: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> ToolResult:
        try:
            target_path = SandboxManager.validate_read_file_path(filename, session_id=session_id)
            content = None
            for enc in ("utf-8", "cp1251", "utf-8-sig"):
                try:
                    with open(target_path, "r", encoding=enc) as f:
                        content = f.read()
                    break
                except (UnicodeDecodeError, LookupError):
                    continue

            if content is None:
                with open(target_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                    content = f.read()

            all_lines = content.splitlines()
            total_lines = len(all_lines)

            start_l = max(1, int(start_line)) if str(start_line).isdigit() else 1
            max_l = max(1, min(int(max_lines), 500)) if str(max_lines).isdigit() else 100

            if total_lines == 0:
                output = "[строки 0-0 из 0]:\n(файл пуст)"
            elif start_l > total_lines:
                output = f"[строки {start_l}-{start_l} из {total_lines}]:\n(начальная строка выходит за пределы файла)"
            else:
                slice_lines = all_lines[start_l - 1 : start_l - 1 + max_l]
                end_l = start_l + len(slice_lines) - 1
                formatted_lines = [
                    f"{start_l + i:04d} | {line}"
                    for i, line in enumerate(slice_lines)
                ]
                header = f"[строки {start_l}-{end_l} из {total_lines}]:"
                output = f"{header}\n" + "\n".join(formatted_lines)

            return ToolResult(
                tool_name="read_file",
                success=True,
                output=output,
                artifact_path=target_path
            )
        except (PermissionError, FileNotFoundError, IsADirectoryError, ValueError) as e:
            return ToolResult(tool_name="read_file", success=False, output=str(e))
        except Exception as e:
            err = f"Ошибка чтения файла: {e}"
            logger.error(err)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="read_file", success=False, output=err)

    @classmethod
    def read_document(cls, path: str, max_chars: int = 3000) -> ToolResult:
        try:
            target_path = SandboxManager.validate_read_path(path)
            if not target_path.is_file():
                return ToolResult(tool_name="read_document", success=False, output=f"Путь не является файлом: {target_path}")

            readable_exts = {
                ".txt", ".py", ".json", ".csv", ".md", ".log",
                ".yaml", ".yml", ".ini", ".toml", ".js", ".html",
                ".css", ".xml", ".bat", ".cmd", ".sql", ".sh",
                ".docx", ".xlsx"
            }
            if target_path.suffix.lower() not in readable_exts:
                return ToolResult(
                    tool_name="read_document",
                    success=False,
                    output=f"Файл {target_path.name} не является поддерживаемым текстовым документом ({target_path.suffix})."
                )

            content = None
            ext = target_path.suffix.lower()
            if ext == ".docx":
                try:
                    import docx
                    doc = docx.Document(target_path)
                    paras = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs if p.text.strip()]
                    content = "\n\n".join(paras)
                except Exception as e:
                    return ToolResult(tool_name="read_document", success=False, output=f"Ошибка чтения .docx документа: {e}")
            elif ext == ".xlsx":
                try:
                    import openpyxl
                    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(target_path, data_only=True)
                    try:
                        sheets_text = []
                        for sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
                            sheet = wb[sheet_name]
                            sheets_text.append(f"--- Лист: {sheet_name} ---")
                            for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True):
                                if any(cell is not None for cell in row):
                                    row_str = " | ".join(str(cell) if cell is not None else "" for cell in row)
                                    sheets_text.append(row_str)
                        content = "\n".join(sheets_text)
                    finally:
                        wb.close()
                except Exception as e:
                    return ToolResult(tool_name="read_document", success=False, output=f"Ошибка чтения .xlsx таблицы: {e}")
            else:
                for enc in ("utf-8", "cp1251", "latin-1"):
                    try:
                        with open(target_path, "r", encoding=enc) as f:
                            content = f.read()
                        break
                    except UnicodeDecodeError:
                        continue

            if content is None:
                return ToolResult(tool_name="read_document", success=False, output=f"Не удалось декодировать текстовый файл: {target_path.name}")

            total_len = len(content)
            if total_len > max_chars:
                displayed = content[:max_chars]
                output = f"{displayed}\n\n[Обрезано: показано {max_chars} из {total_len} символов...]"
            else:
                output = content

            return ToolResult(
                tool_name="read_document",
                success=True,
                output=output,
                artifact_path=target_path
            )
        except Exception as e:
            err = f"Ошибка чтения документа: {e}"
            logger.error(err)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="read_document", success=False, output=err)

    @classmethod
    def open_explorer(cls, path: str) -> ToolResult:
        try:
            target = SandboxManager.validate_read_path(path)
            norm = os.path.normpath(str(target))

            if sys.platform == "win32":
                import ctypes
                if target.is_file():
                    ctypes.windll.shell32.ShellExecuteW(None, "open", "explorer.exe", f'/select,"{norm}"', None, 1)
                else:
                    ctypes.windll.shell32.ShellExecuteW(None, "open", norm, None, None, 1)
            else:
                subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", norm], shell=False)

            if target.is_file():
                msg = f"Проводник открыт с выделением файла: {norm}"
            else:
                msg = f"Проводник открыт в папке: {norm}"

            return ToolResult(tool_name="open_explorer", success=True, output=msg, artifact_path=target)
        except Exception as e:
            err = f"Ошибка открытия проводника: {e}"
            logger.error(err)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="open_explorer", success=False, output=err)

    @classmethod
    def summarize_folder(cls, path: str) -> ToolResult:
        try:
            target = SandboxManager.validate_read_path(path)
            if not target.is_dir():
                return ToolResult(tool_name="summarize_folder", success=False, output=f"Путь не является папкой: {target}")

            subdirs: List[str] = []
            ext_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
            total_files = 0
            total_bytes = 0

            for entry in target.iterdir():
                if entry.is_dir():
                    if not SandboxManager.is_ignored_directory(entry.name):
                        subdirs.append(entry.name)
                elif entry.is_file():
                    total_files += 1
                    try:
                        total_bytes += entry.stat().st_size
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    ext = entry.suffix.lower() or "(без расширения)"
                    ext_counts[ext] = ext_counts.get(ext, 0) + 1

            size_mb = total_bytes / (1024 * 1024)
            lines = [
                f"**Аудит папки:** `{target}`",
                f"- Всего файлов: {total_files} ({size_mb:.2f} МБ)",
                f"- Подпапок первого уровня ({len(subdirs)}): {', '.join(subdirs[:10]) if subdirs else 'нет'}"
            ]
            if len(subdirs) > 10:
                lines[-1] += f" ...и еще {len(subdirs) - 10}"

            if ext_counts:
                ext_items = sorted(ext_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:8]
                ext_str = ", ".join(f"`{k}`: {v}" for k, v in ext_items)
                lines.append(f"- Распределение по типам: {ext_str}")

            return ToolResult(
                tool_name="summarize_folder",
                success=True,
                output="\n".join(lines),
                artifact_path=target
            )
        except Exception as e:
            err = f"Ошибка аудита папки: {e}"
            logger.error(err)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="summarize_folder", success=False, output=err)

    @classmethod
    def copy_file(cls, src_path: str, dst_path: Optional[str] = None) -> ToolResult:
        try:
            if not src_path or not src_path.strip():
                return ToolResult(tool_name="copy_file", success=False, output="Ошибка: Не указан исходный файл.")

            raw_src = src_path.strip().strip("'\"`")
            src = Path(raw_src)

            ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir().resolve()
            sid = SandboxManager.get_active_session_id()
            session_dir = (OUTPUTS_DIR / "sessions" / sid).resolve() if sid else (OUTPUTS_DIR / "sessions").resolve()

            if not src.is_absolute():
                cand_ws = (ws_dir / src).resolve()
                if cand_ws.exists() and cand_ws.is_file():
                    src = cand_ws
                elif sid and (session_dir / src).resolve().exists() and (session_dir / src).resolve().is_file():
                    src = (session_dir / src).resolve()
                else:
                    src = cand_ws
            else:
                src = src.resolve()

            if not src.exists() or not src.is_file():
                return ToolResult(tool_name="copy_file", success=False, output=f"Ошибка: Исходный файл не найден: {src_path}")

            # Разрешено копировать ТОЛЬКО файлы внутри ws_dir или папки сессии
            allowed = False
            try:
                if src.is_relative_to(ws_dir):
                    allowed = True
            except (AttributeError, ValueError):
                pass

            if not allowed and session_dir.exists():
                try:
                    if src.is_relative_to(session_dir):
                        allowed = True
                except (AttributeError, ValueError):
                    pass

            if not allowed:
                return ToolResult(tool_name="copy_file", success=False, output="Доступ за пределы рабочей зоны запрещен")

            if not dst_path or not dst_path.strip():
                dst = (ws_dir / src.name).resolve()
            else:
                clean_dst = SandboxManager.clean_workspace_filename(dst_path)
                dst = (ws_dir / clean_dst).resolve()

            dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(src, dst)

            with open(dst, "ab") as f:
                f.flush()
                os.fsync(f.fileno())

            size_bytes = dst.stat().st_size
            msg = f"Файл успешно скопирован в рабочую песочницу: {dst} ({size_bytes} байт)"
            logger.info(msg)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="copy_file", success=True, output=msg, artifact_path=dst)
        except Exception as e:
            err = f"Ошибка копирования файла: {e}"
            logger.error(err)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="copy_file", success=False, output=err)

    @classmethod
    def get_ast_skeleton(cls, filename: str) -> ToolResult:
        try:
            target_path = SandboxManager.validate_read_file_path(filename)
            with open(target_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                source_code = f.read()

            skeleton_text = ASTSkeletonizer.skeletonize(source_code)
            return ToolResult(
                tool_name="get_ast_skeleton",
                success=True,
                output=skeleton_text,
                artifact_path=target_path
            )
        except Exception as e:
            err_msg = f"[Ошибка get_ast_skeleton]: {e}"
            logger.error(err_msg)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="get_ast_skeleton", success=False, output=err_msg)

    @classmethod
    def patch_file(cls, filename: str, search_block: str = "", replace_block: str = "", diff_body: str = "") -> ToolResult:
        try:
            if not filename or not str(filename).strip():
                return ToolResult(tool_name="patch_file", success=False, output="[Ошибка patch_file]: Не указано имя файла")

            target_path = SandboxManager.validate_read_file_path(filename)
            clean_name = target_path.name

            res = SelfHealingEngine.patch_file_transactional(
                filename=filename,
                search_block=search_block,
                replace_block=replace_block,
                diff_text=diff_body
            )
            if res.success:
                mode_str = " (fuzzy match)" if res.is_fuzzy else ""
                msg = f"[Успешно]: Файл {clean_name} пропатчен{mode_str} (применено замен: {res.applied_count})."
                logger.info(msg)
                return ToolResult(tool_name="patch_file", success=True, output=msg, artifact_path=target_path)
            else:
                err_msg = f"[Ошибка patch_file]: {res.error}"
                logger.warning(err_msg)
                return ToolResult(tool_name="patch_file", success=False, output=err_msg, artifact_path=target_path)
        except Exception as e:
            err = f"[Ошибка patch_file]: {e}"
            logger.error(err)
            return ToolResult(tool_name="patch_file", success=False, output=err)

    @classmethod
    def execute_git_checkpoint(cls, message: str, make_backup: bool = True) -> str:
        from services.git_sandbox import GitSandboxManager
        from services.sandbox_manager import SandboxManager
        ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()

        msg = (message or "").strip() or "Manual user checkpoint"
        ok = GitSandboxManager.checkpoint(ws_dir, msg)
        status = f"Чекпоинт '{msg}' зафиксирован в Git." if ok else "Не удалось зафиксировать чекпоинт."

        if make_backup:
            b_path = GitSandboxManager.create_backup_bundle(ws_dir, label=msg)
            if b_path:
                status += f"\nЛокальный офлайн-бэкап сохранён: {b_path.name}"
        return status

    @classmethod
    def set_reminder(cls, text: str, time: str) -> str:
        if not text or not time:
            return "[Ошибка]: Необходимо указать text и time для напоминания."

        from datetime import datetime, timedelta
        from services.memory_db import memory_db

        now = datetime.now()
        target_dt = None
        clean_time = time.strip()

        rel_match = re.match(r"^\+?(\d+)\s*([smhd])$", clean_time.lower())
        if rel_match:
            val = int(rel_match.group(1))
            unit = rel_match.group(2)
            unit_map = {"s": "seconds", "m": "minutes", "h": "hours", "d": "days"}
            target_dt = now + timedelta(**{unit_map[unit]: val})

        if not target_dt:
            try:
                import dateparser
                settings = {
                    'PREFER_DATES_FROM': 'future',
                    'RELATIVE_BASE': now,
                    'RETURN_AS_TIMEZONE_AWARE': False
                }
                norm_time = re.sub(r'\b(?:в|at|к)\s+', '', clean_time, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()
                norm_time = re.sub(r'\s+года?\b', '', norm_time, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()
                target_dt = dateparser.parse(norm_time, languages=['ru', 'en'], settings=settings)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if not target_dt:
            for fmt in ["%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", "%d.%m.%Y %H:%M", "%d.%m.%Y", "%H:%M:%S", "%H:%M"]:
                try:
                    parsed = datetime.strptime(clean_time, fmt)
                    if fmt in ["%H:%M:%S", "%H:%M"]:
                        target_dt = now.replace(hour=parsed.hour, minute=parsed.minute, second=getattr(parsed, "second", 0), microsecond=0)
                        if target_dt < now:
                            target_dt += timedelta(days=1)
                    elif fmt == "%d.%m.%Y":
                        target_dt = parsed.replace(hour=9, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
                    else:
                        target_dt = parsed
                    break
                except ValueError:
                    continue

        if not target_dt:
            return f"[Ошибка]: Не удалось распознать время '{time}'."

        target_iso = target_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        r_id = memory_db.add_reminder(text, target_iso)
        if r_id != -1:
            return f"[Успешно]: Напоминание #{r_id} установлено на {target_iso}: «{text}»."
        return "[Ошибка]: Не удалось сохранить напоминание в базу данных."

    @classmethod
    def execute_tool_call(cls, call: ToolCall, session_id: Optional[str] = None) -> ToolResult:
        name = call.name.lower()
        p = call.params

        if name == "write_file":
            filename = p.get("filename") or p.get("path") or p.get("file") or p.get("name") or "output.txt"
            content = p.get("content") or (call.body or "")
            return cls.write_file(filename=filename, content=content)

        elif name == "run_script":
            raw_fn = (
                p.get("filename")
                or p.get("path")
                or p.get("script")
                or p.get("file")
                or p.get("command")
                or p.get("name")
                or ""
            )
            return cls.run_script(filename=raw_fn)

        elif name == "find_files":
            query = p.get("query") or ""
            ext = p.get("ext")
            search_root = p.get("search_root") or p.get("root") or p.get("path")
            content_query = p.get("content_query") or p.get("content") or p.get("text")
            return cls.find_files(query=query, ext=ext, search_root=search_root, content_query=content_query)

        elif name == "read_file":
            fn = p.get("filename") or p.get("path") or p.get("file") or p.get("name") or ""
            try:
                st = int(p.get("start_line", 1))
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                st = 1
            try:
                ml = int(p.get("max_lines", 100))
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                ml = 100
            call_sid = p.get("session_id") or session_id
            return cls.read_file(filename=fn, start_line=st, max_lines=ml, session_id=call_sid)

        elif name == "read_document":
            path = p.get("path") or p.get("filename") or ""
            max_chars = int(p.get("max_chars", 3000))
            return cls.read_document(path=path, max_chars=max_chars)

        elif name == "open_explorer":
            path = p.get("path") or p.get("filename") or ""
            return cls.open_explorer(path=path)

        elif name == "summarize_folder":
            path = p.get("path") or p.get("folder") or ""
            return cls.summarize_folder(path=path)

        elif name == "get_ast_skeleton":
            filename = p.get("filename") or p.get("path") or p.get("file") or p.get("name") or ""
            return cls.get_ast_skeleton(filename=filename)

        elif name == "patch_file":
            filename = p.get("filename") or p.get("path") or p.get("file") or p.get("name") or ""
            search_block = p.get("search") or p.get("search_block") or ""
            replace_block = p.get("replace") or p.get("replace_block") or ""
            diff_body = call.body or p.get("diff") or p.get("diff_text") or ""
            return cls.patch_file(filename=filename, search_block=search_block, replace_block=replace_block, diff_body=diff_body)

        elif name == "copy_file":
            src = p.get("src") or p.get("source") or p.get("path") or p.get("file") or p.get("from") or ""
            dst = p.get("dst") or p.get("dest") or p.get("destination") or p.get("target") or p.get("to")
            return cls.copy_file(src_path=src, dst_path=dst)

        elif name == "set_reminder":
            r_text = p.get("text") or p.get("message") or p.get("remind") or p.get("content") or (call.body or "")
            r_time = p.get("time") or p.get("remind_at") or p.get("at") or p.get("when") or ""
            out = cls.set_reminder(text=r_text, time=r_time)
            is_err = out.startswith("[Ошибка") or out.startswith("Ошибка")
            return ToolResult(tool_name="set_reminder", success=not is_err, output=out)

        elif name == "git_checkpoint":
            msg = p.get("message") or p.get("msg") or p.get("m") or (call.body or "")
            b_val = p.get("backup", "true")
            make_backup = str(b_val).strip().lower() not in ("false", "0", "no")
            out = cls.execute_git_checkpoint(message=msg, make_backup=make_backup)
            is_err = "Не удалось" in out
            return ToolResult(tool_name="git_checkpoint", success=not is_err, output=out)

        else:
            return ToolResult(
                tool_name=name,
                success=False,
                output=f"Неизвестный инструмент: '{name}'"
            )

    @classmethod
    def execute_tool(cls, name: str, params: Dict[str, Any], content: str = "") -> str:
        call = ToolCall(name=name, params=dict(params), body=content)
        res = cls.execute_tool_call(call)
        return res.output


    _parse_attributes = staticmethod(ToolParser._parse_attributes)
    normalize_tool_text = staticmethod(ToolParser.normalize_tool_text)
    parse_tool_calls = staticmethod(ToolParser.parse_tool_calls)
    truncate_after_tool_call = staticmethod(ToolParser.truncate_after_tool_call)
    parse_tool_call = staticmethod(ToolParser.parse_tool_call)
    strip_tool_tags = staticmethod(ToolParser.strip_tool_tags)
    has_tool_call = staticmethod(ToolParser.has_tool_call)
