"""
Emoji Picker Menu Component for NeonRoute.
Provides category tabs and grid selection for expressive chat input.
"""

from typing import List, Tuple
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QPoint
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QMenu, QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel, QPushButton, QGridLayout, QWidgetAction
)


class EmojiPickerMenu(QMenu):
    CATEGORIES: List[Tuple[str, List[str]]] = [
        ("Эмоции & Реакции", [
            "😀", "😂", "😊", "🥺", "😳", "😡", "🤔", "🤫", "😍", "🤣", "😭", "😴",
            "👍", "👎", "❤️", "💔", "🖤", "🔥", "💯", "👏", "🎉", "⚡", "⚠️", "✨"
        ]),
        ("Атмосфера & Ролеплей", [
            "👑", "🍷", "⚔️", "💀", "🌙", "🗡️", "🥀", "🕯️", "🔮", "🩸", "⛓️", "🗝️",
            "🎭", "🐺", "🐱", "🦊", "🌹", "🏹", "🛡️", "💎", "💍", "💋", "🌸", "☕"
        ])
    ]

    def __init__(self, target_input, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.target_input = target_input
        self.setObjectName("EmojiPickerMenu")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QMenu#EmojiPickerMenu {
                background-color: rgba(13, 18, 30, 0.96);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4);
                border-radius: 10px;
                padding: 6px;
            }
        """)
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        container = QWidget(self)
        container.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
        c_layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        c_layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        c_layout.setSpacing(6)

        for cat_name, emojis in self.CATEGORIES:
            cat_lbl = QLabel(cat_name, container)
            cat_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 2px;")
            c_layout.addWidget(cat_lbl)

            grid_w = QWidget(container)
            grid = QGridLayout(grid_w)
            grid.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
            grid.setSpacing(2)

            cols = 8
            for idx, emoji_char in enumerate(emojis):
                row = idx // cols
                col = idx % cols
                btn = QPushButton(emoji_char, grid_w)
                btn.setFixedSize(28, 28)
                btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
                btn.setStyleSheet("""
                    QPushButton {
                        background-color: transparent;
                        border: none;
                        font-size: 14px;
                        border-radius: 4px;
                        padding: 0px;
                    }
                    QPushButton:hover {
                        background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);
                    }
                """)
                btn.clicked.connect(lambda _, em=emoji_char: self._on_emoji_clicked(em))
                grid.addWidget(btn, row, col)

            c_layout.addWidget(grid_w)

        action = QWidgetAction(self)
        action.setDefaultWidget(container)
        self.addAction(action)
        self._container = container

    def _on_emoji_clicked(self, emoji_char: str):
        if self.target_input:
            self.target_input.insertPlainText(emoji_char)
            self.target_input.setFocus()
        self.close()

    def show_above_widget(self, anchor_widget: QWidget):
        btn_pos = anchor_widget.mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, 0))
        menu_height = self._container.sizeHint().height() + 16
        pos = QPoint(btn_pos.x(), max(10, btn_pos.y() - menu_height))
        self.exec(pos)

"""
Interactive File Card Component for NeonRoute
Displays generated or attached documents (.xlsx, .docx, images)
with one-click launch ("Открыть файл") and folder location buttons.
"""

import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton
)


class FileCardWidget(QWidget):
    """
    Cyberpunk card representing an exported or attached document.
    """
    def __init__(self, file_path: Path | str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.file_path = Path(file_path)
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setObjectName("FileCardWidget")

        ext = self.file_path.suffix.lower()
        if ext in (".xlsx", ".xls"):
            icon_char = "📊"
            type_label = "EXCEL"
            badge_color = "#10B981"
            border_color = "#059669"
        elif ext in (".docx", ".doc"):
            icon_char = "📄"
            type_label = "WORD"
            badge_color = "#3B82F6"
            border_color = "#2563EB"
        elif ext in (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"):
            icon_char = "🖼️"
            type_label = "IMAGE"
            badge_color = "#D946EF"
            border_color = "#C026D3"
        elif ext in (".wav", ".mp3"):
            icon_char = "🎵"
            type_label = "AUDIO"
            badge_color = "#00F0FF"
            border_color = "#0891B2"
        else:
            icon_char = "📄"
            type_label = "FILE"
            badge_color = "#94A3B8"
            border_color = "#475569"

        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            #FileCardWidget {{
                background-color: #111723;
                border: 1px solid {border_color};
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 4px;
            }}
        """)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        # Icon
        icon_label = QLabel(icon_char, self)
        icon_label.setStyleSheet("font-size: 22px;")
        layout.addWidget(icon_label)

        # File Details (Name, Size, Type badge)
        details_layout = QVBoxLayout()
        details_layout.setSpacing(2)

        title_label = QLabel(self.file_path.name, self)
        title_label.setStyleSheet("color: #F8FAFC; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;")
        details_layout.addWidget(title_label)

        # Size calculation
        size_str = "0 KB"
        if self.file_path.exists():
            bytes_size = self.file_path.stat().st_size
            if bytes_size > 1024 * 1024:
                size_str = f"{bytes_size / (1024 * 1024):.1f} MB"
            else:
                size_str = f"{bytes_size / 1024:.1f} KB"

        meta_label = QLabel(f"<span style='color:{badge_color}; font-weight:bold;'>[{type_label}]</span> {size_str}", self)
        meta_label.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #94A3B8;")
        details_layout.addWidget(meta_label)

        layout.addLayout(details_layout, stretch=1)

        # Action Buttons
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout.setSpacing(6)

        open_btn = QPushButton("Открыть файл", self)
        open_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #1E293B;
                color: #00F0FF;
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                border-radius: 5px;
                padding: 5px 10px;
                font-weight: bold;
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #050B14;
            }
        """)
        open_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_file)
        btn_layout.addWidget(open_btn)

        folder_btn = QPushButton("Папка", self)
        folder_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #1E293B;
                color: #94A3B8;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-radius: 5px;
                padding: 5px 8px;
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                border-color: #64748B;
                color: #F8FAFC;
            }
        """)
        folder_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_in_folder)
        btn_layout.addWidget(folder_btn)

        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _open_file(self):
        """Launches the file in system default application."""
        if self.file_path.exists():
            try:
                os.startfile(str(self.file_path.resolve()))
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error opening file {self.file_path}: {e}")

    def _open_in_folder(self):
        """Highlights the file in Windows Explorer."""
        if self.file_path.exists():
            try:
                subprocess.Popen(f'explorer /select,"{str(self.file_path.resolve())}"')
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error highlighting file in explorer: {e}")

"""
Cyberpunk / Glassmorphic Multi-line Input Box for NeonRoute.
Features:
- Integrated circular Fluent action button (36x36 px): Send (FIF.SEND) ⇄ Stop (⏹)
- Dynamic Mode Highlighting: Button turns Neon Cyan (#00F0FF) on text entry,
  Soft Purple (#C084FC) on !art prompt, and Warning Crimson (#FF007F) during generation
- Viewport right padding (48px) to prevent text overlap with action button
- Dynamic smooth height expansion (42px base up to 250px)
- Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline
- Direct clipboard image capture (Ctrl+V)
- Drag and drop file support
- Guaranteed translucent Glassmorphism styling with outline disabled
"""

import time
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal, QSize, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtGui import QKeyEvent, QImage, QCursor, QColor, QPalette, QIcon, QPixmap, QPainter, QFont
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QTextEdit, QApplication
from qfluentwidgets import (
    TransparentToolButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    ToolTipFilter,
    ToolTipPosition,
)

from config import OUTPUTS_DIR


def _create_stop_square_icon(color: str = "#FF007F", size: int = 32) -> QIcon:
    """Creates a high-DPI rounded square stop icon."""
    pix = QPixmap(size, size)
    pix.fill(QColor(0, 0, 0, 0))
    painter = QPainter(pix)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
    painter.setBrush(QColor(color))
    painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
    # Centered 14x14 square with 2.5px radius
    offset = (size - 14) / 2.0
    painter.drawRoundedRect(int(offset), int(offset), 14, 14, 2.5, 2.5)
    painter.end()
    return QIcon(pix)


class ChatInputBox(QTextEdit):
    """
    Modern glassmorphic multi-line chat input with dynamic mode highlighting,
    auto-expansion up to 250px, and integrated circular Fluent action button.
    """
    send_requested = pyqtSignal()
    stop_requested = pyqtSignal()
    image_pasted = pyqtSignal(Path)
    files_dropped = pyqtSignal(list)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("ChatInputField")
        self.setPlaceholderText("Введите сообщение... (Enter — отправить, Shift+Enter — новая строка)")

        self.min_height = 42
        self.max_height = 250
        self.is_busy = False
        self.has_attachments = False
        self.is_engineer_mode = False

        self.setFixedHeight(self.min_height)
        self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

        # Ensure margins keep text clean from edges and away from 36px action button.
        # Top/bottom margins are strictly 0 to avoid viewport clipping/caret offset artifacts.
        self.setViewportMargins(12, 0, 46, 0)
        self.document().setDocumentMargin(6)
        self.setCursorWidth(2)

        # Synchronize programmatic font and document font with UI font metrics
        ui_font = QFont("Segoe UI", 10)
        self.setFont(ui_font)
        self.document().setDefaultFont(ui_font)

        # Install event filter on viewport to intercept mouse leave/enter cleanly
        self.viewport().installEventFilter(self)

        pal = self.palette()
        pal.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Text, QColor("#F1F5F9"))
        pal.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight, QColor(0, 240, 255, 110))
        pal.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText, QColor("#FFFFFF"))
        self.setPalette(pal)

        # Seamless Sunken Well: deep dark base, no border, no outline, no QSS padding.
        # :hover is scoped to :!focus so focused blinking caret background is 100% stable.
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QTextEdit#ChatInputField, ChatInputBox#ChatInputField {
                background-color: rgba(10, 15, 26, 0.75);
                color: #F8FAFC;
                border: none;
                border-radius: 11px;
                font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
                font-size: 14px;
                outline: none;
            }
            QTextEdit#ChatInputField:hover:!focus, ChatInputBox#ChatInputField:hover:!focus {
                background-color: rgba(13, 20, 34, 0.82);
                border: none;
                outline: none;
            }
            QTextEdit#ChatInputField:focus, ChatInputBox#ChatInputField:focus {
                background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92);
                border: none;
                outline: none;
            }
        """)

        # Circular Fluent UI Transformer Action Button (36x36 px)
        self.action_btn = TransparentToolButton(parent=self)
        self.action_btn.setObjectName("ChatInputTransformerBtn")
        self.action_btn.setFixedSize(36, 36)
        self.action_btn.setIconSize(QSize(18, 18))
        self.action_btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.action_btn.installEventFilter(
            ToolTipFilter(self.action_btn, showDelay=300, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP)
        )
        self.action_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_action_clicked)

        # Pre-create icon variants for optimal performance
        self._icon_idle = FIF.SEND.colored(QColor("#64748B"), QColor("#94A3B8"))
        self._icon_cyan = FIF.SEND.colored(QColor("#00F0FF"), QColor("#00F0FF"))
        self._icon_purple = FIF.SEND.colored(QColor("#C084FC"), QColor("#C084FC"))
        self._icon_stop = _create_stop_square_icon("#FF007F", 32)

        self._update_action_button_style()
        self._update_button_position()

        self.textChanged.connect(self._on_text_changed)

    def set_engineer_mode(self, is_engineer: bool):
        self.is_engineer_mode = is_engineer
        self._update_action_button_style()

    def _is_art_prompt(self, text: str) -> bool:
        if self.is_engineer_mode or not text:
            return False
        clean = text.strip().lower()
        if clean.startswith(("!art", "!арт", "!img", "!картинка")):
            return True
        art_triggers = [
            r'^(?:нарисуй|сгенерируй|сделай арт|изобрази|нарисуй мне|draw|generate art|paint)\b',
            r'\b(?:портрет|пейзаж|аниме арт|фотосессия|концепт-арт)\b'
        ]
        return any(bool(re.search(pat, clean)) for pat in art_triggers)

    def _on_text_changed(self):
        self._adjust_height()
        self._update_action_button_style()

    def _adjust_height(self):
        doc_h = int(self.document().size().height()) + 8
        target_h = max(self.min_height, min(doc_h, self.max_height))

        if abs(self.height() - target_h) >= 2:
            self.setFixedHeight(target_h)

        if doc_h > self.max_height:
            self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAsNeeded)
        else:
            self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

        self._update_button_position()

    def _update_button_position(self):
        if hasattr(self, "action_btn") and self.action_btn:
            pad_right = 5
            # Center vertically when at base single-line height, otherwise anchor near bottom
            if self.height() <= self.min_height + 4:
                by = max(0, (self.height() - self.action_btn.height()) // 2)
            else:
                by = max(0, self.height() - self.action_btn.height() - 4)
            bx = self.width() - self.action_btn.width() - pad_right
            self.action_btn.move(max(0, bx), max(0, by))

    def _update_action_button_style(self):
        if not hasattr(self, "action_btn") or not self.action_btn:
            return

        if self.is_busy:
            self.action_btn.setIcon(self._icon_stop)
            self.action_btn.setText("⏹")
            self.action_btn.setToolTip("Остановить генерацию (Stop)")
            self.action_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn {
                    background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.30);
                    border: none;
                    border-radius: 18px;
                }
                TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:hover {
                    background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.50);
                    border: none;
                }
                TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:pressed {
                    background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.70);
                    border: none;
                }
            """)
        else:
            raw_text = self.toPlainText()
            has_content = bool(raw_text.strip()) or self.has_attachments
            self.action_btn.setText("➤")

            if has_content:
                if self._is_art_prompt(raw_text):
                    self.action_btn.setIcon(self._icon_purple)
                    self.action_btn.setToolTip("Создать арт в Forge (Enter)")
                    self.action_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn {
                            background-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.25);
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: 18px;
                        }
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:hover {
                            background-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.45);
                            border: none;
                        }
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:pressed {
                            background-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.65);
                            border: none;
                        }
                    """)
                else:
                    self.action_btn.setIcon(self._icon_cyan)
                    self.action_btn.setToolTip("Отправить сообщение (Enter)")
                    self.action_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn {
                            background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.22);
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: 18px;
                        }
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:hover {
                            background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.40);
                            border: none;
                        }
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:pressed {
                            background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.60);
                            border: none;
                        }
                    """)
            else:
                self.action_btn.setIcon(self._icon_idle)
                self.action_btn.setToolTip("Введите сообщение...")
                self.action_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                    TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn {
                        background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
                        border: none;
                        border-radius: 18px;
                    }
                    TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:hover {
                        background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                        border: none;
                    }
                    TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:pressed {
                        background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
                        border: none;
                    }
                """)

    def _on_action_clicked(self):
        if self.is_busy:
            self.stop_requested.emit()
        else:
            if self.toPlainText().strip() or self.has_attachments:
                self.send_requested.emit()

    def set_busy(self, is_busy: bool):
        self.is_busy = is_busy
        self._update_action_button_style()

    def set_has_attachments(self, has_attachments: bool):
        self.has_attachments = has_attachments
        self._update_action_button_style()

    def clear(self):
        super().clear()
        self.setFixedHeight(self.min_height)
        self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self._update_action_button_style()
        self._update_button_position()

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._update_button_position()

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event: QEvent):
        if obj is self.viewport() and event.type() in (QEvent.Type.Leave, QEvent.Type.Enter):
            self.viewport().update()
        return super().eventFilter(obj, event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):
        super().leaveEvent(event)
        self.viewport().update()

    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent):
        if event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter):
            if not (event.modifiers() & Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier):
                if not self.is_busy and (self.toPlainText().strip() or self.has_attachments):
                    self.send_requested.emit()
                event.accept()
                return

        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_V and (event.modifiers() & Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier):
            clipboard = QApplication.clipboard()
            mime_data = clipboard.mimeData()
            if mime_data.hasImage():
                image: QImage = clipboard.image()
                if not image.isNull():
                    filename = f"clip_{int(time.time())}.png"
                    img_path = OUTPUTS_DIR / filename
                    image.save(str(img_path), "PNG")
                    self.image_pasted.emit(img_path)
                    event.accept()
                    return

        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def dragEnterEvent(self, event):
        if event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            super().dragEnterEvent(event)

    def dragMoveEvent(self, event):
        if event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            super().dragMoveEvent(event)

    def dropEvent(self, event):
        if event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            paths = []
            for url in event.mimeData().urls():
                p = Path(url.toLocalFile())
                if p.exists():
                    paths.append(p)
            if paths:
                self.files_dropped.emit(paths)
                event.acceptProposedAction()
                return
        super().dropEvent(event)

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QFrame, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton
)


class ReminderToastWidget(QFrame):
    """Стилизованное всплывающее окно напоминания от Эларии."""
    def __init__(self, text: str, remind_at: str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("ReminderToast")
        self.setWindowFlags(Qt.WindowType.SubWindow | Qt.WindowType.FramelessWindowHint)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground)
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#ReminderToast {
                background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95);
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(14, 12, 14, 12)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        top_row = QHBoxLayout()
        icon_lbl = QLabel("🔔", self)
        icon_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 14px; background: transparent;")
        top_row.addWidget(icon_lbl)

        title_lbl = QLabel("Напоминание от Эларии", self)
        title_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; background: transparent;")
        top_row.addWidget(title_lbl, 1)

        close_btn = QPushButton("✕", self)
        close_btn.setFixedSize(18, 18)
        close_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background: transparent;
                color: #94A3B8;
                border: none;
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: bold;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                color: #FFFFFF;
            }
        """)
        close_btn.clicked.connect(self.close)
        top_row.addWidget(close_btn)
        layout.addLayout(top_row)

        body_lbl = QLabel(text, self)
        body_lbl.setWordWrap(True)
        body_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #E2E8F0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.3; background: transparent;")
        layout.addWidget(body_lbl)

        time_lbl = QLabel(remind_at, self)
        time_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 10px; background: transparent;")
        time_lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight)
        layout.addWidget(time_lbl)

        QTimer.singleShot(14000, self.close)

"""
Modular RPG UI Elements Component for NeonRoute.
Parses roleplay markup (<stats>, <thought>, <choices>, <meters>, <check>, <terminal>, <sms>)
and renders glassmorphic Cyberpunk widgets and formatted HTML blocks.
"""

import re
import html
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple, List
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QFrame, QVBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QTextBrowser
)


class RPGBundle:
    def __init__(
        self,
        clean_text: str,
        stats: Optional[Any] = None,
        thought: Optional[str] = None,
        choices: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        meters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    ):
        self.clean_text = clean_text
        self.stats = stats
        self.thought = thought
        self.choices = choices
        self.meters = meters


class RPGContentParser:
    THOUGHT_RE = re.compile(r'<(thought|think)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    CHOICES_RE = re.compile(r'<(choices|options)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    STATS_RE = re.compile(r'<(stats|status)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    METERS_RE = re.compile(r'<(meters|affection)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    CHECK_RE = re.compile(r'<check>\s*(.*?)\s*</check>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    TERMINAL_RE = re.compile(r'<terminal>\s*(.*?)\s*</terminal>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    SMS_RE = re.compile(r'<(sms|phone)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, text: str) -> RPGBundle:
        if not text or ("<" not in text and "```" not in text):
            return RPGBundle(clean_text=text)

        norm = text.replace('\u2028', '\n').replace('\u2029', '\n').replace('\r\n', '\n')

        thought_text = None
        m_th = cls.THOUGHT_RE.search(norm)
        if m_th:
            thought_text = m_th.group(2).strip()
            norm = cls.THOUGHT_RE.sub('', norm)

        choices_list = None
        m_ch = cls.CHOICES_RE.search(norm)
        if m_ch:
            raw_c = m_ch.group(2).strip()
            lines = [ln.strip() for ln in raw_c.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
            if lines:
                choices_list = lines
            norm = cls.CHOICES_RE.sub('', norm)

        stats_data = None
        m_st = cls.STATS_RE.search(norm)
        if m_st:
            raw_st = m_st.group(2).strip()
            stats_data = cls._parse_key_values(raw_st)
            norm = cls.STATS_RE.sub('', norm)

        meters_data = None
        m_mt = cls.METERS_RE.search(norm)
        if m_mt:
            raw_mt = m_mt.group(2).strip()
            meters_data = cls._parse_meters(raw_mt)
            norm = cls.METERS_RE.sub('', norm)

        clean_text = norm.strip()
        bundle = RPGBundle(clean_text, stats_data, thought_text, choices_list, meters_data)

        # Fallback: Detect raw markdown code blocks containing RPG stats if <stats> tag was omitted
        if not bundle.stats and "```" in bundle.clean_text:
            code_block_pattern = re.compile(r'```(?:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)?\s*\n?(.*?)```', re.DOTALL)
            stat_markers = (
                "physical status:", "inventory:", "equipment:", "level:", "lvl:",
                "уровень:", "hp:", "health:", "здоровье:", "class:", "класс:",
                "battle power:", "bp:", "gold:", "золото:", "threat level:",
                "reputation:", "skills:", "spells:", "abilities:", "objectives:"
            )
            for match in code_block_pattern.finditer(bundle.clean_text):
                block_content = match.group(1).strip()
                block_lower = block_content.lower()
                matches_count = sum(1 for marker in stat_markers if marker in block_lower)
                if matches_count >= 2:
                    bundle.stats = block_content
                    # Clean out the code block from visible chat text
                    start_idx, end_idx = match.span()
                    bundle.clean_text = (bundle.clean_text[:start_idx] + bundle.clean_text[end_idx:]).strip()
                    break

        return bundle

    @classmethod
    def format_inline_rpg_blocks(cls, escaped_html: str) -> str:
        """Formats inline XML blocks safely AFTER html.escape to prevent double-escaping bugs."""
        # 1. Check (D&D d20)
        def _check_sub(m):
            raw_body = m.group(1).strip().replace('\n', '<br>')
            is_success = "успех" in raw_body.lower() or "success" in raw_body.lower()
            is_fail = "провал" in raw_body.lower() or "failure" in raw_body.lower()
            color = "#10B981" if is_success else ("#EF4444" if is_fail else "#F59E0B")
            badge = "✔ УСПЕХ" if is_success else ("✖ ПРОВАЛ" if is_fail else "🎲 ПРОВЕРКА")
            return (
                f"<div style='background:rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9); border:1px solid {color}; "
                f"border-left:4px solid {color}; border-radius:6px; padding:6px 10px; margin:6px 0;'>"
                f"<div style='color:{color}; font-weight:bold; font-size:11px; margin-bottom:3px;'>🎲 {badge}</div>"
                f"<div style='color:#E2E8F0; font-size:11px; line-height:1.3;'>{raw_body}</div></div>"
            )
        escaped_html = re.sub(r'&lt;check&gt;\s*(.*?)\s*&lt;/check&gt;', _check_sub, escaped_html, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

        # 2. Terminal
        def _term_sub(m):
            raw_body = m.group(1).strip().replace('\n', '<br>')
            return (
                f"<div style='background:#050D0A; border:1px solid #10B981; border-radius:6px; "
                f"padding:8px 12px; margin:6px 0; font-family:Consolas, monospace;'>"
                f"<div style='color:#34D399; font-weight:bold; font-size:10px; margin-bottom:4px;'>📟 ТЕРМИНАЛ СВЯЗИ</div>"
                f"<div style='color:#A7F3D0; font-size:11px; line-height:1.3;'>{raw_body}</div></div>"
            )
        escaped_html = re.sub(r'&lt;terminal&gt;\s*(.*?)\s*&lt;/terminal&gt;', _term_sub, escaped_html, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

        # 3. SMS / Phone
        def _sms_sub(m):
            raw_body = m.group(2).strip().replace('\n', '<br>')
            return (
                f"<div style='background:rgba(10, 16, 28, 0.95); border:1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4); "
                f"border-left:3px solid #00F0FF; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 12px; margin:6px 0;'>"
                f"<div style='color:#00F0FF; font-weight:bold; font-size:10px; margin-bottom:3px;'>📱 ВХОДЯЩЕЕ СООБЩЕНИЕ</div>"
                f"<div style='color:#F1F5F9; font-size:11px; line-height:1.3;'>{raw_body}</div></div>"
            )
        escaped_html = re.sub(r'&lt;(sms|phone)&gt;\s*(.*?)\s*&lt;/\1&gt;', _sms_sub, escaped_html, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

        return escaped_html

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_key_values(raw_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        for line in raw_text.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or ":" not in line:
                continue
            k, v = line.split(":", 1)
            key, val = k.strip(), v.strip().rstrip(',')
            if val.startswith('[') and val.endswith(']'):
                inner = val[1:-1].strip()
                items = []
                if inner:
                    for raw_item in re.split(r',\s*(?=(?:[^\"]*\"[^\"]*\")*[^\"]*$)', inner):
                        c = raw_item.strip().strip('\'"').strip()
                        if c:
                            items.append(c)
                data[key] = items
            else:
                data[key] = val.strip('\'"')
        return data

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_meters(raw_text: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        meters: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for line in raw_text.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or ":" not in line:
                continue
            k, v = line.split(":", 1)
            key = k.strip()
            val = v.strip()
            pct_m = re.search(r'(\d+)\s*%', val)
            pct = int(pct_m.group(1)) if pct_m else None
            if pct is None:
                slash_m = re.search(r'(\d+)\s*/\s*(\d+)', val)
                if slash_m:
                    num, den = float(slash_m.group(1)), float(slash_m.group(2))
                    pct = int((num / den) * 100) if den > 0 else 0
            if pct is None:
                filled = val.count('█') + val.count('#')
                empty = val.count('░') + val.count('-')
                if (filled + empty) > 0:
                    pct = int((filled / (filled + empty)) * 100)
            note_m = re.search(r'\((.*?)\)', val)
            note = note_m.group(1).strip() if note_m else ""
            meters[key] = {"pct": min(100, max(0, pct if pct is not None else 50)), "note": note, "raw": val}
        return meters


class RPGThoughtWidget(QFrame):
    def __init__(self, thought_text: str, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.thought_text = thought_text
        self.is_expanded = True
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setObjectName("RPGThoughtFrame")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#RPGThoughtFrame {
                background-color: rgba(25, 20, 42, 0.65);
                border: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.25);
                border-radius: 10px;
                margin-top: 3px;
                margin-bottom: 4px;
            }
        """)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(8, 6, 8, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(4)

        self.toggle_btn = QPushButton(self)
        self.toggle_btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self._update_header()
        self.toggle_btn.clicked.connect(self._toggle_collapse)
        layout.addWidget(self.toggle_btn)

        self.text_browser = QTextBrowser(self)
        self.text_browser.setReadOnly(True)
        self.text_browser.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.text_browser.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.text_browser.setStyleSheet("""
            QTextBrowser {
                background: transparent;
                border: none;
                color: #E9D5FF;
                font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
                font-style: italic;
                font-size: 11px;
                line-height: 1.35;
                padding: 0px;
            }
        """)
        esc_t = html.escape(self.thought_text).replace('\n', '<br>')
        self.text_browser.setHtml(f"<div>{esc_t}</div>")
        doc = self.text_browser.document()
        doc.setTextWidth(600.0)
        h = max(26, min(int(doc.size().height()) + 8, 220))
        self.text_browser.setFixedHeight(h)
        layout.addWidget(self.text_browser)

    def _update_header(self):
        arr = "▼" if self.is_expanded else "▶"
        self.toggle_btn.setText(f"{arr}  💭 Внутренние мысли")
        self.toggle_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background: transparent;
                color: #A78BFA;
                text-align: left;
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: bold;
                border: none;
                padding: 2px 4px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover { color: #C4B5FD; }
        """)

    def _toggle_collapse(self):
        self.is_expanded = not self.is_expanded
        self.text_browser.setVisible(self.is_expanded)
        self._update_header()


class RPGChoicesWidget(QFrame):
    choice_selected = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, choices: List[str], parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.choices = choices or []
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setObjectName("RPGChoicesFrame")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#RPGChoicesFrame {
                background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.20);
                border-radius: 10px;
                margin-top: 6px;
                margin-bottom: 4px;
            }
        """)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        hdr = QLabel("🧭 ВАРИАНТЫ ДЕЙСТВИЙ (нажмите для выбора):", self)
        hdr.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; background: transparent;")
        layout.addWidget(hdr)

        for raw_choice in self.choices:
            btn = QPushButton(raw_choice, self)
            btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
            btn.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background-color: rgba(22, 32, 50, 0.65);
                    color: #F1F5F9;
                    border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
                    border-radius: 8px;
                    padding: 6px 12px;
                    text-align: left;
                    font-size: 11px;
                    font-weight: 500;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.18);
                    border-color: #00F0FF;
                    color: #00F0FF;
                }
                QPushButton:pressed {
                    background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.30);
                }
                QPushButton:disabled {
                    background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.40);
                    border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
                    color: #64748B;
                }
            """)
            btn.clicked.connect(lambda _, ch=raw_choice: self._on_btn_clicked(ch))
            layout.addWidget(btn)

    def _on_btn_clicked(self, choice_text: str):
        for btn in self.findChildren(QPushButton):
            btn.setEnabled(False)
        clean_choice = re.sub(r'^\s*[\d]+[.)\-]\s*', '', choice_text).strip()
        self.choice_selected.emit(clean_choice)


class RPGStatusWidget(QFrame):
    KEY_ICONS = {
        "class": "👤", "класс": "👤", "level": "⭐", "уровень": "⭐",
        "gold": "💰", "золото": "💰", "exp": "📈", "опыт": "📈",
        "bp": "⚡", "location": "📍", "локация": "📍",
        "threat level": "⚠️", "угроза": "⚠️", "reputation": "👑",
        "inventory": "🎒", "инвентарь": "🎒", "equipment": "🛡️",
        "снаряжение": "🛡️", "abilities": "🐾", "способности": "🐾",
        "skill": "🎯", "skills": "🎯", "spells": "🔮", "relationships": "🤝", "objectives": "📜"
    }

    def __init__(self, stats_data: Any, meters_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        if isinstance(stats_data, str):
            self.stats_data = RPGContentParser._parse_key_values(stats_data)
            if not self.stats_data:
                self.stats_data = {"Status": stats_data}
        else:
            self.stats_data = stats_data or {}
        self.meters_data = meters_data or {}
        self.is_expanded = True
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setObjectName("RPGStatusHUD")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#RPGStatusHUD {
                background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.80);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25);
                border-radius: 10px;
                margin-top: 6px;
                margin-bottom: 4px;
            }
        """)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(8, 6, 8, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        self.toggle_btn = QPushButton(self)
        self.toggle_btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self._update_header()
        self.toggle_btn.clicked.connect(self._toggle_collapse)
        layout.addWidget(self.toggle_btn)

        self.content_browser = QTextBrowser(self)
        self.content_browser.setReadOnly(True)
        self.content_browser.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.content_browser.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.content_browser.setStyleSheet("""
            QTextBrowser {
                background: transparent;
                border: none;
                color: #CBD5E1;
                font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
                font-size: 11px;
                padding: 0px;
            }
        """)
        self._render_content()
        layout.addWidget(self.content_browser)

    def _update_header(self):
        arr = "▼" if self.is_expanded else "▶"
        lvl = self.stats_data.get("Level") or self.stats_data.get("level") or ""
        cls_ = self.stats_data.get("Class") or self.stats_data.get("class") or ""
        badge = f" • {cls_} (Lvl {lvl})" if (cls_ and lvl) else ""
        self.toggle_btn.setText(f"{arr}  ⚔️ СТАТУС & ИНВЕНТАРЬ{badge}")
        self.toggle_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background: transparent;
                color: #00F0FF;
                text-align: left;
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: bold;
                border: none;
                padding: 2px 4px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover { color: #38BDF8; }
        """)

    def _toggle_collapse(self):
        self.is_expanded = not self.is_expanded
        self.content_browser.setVisible(self.is_expanded)
        self._update_header()

    def update_data(self, stats: Any, meters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None):
        if isinstance(stats, str):
            self.stats_data = RPGContentParser._parse_key_values(stats)
            if not self.stats_data:
                self.stats_data = {"Status": stats}
        else:
            self.stats_data = stats or {}
        if meters:
            self.meters_data = meters
        self._update_header()
        self._render_content()

    def update_status(self, stats: Any, meters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None):
        """Backward compatibility alias for update_data."""
        self.update_data(stats, meters)

    def _render_content(self):
        blocks = []
        scalars, lists = [], []

        for k, v in self.stats_data.items():
            if isinstance(v, list):
                lists.append((k, v))
            else:
                scalars.append((k, str(v)))

        # 1. Grid of Scalar Stats
        if scalars:
            cells = []
            for k, val in scalars:
                icon = self.KEY_ICONS.get(k.lower(), "🔹")
                cells.append(
                    f"<div style='display:inline-block; margin-right:12px; margin-bottom:4px;'>"
                    f"<span style='color:#64748B;'>{icon} {html.escape(k)}:</span> "
                    f"<strong style='color:#38BDF8;'>{html.escape(val)}</strong></div>"
                )
            blocks.append(f"<div style='margin-bottom:6px;'>{''.join(cells)}</div>")

        # 2. Graphical Progress Bars for Meters / Affection
        if self.meters_data:
            meter_rows = []
            for m_name, m_info in self.meters_data.items():
                pct = m_info.get("pct", 50)
                note = html.escape(m_info.get("note", ""))
                note_str = f" <span style='color:#34D399; font-size:10px;'>({note})</span>" if note else ""
                bar_color = "#EC4899" if any(w in m_name.lower() for w in ("любовь", "привяз", "влеч", "love")) else "#00F0FF"
                meter_rows.append(
                    f"<table width='100%' cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' style='margin-bottom:5px;'>"
                    f"<tr><td style='color:#E2E8F0; font-size:11px; font-weight:600;'>📊 {html.escape(m_name)}</td>"
                    f"<td align='right' style='color:{bar_color}; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold;'>{pct}%{note_str}</td></tr>"
                    f"<tr><td colspan='2' style='padding-top:2px;'>"
                    f"<table width='100%' cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' style='background-color:#1E293B; height:6px; border-radius:3px;'>"
                    f"<tr><td width='{pct}%' style='background-color:{bar_color}; height:6px; border-radius:3px;'></td>"
                    f"<td width='{100 - pct}%'></td></tr></table></td></tr></table>"
                )
            blocks.append(f"<div style='margin-top:4px; margin-bottom:6px;'>{''.join(meter_rows)}</div>")

        # 3. Lists & Chips
        if lists:
            list_rows = []
            for k, items in lists:
                icon = self.KEY_ICONS.get(k.lower(), "📦")
                if not items:
                    chips = "<span style='color:#475569; font-style:italic;'>пусто</span>"
                else:
                    chip_tags = [
                        f"<span style='background:rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12); color:#00F0FF; "
                        f"border:1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35); border-radius:4px; "
                        f"padding:1px 6px; margin-right:4px; font-weight:500; font-size:11px;'>{html.escape(str(itm))}</span>"
                        for itm in items
                    ]
                    chips = " ".join(chip_tags)
                list_rows.append(
                    f"<div style='margin-top:3px; margin-bottom:4px;'>"
                    f"<span style='color:#94A3B8; font-weight:600;'>{icon} {html.escape(k)}:</span> {chips}</div>"
                )
            blocks.append("".join(list_rows))

        full_html = f"<div style='font-family:\"Inter\",\"Segoe UI\",sans-serif; line-height:1.35;'>{''.join(blocks)}</div>"
        self.content_browser.setHtml(full_html)
        doc = self.content_browser.document()
        doc.setTextWidth(600.0)
        h = int(doc.size().height()) + 8
        self.content_browser.setFixedHeight(max(30, min(h, 280)))


def extract_rpg_status(text: str) -> Tuple[str, Optional[Any]]:
    bundle = RPGContentParser.parse(text)
    return bundle.clean_text, bundle.stats


# Backward compatibility alias
RPGStatusParser = RPGContentParser
RPGStatusParser.extract = staticmethod(extract_rpg_status)

"""
Search Bar Component for NeonRoute Chat.
Provides Ctrl+F in-chat search, match counting, next/previous navigation,
and smooth scrolling to highlighted message.
Modernized with QFluentWidgets components and Glassmorphism styling under Agentrules.md.
"""

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal, QSize, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel
from qfluentwidgets import (
    SearchLineEdit,
    TransparentToolButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    ToolTipFilter,
    ToolTipPosition,
)


class SearchBarWidget(QFrame):
    """
    Compact popup / top search bar for searching text across chat messages.
    """
    search_changed = pyqtSignal(str)
    next_requested = pyqtSignal()
    prev_requested = pyqtSignal()
    close_requested = pyqtSignal()

    # Aliases
    query_changed = search_changed
    find_next = next_requested
    find_prev = prev_requested
    closed = close_requested

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("SearchBarWidget")
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            #SearchBarWidget {
                background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.90);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.28);
                border-radius: 12px;
                padding: 3px 8px;
            }
            SearchLineEdit {
                background-color: rgba(10, 15, 26, 0.75);
                color: #F1F5F9;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 4px 8px;
                font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif;
                font-size: 12px;
                min-width: 200px;
            }
            SearchLineEdit:focus {
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.50);
                background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.90);
            }
            QLabel#SearchCountLabel {
                color: #94A3B8;
                font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif;
                font-size: 11px;
                padding: 0 4px;
                background: transparent;
            }
            TransparentToolButton {
                border-radius: 6px;
            }
            TransparentToolButton:hover {
                background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
            }
            TransparentToolButton#CloseSearchBtn:hover {
                background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.20);
            }
        """)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 4, 6, 4)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        self.input_field = SearchLineEdit(self)
        self.input_field.setPlaceholderText("Поиск в диалоге... (Esc для закрытия)")
        self.input_field.textChanged.connect(self.search_changed.emit)
        self.input_field.installEventFilter(self)
        layout.addWidget(self.input_field, stretch=1)

        self.lbl_count = QLabel("0 совпадений", self)
        self.lbl_count.setObjectName("SearchCountLabel")
        layout.addWidget(self.lbl_count)

        self.btn_prev = TransparentToolButton(FIF.UP, self)
        self.btn_prev.setFixedSize(28, 28)
        self.btn_prev.setIconSize(QSize(12, 12))
        self.btn_prev.setToolTip("Предыдущее совпадение (Shift+Enter)")
        self.btn_prev.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self.btn_prev, 300, ToolTipPosition.BOTTOM))
        self.btn_prev.clicked.connect(self.prev_requested.emit)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_prev)

        self.btn_next = TransparentToolButton(FIF.DOWN, self)
        self.btn_next.setFixedSize(28, 28)
        self.btn_next.setIconSize(QSize(12, 12))
        self.btn_next.setToolTip("Следующее совпадение (Enter)")
        self.btn_next.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self.btn_next, 300, ToolTipPosition.BOTTOM))
        self.btn_next.clicked.connect(self.next_requested.emit)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_next)

        self.btn_close = TransparentToolButton(FIF.CLOSE, self)
        self.btn_close.setObjectName("CloseSearchBtn")
        self.btn_close.setFixedSize(28, 28)
        self.btn_close.setIconSize(QSize(12, 12))
        self.btn_close.setToolTip("Закрыть поиск (Esc)")
        self.btn_close.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self.btn_close, 300, ToolTipPosition.BOTTOM))
        self.btn_close.clicked.connect(self.close_requested.emit)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_close)

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):
        if watched == self.input_field and event.type() == QEvent.Type.KeyPress:
            if event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter):
                if event.modifiers() & Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier:
                    self.prev_requested.emit()
                else:
                    self.next_requested.emit()
                return True
            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Escape:
                self.close_requested.emit()
                return True
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def set_match_status(self, current: int, total: int):
        """Updates match counter label."""
        if total == 0:
            self.lbl_count.setText("0 совпадений")
            self.lbl_count.setStyleSheet("color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.85); font-size: 11px;")
        else:
            self.lbl_count.setText(f"{current} из {total}")
            self.lbl_count.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;")

    def set_match_info(self, current: int, total: int):
        self.set_match_status(current, total)

    @property
    def search_input(self):
        return self.input_field

    @property
    def counter_label(self):
        return self.lbl_count

    def focus_input(self):
        """Activates and selects text in the search input."""
        self.input_field.setFocus()
        self.input_field.selectAll()

    def show_and_focus(self):
        self.setVisible(True)
        self.focus_input()

    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Escape:
            self.close_requested.emit()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def _handle_new_chat_clicked(self):
        """Открытие диалога NewChatDialog с выбором целевого режима (РП / Ассистент / Инженер)."""
        if hasattr(self.window, "show_new_chat_dialog"):
            self.window.show_new_chat_dialog()
        elif hasattr(self.window, "_open_new_chat_dialog"):
            self.window._open_new_chat_dialog()
        else:
            from ui.dialogs.new_chat_dialog import NewChatDialog
            from PyQt6.QtCore import QPoint
            from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QDialog
            dlg = NewChatDialog(parent=self.window)
            btn = self.btn_new_chat
            pos = btn.mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, btn.height() + 4))
            dlg.move(pos)
            if dlg.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted and dlg.selected_mode:
                if hasattr(self.window, "create_chat"):
                    self.window.create_chat(mode=dlg.selected_mode)

    @staticmethod
    def _safe_open_folder(folder_path):
        try:
            p = Path(folder_path)
            p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            os.startfile(str(p.resolve()))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[Sidebar] Не удалось открыть папку {folder_path}: {e}")

"""

Encapsulates hardware telemetry (VRAM/RAM ProgressBars), server process controls,

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
import re

class ServiceStatusBadge(QWidget):
    """
    Service status indicator featuring a QFluentWidgets DotInfoBadge,
    compact label, and ToolTipFilter.
    """

    def __init__(self, name: str, port: int, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.name = name
        self.port = port
        self.is_online = False
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 2, 8, 2)
        layout.setSpacing(6)
        layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)

        # Dot info badge indicator (green when active, red when inactive)
        self.dot = DotInfoBadge(self)
        self.dot.setFixedSize(6, 6)
        self.dot.setLevel(InfoLevel.ERROR)
        self.dot.setCustomBackgroundColor("#EF4444", "#EF4444")
        self.dot.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True)
        layout.addWidget(self.dot)

        # Service name & port label
        self.label = QLabel(f"{self.name} ({self.port})", self)
        self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
        self.label.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True)
        layout.addWidget(self.label)

        self.setStyleSheet("""
            ServiceStatusBadge {
                background-color: #111622;
                border: 1px solid #1E273A;
                border-radius: 10px;
            }
        """)

        self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} ({self.port}) — Офлайн: Сервис недоступен")
        self.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self, showDelay=250, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP))

    def set_status(self, online: bool, message: str = ""):
        self.is_online = online
        if online:
            self.dot.setLevel(InfoLevel.SUCCESS)
            self.dot.setCustomBackgroundColor("#10B981", "#10B981")
            self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #E2E8F0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
            self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} ({self.port}) — Онлайн ({message or 'Готов к работе'})")
        else:
            self.dot.setLevel(InfoLevel.ERROR)
            self.dot.setCustomBackgroundColor("#EF4444", "#EF4444")
            self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
            self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} ({self.port}) — Офлайн ({message or 'Сервис недоступен'})")

class VramLabel(QLabel):
    """
    Hardware metric label for VRAM with two-way synchronization to QFluentWidgets ProgressBar.
    Applies colors strictly per Agentrules hardware thresholds:
    - Free >= 5500 MB: Calm green accent (#10B981)
    - Free 4200 - 5499 MB: Warning amber tint (#F59E0B)
    - Free < 4200 MB: Critical load indicator (#EF4444)
    """

    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: Optional[QWidget] = None, progress_bar: Optional[ProgressBar] = None):
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self.progress_bar = progress_bar
        self._current_color = "#10B981"

    def update_vram(self, v_used: int, v_total: int, v_pct: float, temp: Optional[int] = None):
        free_mb = max(0, v_total - v_used)
        if free_mb >= 5500:
            color = "#10B981"
        elif 4200 <= free_mb < 5500:
            color = "#F59E0B"
        else:
            color = "#EF4444"

        self._current_color = color
        temp_str = f" • {temp}°C" if temp else ""
        super().setText(f"VRAM: {v_used} / {v_total} MB ({v_pct}%){temp_str}")
        super().setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 6px;")

        if self.progress_bar:
            self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 100)
            self.progress_bar.setValue(int(round(v_pct)))
            self.progress_bar.setCustomBarColor(color, color)
            self.progress_bar.setToolTip(f"VRAM: {v_used} / {v_total} MB ({v_pct}%)\nСвободно: {free_mb} MB{temp_str}")

    def setText(self, text: str):
        # Auto-parse text if called by legacy slot
        m = re.search(r"VRAM:\s*(\d+)\s*/\s*(\d+)\s*MB\s*\(([0-9.]+)%\)", text)
        if m:
            v_used = int(m.group(1))
            v_total = int(m.group(2))
            v_pct = float(m.group(3))
            m_temp = re.search(r"•\s*(\d+)\s*°C", text)
            temp = int(m_temp.group(1)) if m_temp else None
            self.update_vram(v_used, v_total, v_pct, temp)
        else:
            super().setText(text)

    def setStyleSheet(self, style: str):
        # Preserve threshold-based color
        super().setStyleSheet(f"color: {self._current_color}; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 6px;")


class RamLabel(QLabel):
    """
    Hardware metric label for RAM with synchronization to QFluentWidgets ProgressBar.
    """

    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: Optional[QWidget] = None, progress_bar: Optional[ProgressBar] = None):
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self.progress_bar = progress_bar

    def update_ram(self, r_used: float, r_total: float, r_pct: float):
        super().setText(f"RAM: {r_used:.1f} / {r_total:.1f} GB ({r_pct}%)")
        super().setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; margin-right: 6px;")

        if self.progress_bar:
            self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 100)
            self.progress_bar.setValue(int(round(r_pct)))
            self.progress_bar.setCustomBarColor("#38BDF8", "#38BDF8")
            self.progress_bar.setToolTip(f"RAM: {r_used:.1f} / {r_total:.1f} GB ({r_pct}%)")

    def setText(self, text: str):
        m = re.search(r"RAM:\s*([0-9.]+)\s*/\s*([0-9.]+)\s*GB\s*\(([0-9.]+)%\)", text)
        if m:
            r_used = float(m.group(1))
            r_total = float(m.group(2))
            r_pct = float(m.group(3))
            self.update_ram(r_used, r_total, r_pct)
        else:
            super().setText(text)

        v_used = stats.get("vram_used_mb", 0)
        v_total = stats.get("vram_total_mb", 8192)
        v_pct = stats.get("vram_percent", 0.0)
        temp = stats.get("gpu_temp_c")

        if hasattr(self.lbl_vram, "update_vram"):
            self.lbl_vram.update_vram(v_used, v_total, v_pct, temp)

        r_used = stats.get("ram_used_gb", 0.0)
        r_total = stats.get("ram_total_gb", 16.0)
        r_pct = stats.get("ram_percent", 0.0)

        if hasattr(self.lbl_ram, "update_ram"):
            self.lbl_ram.update_ram(r_used, r_total, r_pct)

    @pyqtSlot(dict)
    def _on_health_updated(self, health: dict):
        lm_ok = health.get("lm_ok", False)
        lm_msg = health.get("lm_msg", "LM Studio Offline")
        self.pill_lm.set_status(lm_ok, lm_msg)

        forge_ok = health.get("forge_ok", False)
        forge_msg = health.get("forge_msg", "SD Forge Offline")
        self.pill_forge.set_status(forge_ok, forge_msg)

        tts_ok = health.get("tts_ok", False)
        tts_msg = health.get("tts_msg", "F5-TTS Offline")
        self.pill_tts.set_status(tts_ok, tts_msg)

"""
Backend Status Indicator Pill for NeonRoute
Displays live connection states for LM Studio, SD Forge, and F5-TTS.

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QLabel


class StatusPill(QWidget):
    """
    Compact status badge with glowing LED indicator.
    """
    def __init__(self, name: str, port: int, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.name = name
        self.port = port
        self.is_online = False
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 2, 6, 2)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        # LED Indicator Dot
        self.dot = QLabel("●", self)
        self.dot.setStyleSheet("color: #EF4444; font-size: 11px;")
        layout.addWidget(self.dot)

        # Name & Port label
        self.label = QLabel(f"{self.name} ({self.port})", self)
        self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
        layout.addWidget(self.label)

        self.setStyleSheet("""
            background-color: #111622;
            border: 1px solid #1E273A;
            border-radius: 12px;
        """)

    def set_status(self, online: bool, message: str = ""):
        self.is_online = online
        if online:
            self.dot.setStyleSheet("color: #00FF66; font-size: 11px;")  # Neon lime/emerald
            self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #E2E8F0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
            self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} Online ({message or 'Ready'})")
        else:
            self.dot.setStyleSheet("color: #EF4444; font-size: 11px;")  # Neon red/coral
            self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
            self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} Offline: {message or 'Service unreachable'}")

"""
Typing Loader Indicator for NeonRoute
Displays a pulsing cyberpunk bubble while LLM, Translation, or Forge tasks are executing.
Adheres to Telegram/WhatsApp style with circular avatar and dynamic dancing dots.
"""

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel

from ui.components.chat_bubble import render_circular_avatar


class TypingLoaderWidget(QWidget):
    """
    Compact animated typing loader bubble in Telegram/WhatsApp style.
    Displays circular avatar of the sender on the left, a glassmorphic bubble with
    clean status text, and dynamically animated dancing dots.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        sender_name: str = "NeonRoute",
        action_text: str = "печатает",
        avatar_path: Optional[Path | str] = None,
        icon: Optional[str] = None,
        parent=None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.sender_name = sender_name
        # Clean action text of any static trailing dots and leading duplicate emojis
        clean_action = re.sub(r'[\.\s]+$', '', action_text).strip()
        self.action_text = clean_action
        self.avatar_path = Path(avatar_path) if avatar_path else None
        self.dot_count = 1

        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 4, 10, 4)
        layout.setSpacing(10)
        layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)

        # 1. Circular Avatar (36x36)
        self.avatar_lbl = QLabel(self)
        self.avatar_lbl.setFixedSize(36, 36)
        self.avatar_lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.avatar_lbl.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
        self.avatar_lbl.setPixmap(
            render_circular_avatar(
                avatar_path=self.avatar_path,
                name=self.sender_name,
                size=36,
                is_user=False
            )
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.avatar_lbl, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)

        # 2. Glassmorphic Bubble
        self.bubble = QFrame(self)
        self.bubble.setObjectName("TypingLoaderBubble")
        self.bubble.setStyleSheet("""
            #TypingLoaderBubble {
                background-color: rgba(28, 30, 38, 0.82);
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                border-radius: 16px;
                border-top-left-radius: 4px;
                padding: 8px 14px;
            }
        """)

        bubble_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.bubble)
        bubble_layout.setContentsMargins(4, 2, 4, 2)
        bubble_layout.setSpacing(4)

        self.lbl_text = QLabel(self.action_text, self.bubble)
        self.lbl_text.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: transparent;")
        bubble_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_text)

        self.lbl_dots = QLabel(".", self.bubble)
        self.lbl_dots.setFixedWidth(24)
        self.lbl_dots.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; background: transparent;")
        bubble_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_dots)

        layout.addWidget(self.bubble, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
        layout.addStretch(1)

        # Dynamic Animation timer (every 350 ms: . -> .. -> ... -> "")
        self.timer = QTimer(self)
        self.timer.timeout.connect(self._animate_tick)
        self.timer.start(350)

    def _animate_tick(self):
        self.dot_count = (self.dot_count + 1) % 4
        self.lbl_dots.setText("." * self.dot_count)

    def stop_animation(self):
        """Stops the animation timer cleanly."""
        self.cleanup()

    def cleanup(self):
        """Stops the animation timer cleanly."""
        if hasattr(self, "timer") and self.timer.isActive():
            self.timer.stop()

FILE: ui\components\bubbles\avatar_renderer.py (183 lines)

"""
Avatar and art pixmap rendering with rounded and circular masks and caching.
"""

import re
import logging
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Union

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QRect, QRectF
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QPixmap, QPainter, QPainterPath, QColor, QFont,
    QLinearGradient, QBrush, QPen
)

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.AvatarRenderer")

# Глобальный LRU-кэш для скругленных превью изображений
_IMAGE_CACHE_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE: dict[tuple[str, int], QPixmap] = {}


def render_rounded_art_pixmap(source_pix: QPixmap, radius: float = 14.0) -> QPixmap:
    if source_pix.isNull():
        return source_pix

    w = source_pix.width()
    h = source_pix.height()
    target = QPixmap(w, h)
    target.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)

    painter = QPainter(target)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)

    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addRoundedRect(QRectF(0, 0, float(w), float(h)), radius, radius)

    painter.setClipPath(path)
    painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, source_pix)

    painter.setClipping(False)
    painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 38), 1.0))
    painter.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(0.5, 0.5, float(w) - 1.0, float(h) - 1.0), radius, radius)
    painter.end()

    return target


def get_cached_art_pixmap(image_path: Path | str, target_size: int = 380, radius: float = 14.0) -> QPixmap:
    key = (str(image_path), target_size)
    with _IMAGE_CACHE_LOCK:
        if key in _IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE:
            return _IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE[key]

    p = Path(image_path)
    if not p.exists():
        return QPixmap()

    pix = QPixmap(str(p))
    if pix.isNull():
        return pix

    scaled = pix.scaled(
        target_size, target_size,
        Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
        Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
    )
    rounded = render_rounded_art_pixmap(scaled, radius=radius)
    with _IMAGE_CACHE_LOCK:
        if len(_IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE) > 60:
            _IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE.pop(next(iter(_IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE)))
        _IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE[key] = rounded
    return rounded


def render_circular_avatar(
    avatar_path: Optional[Path | str] = None,
    name: str = "Assistant",
    size: int = 64,
    is_user: bool = False,
    is_error: bool = False,
    image_path: Optional[Path | str] = None,
    text: Optional[str] = None
) -> QPixmap:
    if image_path is not None:
        avatar_path = image_path
    if text is not None:
        name = text

    scale_factor = 3
    render_size = size * scale_factor

    target = QPixmap(render_size, render_size)
    target.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)

    painter = QPainter(target)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)
    if hasattr(QPainter.RenderHint, "LosslessImageRendering"):
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.LosslessImageRendering, True)

    p_path = Path(avatar_path) if avatar_path else None
    loaded = False
    if p_path and p_path.exists():
        try:
            orig_pixmap = QPixmap(str(p_path))
            if not orig_pixmap.isNull():
                orig_w = orig_pixmap.width()
                orig_h = orig_pixmap.height()
                min_edge = min(orig_w, orig_h)
                if min_edge > 0:
                    crop_rect = QRect((orig_w - min_edge) // 2, (orig_h - min_edge) // 2, min_edge, min_edge)
                    square_pixmap = orig_pixmap.copy(crop_rect)
                    scaled_pixmap = square_pixmap.scaled(
                        render_size,
                        render_size,
                        Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                        Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
                    )

                    path = QPainterPath()
                    path.addEllipse(0.0, 0.0, float(render_size), float(render_size))
                    painter.fillPath(path, QBrush(scaled_pixmap))

                    border_width = 2.0 * scale_factor
                    half_border = border_width / 2.0
                    rim_rect = QRectF(half_border, half_border, float(render_size) - border_width, float(render_size) - border_width)
                    if is_error:
                        rim_pen = QPen(QColor(239, 68, 68, 180), border_width)
                    elif is_user:
                        rim_pen = QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 80), border_width)
                    else:
                        rim_pen = QPen(QColor(0, 240, 255, 140), border_width)

                    painter.setPen(rim_pen)
                    painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
                    painter.drawEllipse(rim_rect)
                    loaded = True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Failed to load avatar image: {e}")
            loaded = False

    if not loaded:
        grad = QLinearGradient(0, 0, render_size, render_size)
        if is_error:
            grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(220, 38, 38))
            grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(153, 27, 27))
            rim_col = QColor(239, 68, 68, 180)
        elif is_user:
            grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(99, 102, 241))
            grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(67, 56, 202))
            rim_col = QColor(255, 255, 255, 80)
        else:
            grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(14, 165, 233))
            grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(79, 70, 229))
            rim_col = QColor(0, 240, 255, 140)

        border_width = 2.0 * scale_factor
        half_border = border_width / 2.0
        rim_rect = QRectF(half_border, half_border, float(render_size) - border_width, float(render_size) - border_width)

        painter.setBrush(QBrush(grad))
        painter.setPen(QPen(rim_col, border_width))
        painter.drawEllipse(rim_rect)

        clean_name = re.sub(r'^[^\w\d]+', '', name.strip()) if name else ""
        if not clean_name:
            letter = "U" if is_user else ("!" if is_error else "N")
        else:
            letter = clean_name[0].upper()

        font_size = max(10 * scale_factor, int(render_size * 0.42))
        font = QFont("Inter", font_size, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        font.setFamilies(["Inter", "Segoe UI", "sans-serif"])
        painter.setFont(font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(255, 255, 255))
        painter.drawText(QRectF(0, 0, float(render_size), float(render_size)), Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, letter)

    painter.end()
    target.setDevicePixelRatio(scale_factor)
    return target

"""
Full-resolution image preview modal dialog with system viewer integration.
"""

import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPixmap
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QApplication
)


class ImagePreviewDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, image_path: Path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.image_path = Path(image_path)
        
        pixmap = QPixmap(str(self.image_path))
        orig_w = pixmap.width() if not pixmap.isNull() else 0
        orig_h = pixmap.height() if not pixmap.isNull() else 0
        file_sz_kb = self.image_path.stat().st_size / 1024 if self.image_path.exists() else 0
        sz_str = f"{file_sz_kb / 1024:.2f} MB" if file_sz_kb > 1024 else f"{file_sz_kb:.0f} KB"

        self.setWindowTitle(f"NeonRoute Preview — {self.image_path.name} ({orig_w}x{orig_h} • {sz_str})")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QDialog {
                background-color: #0A0D14;
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
            }
        """)
        screen = QApplication.primaryScreen()
        if screen:
            max_w = int(screen.size().width() * 0.85)
            max_h = int(screen.size().height() * 0.85)
        else:
            max_w = 1600
            max_h = 1000

        self.setMinimumSize(400, 300)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 16, 12)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        hdr_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        info_lbl = QLabel(f"🖼️ <b>Оригинал:</b> {orig_w}x{orig_h} px | <b>Размер:</b> {sz_str} | 100% Full-res PNG", self)
        info_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 12px;")
        hdr_layout.addWidget(info_lbl)
        hdr_layout.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(hdr_layout)

        img_label = QLabel(self)
        img_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        if not pixmap.isNull():
            scaled = pixmap.scaled(
                max_w, max_h,
                Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
            )
            img_label.setPixmap(scaled)
            self.resize(min(scaled.width() + 36, max_w), min(scaled.height() + 84, max_h))
        else:
            self.resize(850, 850)

        layout.addWidget(img_label, stretch=1)

        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout.setSpacing(10)

        open_sys_btn = QPushButton("📂 Открыть оригинал в Windows", self)
        open_sys_btn.setToolTip("Запустить исходный файл без потерь в штатном просмотрщике Windows")
        open_sys_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #050B14;
                font-weight: bold;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 6px 14px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #38F4FF;
            }
        """)

"""
Interactive file cards, console output spoilers, and generation info accordions.

import os
