class WorkspaceFileCardWidget(QFrame):
    run_script_requested = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, file_path: Path | str, on_run: Optional[Callable] = None, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.file_path = Path(file_path)
        self.on_run = on_run
        if on_run:
            self.run_script_requested.connect(on_run)
        self._init_ui()

    def _init_ui(self):
        self.setObjectName("WorkspaceFileCard")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#WorkspaceFileCard {
                background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35);
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 6px 10px;
                margin-top: 4px;
                margin-bottom: 4px;
            }
            QFrame#WorkspaceFileCard:hover {
                border-color: #00F0FF;
            }
        """)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(8, 6, 8, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        icon_lbl = QLabel(self)
        is_py = self.file_path.suffix.lower() == ".py"
        icon_lbl.setText("🐍" if is_py else "📄")
        icon_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 20px; background: transparent; border: none;")
        layout.addWidget(icon_lbl)

        info_layout = QVBoxLayout()
        info_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        info_layout.setSpacing(2)

        name_lbl = QLabel(self.file_path.name, self)
        name_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; background: transparent; border: none;")
        info_layout.addWidget(name_lbl)

        try:
            rel_path = self.file_path.relative_to(WORKSPACE_DIR)
            display_path = f"workspace / {rel_path}"
        except Exception:
            display_path = str(self.file_path)
            if len(display_path) > 40:
                display_path = "..." + display_path[-37:]

        path_lbl = QLabel(display_path, self)
        path_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px; background: transparent; border: none;")
        path_lbl.setToolTip(str(self.file_path))
        info_layout.addWidget(path_lbl)

        layout.addLayout(info_layout, stretch=1)

        btn_open = QPushButton("📂 В проводник", self)
        btn_open.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        btn_open.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8);
                color: #E2E8F0;
                border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 4px 8px;
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
        """)
        btn_open.clicked.connect(self._open_in_explorer)
        layout.addWidget(btn_open)

        if not is_py:
            btn_view = QPushButton("📄 Открыть", self)
            btn_view.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
            btn_view.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background-color: rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.7);
                    color: #34D399;
                    border: 1px solid #10B981;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    padding: 4px 8px;
                    font-size: 11px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: #10B981;
                    color: #022C22;
                }
            """)
            btn_view.clicked.connect(lambda: os.startfile(str(self.file_path.resolve())))
            layout.addWidget(btn_view)

        if is_py:
            self.btn_run = QPushButton("▶ Запустить", self)
            self.btn_run.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
            self.btn_run.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background-color: rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.7);
                    color: #34D399;
                    border: 1px solid #10B981;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    padding: 4px 8px;
                    font-size: 11px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: #10B981;
                    color: #022C22;
                }
            """)
            try:
                self.btn_run.clicked.disconnect()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.btn_run.clicked.connect(lambda: self.run_script_requested.emit(str(self.file_path)))
            layout.addWidget(self.btn_run)

    def _open_in_explorer(self):
        try:
            if self.file_path.exists():
                subprocess.Popen(f'explorer.exe /select,"{self.file_path.resolve()}"')
            else:
                parent_dir = self.file_path.parent
                if parent_dir.exists():
                    subprocess.Popen(f'explorer.exe "{parent_dir.resolve()}"')
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to open explorer for {self.file_path}: {e}")


class ConsoleOutputSpoilerWidget(QFrame):
    def __init__(
        self,
        title: str = "Консоль вывода",
        output: str = "",
        is_error: bool = False,
        return_code: int = 0,
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title = title
        self.output = output.strip() if output else "(нет вывода)"
        self.is_error = is_error or (return_code != 0)
        self.return_code = return_code
        self.is_expanded = True
        self._init_ui()

    def _init_ui(self):
        self.setObjectName("ConsoleSpoilerFrame")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#ConsoleSpoilerFrame {
                background-color: rgba(10, 14, 23, 0.9);
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
                border-radius: 6px;
                margin-top: 4px;
                margin-bottom: 4px;
            }
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(4)

        self.toggle_btn = QPushButton(self)
        self.toggle_btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self._update_header_text()
        self.toggle_btn.clicked.connect(self._toggle_collapse)
        layout.addWidget(self.toggle_btn)

        self.console_browser = SelectableTextBrowser(self)
        self.console_browser.setReadOnly(True)
        self.console_browser.setOpenExternalLinks(False)
        self.console_browser.setPlainText(self.output)
        self.console_browser.setStyleSheet("""
            QTextBrowser {
                background-color: #07090E;
                color: #A7F3D0;
                font-family: Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
                font-size: 11px;
                line-height: 1.4;
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 6px;
            }
        """ if not self.is_error else """
            QTextBrowser {
                background-color: #0E0709;
                color: #FCA5A5;
                font-family: Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
                font-size: 11px;
                line-height: 1.4;
                border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 6px;
            }
        """)

        line_count = max(len(self.output.splitlines()), 1)
        target_height = min(max(line_count * 18 + 16, 40), 220)
        self.console_browser.setFixedHeight(target_height)

        layout.addWidget(self.console_browser)
        self.console_browser.setVisible(self.is_expanded)

    def _update_header_text(self):
        arrow = "▼" if self.is_expanded else "▶"
        status_text = f"✔ Код: {self.return_code}" if not self.is_error else f"✖ Ошибка (код {self.return_code})"
        status_color = "#34D399" if not self.is_error else "#F87171"
        self.toggle_btn.setText(f"{arrow} [{self.title}]  •  {status_text}")
        self.toggle_btn.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QPushButton {{
                background-color: transparent;
                color: {status_color};
                text-align: left;
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: bold;
                border: none;
                padding: 3px 6px;
            }}
            QPushButton:hover {{
                color: #00F0FF;
            }}
        """)

    def _toggle_collapse(self):
        self.is_expanded = not self.is_expanded
        self.console_browser.setVisible(self.is_expanded)
        self._update_header_text()

"""
Roleplay Chat Message Bubble Component for NeonRoute.
Specialized bubble for Roleplay mode with status HUD, thought spoiler, and interactive choices.
"""

import html
import re
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List, Union, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtGui import QFont
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QPushButton

from ui.components.chat_bubble import ChatMessageWidget, SelectableTextBrowser
from ui.components.rpg_elements import (
    RPGBundle,
    RPGContentParser,
    RPGStatusWidget,
    RPGThoughtWidget,
    RPGChoicesWidget
)

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.RPChatBubble")

FILE_PATH_RE = re.compile(
    r'\b([a-zA-Z]:[/\\\\][a-zA-Z0-9_./\\\\-]+|workspace[/\\\\][a-zA-Z0-9_./\\\\-]+)'
)


class RPChatMessageWidget(ChatMessageWidget):
    """
    Специализированный бабл сообщений для ролевого режима (Tavern/RP).
    Инкапсулирует парсинг тегов <thought>, <stats>, <choices>, <meters>
    и интерактивные ролевые виджеты.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        sender: str,
        text: str,
        is_user: bool = False,
        is_error: bool = False,
        image_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        file_paths: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        audio_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        avatar_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        translated_text: Optional[str] = None,
        is_showing_translation: bool = False,
        font_size: int = 13,
        negative_prompt: Optional[str] = None,
        timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
        is_roleplay: bool = True,
        generation_params: Optional[dict] = None,
        visual_intent: Optional[dict] = None,
        message_id: Optional[str] = None,
        reply_to_id: Optional[str] = None,
        parent=None,
        **kwargs
    ):
        self.visual_intent: Optional[dict] = visual_intent
        self.art_source: Optional[str] = None
        self.btn_scene_art: Optional[QPushButton] = None
        self._pending_art_trigger = False
        self.rpg_status_widget: Optional[RPGStatusWidget] = None
        self.rpg_thought_widget: Optional[RPGThoughtWidget] = None
        self.rpg_choices_widget: Optional[RPGChoicesWidget] = None

        kwargs.pop("is_roleplay", None)
        super().__init__(
            sender=sender,
            text=text,
            is_user=is_user,
            is_error=is_error,
            image_path=image_path,
            file_paths=file_paths,
            audio_path=audio_path,
            avatar_path=avatar_path,
            translated_text=translated_text,
            is_showing_translation=is_showing_translation,
            font_size=font_size,
            negative_prompt=negative_prompt,
            timestamp=timestamp,
            is_roleplay=True,
            generation_params=generation_params,
            message_id=message_id,
            reply_to_id=reply_to_id,
            parent=parent,
            **kwargs
        )
        if visual_intent is not None:
            self.visual_intent = visual_intent
        self._setup_rp_widgets()

    def _markdown_to_html(self, text: str) -> str:
        if not text:
            return ""
        normalized_text = text.replace(chr(8232), '\n').replace(chr(8233), '\n').replace('\r\n', '\n')
        escaped = html.escape(normalized_text)
        escaped = RPGContentParser.format_inline_rpg_blocks(escaped)

        def code_block_sub(match):
            code = match.group(1)
            return f"<pre style='background-color:#080B11; border:1px solid #1E273A; border-radius:6px; padding:8px; color:#00F0FF; font-family:Consolas, monospace; white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word;'>{code}</pre>"
        escaped = re.sub(r'```(?:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)?\n(.*?)```', code_block_sub, escaped, flags=re.DOTALL)

        escaped = re.sub(r'`([^`]+)`', r"<code style='background-color:#141C2B; color:#38BDF8; padding:1px 4px; border-radius:4px; font-family:Consolas;'>\1</code>", escaped)

        def path_link_sub(match):
            raw_path = match.group(1)
            raw_path = re.sub(r'(&(?:#x27|#39|quot|amp|lt|gt);|[,.;:!?\"\'])*$', '', raw_path)
            norm_path = raw_path.replace('\\', '/')
            return f'<a href="file:///{norm_path}" style="color:#00F0FF; text-decoration:none;" title="Открыть в проводнике">{raw_path}</a>'

        escaped = FILE_PATH_RE.sub(path_link_sub, escaped)

        escaped = re.sub(r'\*\*(.*?)\*\*', r"<strong>\1</strong>", escaped)
        escaped = re.sub(r'\*([^*]+)\*', r"<em style='color:#A78BFA;'>*\1*</em>", escaped)

        escaped = re.sub(r'^### (.*)$', r"<h3 style='color:#38BDF8; margin-top:4px; margin-bottom:2px;'>\1</h3>", escaped, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        escaped = re.sub(r'^## (.*)$', r"<h2 style='color:#00F0FF; margin-top:5px; margin-bottom:2px;'>\1</h2>", escaped, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        escaped = re.sub(r'^# (.*)$', r"<h1 style='color:#F8FAFC; margin-top:6px; margin-bottom:3px;'>\1</h1>", escaped, flags=re.MULTILINE)

        escaped = escaped.replace('\n', '<br>')
        return f"""<div style="font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; overflow-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-word; margin: 0; padding: 0;">{escaped}</div>"""

    def _setup_rp_widgets(self):
        """Парсит и монтирует начальные RPG-виджеты при инициализации бабла."""
        if not self.bubble_container:
            return
        initial_text = self.translated_text if (self.is_showing_translation and self.translated_text) else self.raw_text
        if not initial_text:
            return

        bundle = RPGContentParser.parse(initial_text)
        bubble_layout = self.bubble_container.layout()
        if not bubble_layout:
            return

        # 1. Thought Spoiler
        if bundle.thought and not self.rpg_thought_widget:
            self.rpg_thought_widget = RPGThoughtWidget(bundle.thought, self.bubble_container)
            bubble_layout.insertWidget(1, self.rpg_thought_widget)

        # Обновляем основной текст чистым текстом без тегов
        if self.text_browser and bundle.clean_text != initial_text:
            self.text_browser.setHtml(self._markdown_to_html(bundle.clean_text))
            self._adjust_text_height()

        # 2. RPG Status HUD & Meters
        if (bundle.stats or bundle.meters) and not self.rpg_status_widget:
            self.rpg_status_widget = RPGStatusWidget(bundle.stats or {}, bundle.meters or {}, self.bubble_container)
            target_idx = bubble_layout.count() - 1 if not self.rpg_choices_widget else bubble_layout.indexOf(self.rpg_choices_widget)
            bubble_layout.insertWidget(max(1, target_idx), self.rpg_status_widget)

        # 3. Interactive Choices Buttons
        if bundle.choices and not self.rpg_choices_widget:
            self.rpg_choices_widget = RPGChoicesWidget(bundle.choices, self.bubble_container)
            self.rpg_choices_widget.choice_selected.connect(self.choice_selected.emit)
            bubble_layout.insertWidget(bubble_layout.count() - 1, self.rpg_choices_widget)

    def _update_rendered_text(self):
        current = self.translated_text if (self.is_showing_translation and self.translated_text) else self.original_text
        self.raw_text = current
        bundle = RPGContentParser.parse(current)

        if not getattr(self, "text_browser", None) and getattr(self, "bubble_container", None):
            self.text_browser = SelectableTextBrowser(self.bubble_container)
            self.text_browser.setReadOnly(True)
            self.text_browser.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
            self.text_browser.setOpenExternalLinks(False)
            self.text_browser.setOpenLinks(False)
            self.text_browser.anchorClicked.connect(self._on_anchor_clicked)
            self.text_browser.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
            self.text_browser.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
            self.text_browser.setTextInteractionFlags(
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByKeyboard |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.LinksAccessibleByMouse |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.LinksAccessibleByKeyboard
            )
            self.text_browser.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
            self.text_browser.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)

            font = QFont("Inter", self.font_size)
            font.setFamilies(["Inter", "Segoe UI", "sans-serif"])
            self.text_browser.setFont(font)
            if self.text_browser.document():
                self.text_browser.document().setDefaultFont(font)

            text_color = "#FCA5A5" if self.is_error else ("#FFFFFF" if self.is_user else "#F1F5F9")
            self.text_browser.setStyleSheet(f"""
                QTextBrowser {{
                    background-color: transparent;
                    color: {text_color};
                    border: none;
                    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
                    font-size: {self.font_size}px;
                    line-height: 1.18;
                    selection-background-color: #00F0FF;
                    selection-color: #000000;
                }}
            """)
            if self.bubble_container.layout():
                self.bubble_container.layout().insertWidget(1, self.text_browser)

        if self.text_browser:
            self.text_browser.setHtml(self._markdown_to_html(bundle.clean_text))
            self._update_bubble_geometry()
            self._adjust_text_height()

        layout = self.bubble_container.layout() if self.bubble_container else None

        # Manage Thoughts
        if bundle.thought:
            if not self.rpg_thought_widget:
                self.rpg_thought_widget = RPGThoughtWidget(bundle.thought, self.bubble_container)
                if layout:
                    layout.insertWidget(1, self.rpg_thought_widget)
        elif self.rpg_thought_widget:
            self.rpg_thought_widget.deleteLater()
            self.rpg_thought_widget = None

        # Manage Status & Meters
        if bundle.stats or bundle.meters:
            if not self.rpg_status_widget:
                self.rpg_status_widget = RPGStatusWidget(bundle.stats or {}, bundle.meters or {}, self.bubble_container)
                if layout:
                    target_idx = layout.count() - 1 if not self.rpg_choices_widget else layout.indexOf(self.rpg_choices_widget)
                    layout.insertWidget(max(1, target_idx), self.rpg_status_widget)
            else:
                self.rpg_status_widget.update_data(bundle.stats or {}, bundle.meters or {})
        elif self.rpg_status_widget:
            self.rpg_status_widget.deleteLater()
            self.rpg_status_widget = None

        # Manage Choices
        if bundle.choices:
            if not self.rpg_choices_widget:
                self.rpg_choices_widget = RPGChoicesWidget(bundle.choices, self.bubble_container)
                self.rpg_choices_widget.choice_selected.connect(self.choice_selected.emit)
                if layout:
                    layout.insertWidget(layout.count() - 1, self.rpg_choices_widget)
        elif self.rpg_choices_widget:
            self.rpg_choices_widget.deleteLater()
            self.rpg_choices_widget = None

"""
Assistant Flow & Turn Generation Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Handles Elaria dialogue dispatch, 14K context management, VRAM headroom adaptation,
LanceDB passive memory extraction, and Visual Engine protocol callbacks.
"""

import re
import random
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any

from services.session_manager import SessionManager, get_mode_profile
from services.regex_filter import TextRegexFilter
from services.task_queue import InferenceTask
from services.model_router import ModelRouter, normalize_model_choice
from services.art_director import VisualIntent, TargetSubject
from ui.components.chat_bubble import ChatMessageWidget

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.AssistantFlow")

RE_IMAGE_TAG = re.compile(r'\[IMAGE[\s_-]PROMPT:\s*([\s\S]*?)\]', re.IGNORECASE)


class AssistantFlowControllerMixin:
    """Изолированный контроллер диалогового цикла и логики режима «💬 Ассистент» (Элария)."""

    @staticmethod
    def _should_trigger_assistant_art(user_query: str) -> bool:
        """Проверяет наличие явных запросов на визуализацию для Эларии (без ролевых триггеров)."""
        q = (user_query or "").strip().lower()
        if not q:
            return False

        # Защита от ложных срабатываний на коде и документах
        exclusions = (
            "excel", "эксель", "таблиц", ".xlsx", "docx", "ворд", "word",
            "код", "скрипт", "pygame", "matplotlib", "график", "диаграмм",
            "баз данных", "sql", "функци", "класс", ".py"
        )
        if any(w in q for w in exclusions):
            return False

        explicit_triggers = (
            "нарисуй", "нарисуешь", "нарисовать",
            "сфотографируй", "сфоткай", "сделай фото", "сделай снимок", "сделай кадр",
            "сгенерируй", "сгенерируешь", "генерация арта",
            "изобрази", "изобразишь", "начерти", "начертишь",
            "иллюстрируй", "проиллюстрируй", "проиллюстрируешь",
            "отрисуй", "зарисуй", "набросай", "визуализируй",
            "сделай арт", "создай арт", "сделай картинку", "создай картинку", "покажи картинку",
            "покажи рисунок", "покажи арт", "нарисуй мне", "сделай портрет",
            "draw", "paint", "sketch", "render", "take a photo", "generate art"
        )
        return any(w in q for w in explicit_triggers)

    @staticmethod
    def _get_ephemeral_art_directive(target_model_id: str = "realistic", target_model_desc: str = "", is_roleplay: bool = False) -> str:
        model_hint = f"{target_model_id} ({target_model_desc})" if target_model_desc else target_model_id

        return (
            f"\n\n[SYSTEM DIRECTIVE: Image Generation for Stable Diffusion]\n"
            f"The user has requested an image. Act as an expert prompt engineer for Stable Diffusion.\n"
            f"Target model / aesthetic profile: {model_hint}.\n\n"
            f"Prompt Engineering Rules:\n"
            f"1. Tag Language: STRICTLY English.\n"
            f"2. Structure: Dense comma-separated keywords and short phrases (NO full sentences or conversational filler).\n"
            f"3. Word Order Priority:\n"
            f"   [Main subject & action] -> [Environment & location] -> [Lighting & mood] -> [Style & medium] -> [Camera angle / framing] -> [Quality modifiers].\n"
            f"4. Density: 35–60 evocative Danbooru/SD tags without fluff.\n"
            f"5. Framing Flag: Always append one aspect ratio flag to the end:\n"
            f"   --ar wide (landscapes, rooms, sceneries, architecture, vehicles)\n"
            f"   --ar portrait (standing characters, full body, outfits, vertical interactions/embrace)\n"
            f"   --ar square (face close-ups, selfies, busts, single small items)\n"
            f"6. Do NOT write negative prompts (injected automatically).\n\n"
            f"Output Format:\n"
            f"1. Respond to the user warmly and concisely in RUSSIAN (1-2 natural conversational sentences).\n"
            f"2. Output the generation tag strictly on a new line at the very end in this format:\n"
            f"[IMAGE_PROMPT: <comma-separated SD positive tags> --ar <wide|portrait|square> --model {target_model_id}]\n\n"
            f"Example ending:\n"
            f"Секунду, перевожу образ в кадр...\n"
            f"[IMAGE_PROMPT: 1girl, female samurai, holding katana, detailed traditional armor with cyberpunk accents, neo-tokyo street, night, heavy rain, wet pavement, puddles with neon reflections, dramatic rim light, cinematic lighting, upper body shot, photorealistic, 8k uhd, sharp focus --ar portrait --model {target_model_id}]"
        )

    def _enqueue_assistant_llm_task(
        self,
        is_excel: bool = False,
        is_word: bool = False,
        vision_content: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        art_guidance: Optional[str] = None
    ):
        """Формирует контекст Ассистента (14K) и передает задачу в TaskQueue."""
        self._requested_word_export = is_word
        self._requested_excel_export = is_excel

        if art_guidance is None:
            art_guidance = getattr(self, "_pre_routed_art_guidance", None)

        model_name = self.lm_combo.currentText().strip()
        if model_name.startswith("default"):
            model_name = None

        _req = getattr(self, "_current_user_request", "")
        if not _req and hasattr(self, "chat_history") and self.chat_history:
            for _h in reversed(self.chat_history):
                if _h.get("role") == "user":
                    _req = str(_h.get("content", ""))
                    break

        _should_art = (not vision_content and self._should_trigger_assistant_art(_req))

        mode_profile = get_mode_profile("assistant")
        base_history_limit = mode_profile.get("history_limit", 60)

        # ── ДИНАМИЧЕСКИЙ РАСЧЕТ БЮДЖЕТА ПАМЯТИ И ТОКЕНОВ ──
        if _should_art:
            effective_history_limit = 6
            effective_max_tokens = 512
            history_slice = self.chat_history[-effective_history_limit:] if len(self.chat_history) > effective_history_limit else self.chat_history
        else:
            free_vram = 4500
            if hasattr(self, "system_monitor") and self.system_monitor:
                try:
                    free_vram = self.system_monitor.get_free_vram_mb()
                except Exception:
                    free_vram = 4500

            if free_vram < 4200:
                effective_history_limit = max(12, int(base_history_limit * 0.4))
                effective_max_tokens = 512
            elif free_vram < 5500:
                effective_history_limit = max(20, int(base_history_limit * 0.7))
                effective_max_tokens = 768
            else:
                effective_history_limit = base_history_limit
                effective_max_tokens = mode_profile.get("sampling", {}).get("max_tokens", 1024)

            history_slice = self.chat_history[-effective_history_limit:] if len(self.chat_history) > effective_history_limit else self.chat_history

        curr_sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        sess_persona_id = self.current_session.get("user_persona_id") if self.current_session else None
        active_p = SessionManager.get_active_user_persona(is_roleplay=False, session_persona_id=sess_persona_id)
        effective_user_name = active_p.get("name") or "Пользователь"

        messages = SessionManager.get_lm_studio_messages(
            history=history_slice,
            is_roleplay=False,
            character_card=None,
            is_excel=is_excel,
            is_word=is_word,
            vision_content=vision_content,
            history_limit=effective_history_limit,
            user_name=effective_user_name,
            include_memory=(not _should_art),
            session_id=curr_sess_id,
            session_persona_id=sess_persona_id,
            is_engineer=False,
            world_facts=None,
            art_guidance=art_guidance,
            active_cast_block="",
            recalled_lore_block="",
            meta_context_block="",
            is_dm_mode=False
        )

        if _should_art:
            best_model_id = "realistic"
            best_desc = ""
            try:
                router = ModelRouter.get_instance() if hasattr(ModelRouter, "get_instance") else ModelRouter()
                matched_id, score = router.match_prompt(_req)
                if matched_id:
                    best_model_id = matched_id
                    for m in router.profiles:
                        if m.get("id") == matched_id:
                            guidance = (m.get("llm_guidance") or "").strip()
                            best_desc = guidance if guidance else (m.get("routing_description") or m.get("name") or "")
                            break
            except Exception:
                pass

            _directive = self._get_ephemeral_art_directive(target_model_id=best_model_id, target_model_desc=best_desc, is_roleplay=False)
            if _directive and messages:
                for idx in reversed(range(len(messages))):
                    if messages[idx].get("role") == "user":
                        user_msg_copy = dict(messages[idx])
                        _c = user_msg_copy.get("content")
                        if isinstance(_c, str):
                            user_msg_copy["content"] = _c + _directive
                        messages[idx] = user_msg_copy
                        break

        # ── ДВУХУРОВНЕВЫЙ СЭМПЛИНГ С ЗАЩИТОЙ ОТ МУТАЦИЙ РЕЖИМОВ ──
        sampling = (self.current_session.get("sampling_params") or {}) if self.current_session else {}
        is_custom = bool(self.current_session.get("is_custom_sampling", False)) if self.current_session else False

        cfg_defaults = getattr(self, "app_config", {}).get("default_sampling_assistant", {})
        prof_sampling = mode_profile.get("sampling", {})

        default_temp = cfg_defaults.get("temperature", prof_sampling.get("temperature", 0.70))
        default_min_p = cfg_defaults.get("min_p", prof_sampling.get("min_p", 0.05))
        default_rep_pen = cfg_defaults.get("repeat_penalty", prof_sampling.get("repeat_penalty", 1.05))
        default_max_tok = cfg_defaults.get("max_tokens", prof_sampling.get("max_tokens", 1024))

        if is_custom and "temperature" in sampling:
            temp = float(sampling.get("temperature", default_temp))
            min_p = float(sampling.get("min_p", default_min_p))
            rep_pen = float(sampling.get("repeat_penalty", default_rep_pen))
            user_max_tokens = sampling.get("max_tokens", default_max_tok)
            source_tag = f"Кастомный чат (PKM) [ID: {curr_sess_id}]"
        else:
            temp = float(default_temp)
            min_p = float(default_min_p)
            rep_pen = float(default_rep_pen)
            user_max_tokens = default_max_tok
            source_tag = "Глобальный дефолт config.json (или профиль режима)"

        target_max_tokens = int(user_max_tokens) if (user_max_tokens and not _should_art) else effective_max_tokens
        target_ctx_len = mode_profile.get("context_length", 14336)

        logger.info(
            f"[SamplingResolve] Режим 'assistant' | Сессия: {curr_sess_id} | "
            f"Источник: {source_tag} -> temp={temp}, min_p={min_p}, ctx={target_ctx_len}, max_tokens={target_max_tokens}"
        )

        llm_kwargs = {
            "messages": messages,
            "model": model_name,
            "temperature": temp,
            "stop": ["\n\nПользователь:", "\n\nUser:"],
            "is_roleplay": False,
            "is_engineer": False,
            "context_length": target_ctx_len,
            "max_tokens": target_max_tokens,
            "min_p": min_p,
            "repetition_penalty": rep_pen,
            "repeat_penalty": rep_pen,
            "stream": True
        }

        task = InferenceTask(
            name="LLM Ответ",
            task_type="llm",
            func=self.lm_client.chat_completion,
            kwargs=llm_kwargs,
            abort_fn=self.lm_client.abort,
            metadata={
                "is_excel": is_excel,
                "is_word": is_word,
                "is_roleplay": False,
                "has_vision": bool(vision_content)
            }
        )

        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _handle_assistant_llm_response(self, text: str):
        """Обрабатывает ответ Эларии, парсит арт-протокол, Ambiguity Gate и инициирует память."""
        img_match = RE_IMAGE_TAG.search(text)
        extracted_image_prompt = None
        if img_match:
            extracted_image_prompt = re.sub(r'^[\s\*_\-\#]+', '', img_match.group(1)).strip()
            clean_text = RE_IMAGE_TAG.sub('', text)
            clean_text = re.sub(r'(?:\n\s*)(?:Элария|Assistant|Пользователь|User)\s*:\s*$', '', clean_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            clean_text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', clean_text).strip()
            if not clean_text:
                clean_text = random.choice([
                    "Поймала образ. Сейчас соберу сцену... 🎨",
                    "Отличная задумка. Уже настраиваю рендер.",
                    "Секунду, перевожу мысль в кадр...",
                    "Взяла в работу. Сейчас покажу, как это выглядит."
                ])
            text = clean_text

        text = TextRegexFilter.process_output(text)
        text = re.sub(r'(?:\n|\s)*🔔\s*Напоминаю:[^\n]*', '', text).strip()
        text = re.sub(r'(?:\s*--(?:model|style|ar|neg|negative)\s+[^\n]+)+$', '', text, flags=re.I).strip()
        text = re.sub(r'(?:\*\*|__)?(?:Positive\s+Prompt|Позитивный\s+промпт)[:\s*]*', '', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()

        if not text:
            text = "Связь с моделью обновлена. Я готова, о чём поговорим?"

        sender_name = "Элария"
        avatar = self._get_current_avatar_path() if hasattr(self, "_get_current_avatar_path") else None

        msg_widget = getattr(self, "_turn_bubble", None)
        if msg_widget is not None:
            try:
                msg_widget.set_text(text)
            except (RuntimeError, AttributeError):
                msg_widget = None

        if msg_widget is None:
            try:
                msg_widget = self._append_message(sender_name, text, is_user=False, avatar_path=avatar)
                self._turn_bubble = msg_widget
            except (RuntimeError, AttributeError):
                logger.warning("[AssistantFlow] Не удалось отрисовать сообщение: UI чата пересоздается.")
                return

        self._sync_turn(role="assistant", content=text, replace_last=True)
        if hasattr(self, "_check_mode_lock"):
            self._check_mode_lock()

        # ── ОБРАБОТКА АРТ-ПРОТОКОЛА ──
        if extracted_image_prompt:
            raw_prompt = extracted_image_prompt.strip()
            router = ModelRouter.get_instance() if hasattr(ModelRouter, "get_instance") else ModelRouter()
            active_models = {
                str(m.get("id", "")).lower().strip(): m.get("id")
                for m in router.profiles if m.get("active", True) and m.get("id")
            }

            model_match = re.search(r'(?:--model|--style)[:=\s]+["\']?([a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+)["\']?', raw_prompt, re.I)
            llm_style = model_match.group(1).lower().strip() if model_match else None
            raw_prompt = re.sub(r'(?:--model|--style)[:=\s]+["\']?[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+["\']?', '', raw_prompt, flags=re.I).strip(' ,')

            neg_match = re.search(r'(?:--neg|--negative)[:=\s]+(.*?)(?=(?:--model|--style|--ar|$))', raw_prompt, re.I)
            custom_neg = neg_match.group(1).strip().strip(' ,') if neg_match else ""
            raw_prompt = re.sub(r'(?:--neg|--negative)[:=\s]+.*?(?=(?:--model|--style|--ar|$))', '', raw_prompt, flags=re.I).strip(' ,')

            ar_match = re.search(r'--ar[:=\s]+([a-zA-Z0-9:]+)', raw_prompt, re.I)
            extracted_ar = ar_match.group(1).lower().strip() if ar_match else None
            raw_prompt = re.sub(r'--ar[:=\s]+[a-zA-Z0-9:]+', '', raw_prompt, flags=re.I).strip(' ,')

            # Разрешение модели: если в GUI выбран конкретный чекпоинт — передаем его, иначе None (для роутера)
            norm_combo = normalize_model_choice(getattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint", None))
            if norm_combo:
                effective_style = norm_combo
            elif llm_style and llm_style in active_models:
                effective_style = active_models[llm_style]
            else:
                effective_style = None

            # Извлечение исходного запроса пользователя
            last_req = getattr(self, "_current_user_request", "").strip()
            if not last_req and hasattr(self, "chat_history") and self.chat_history:
                for _h in reversed(self.chat_history):
                    if _h.get("role") == "user":
                        last_req = str(_h.get("content", "")).strip()
                        break
            low_u = last_req.lower()

            # Безопасное определение автопортрета (отсекаем вежливое обращение по имени)
            clean_user_intent = re.sub(r'^\s*элари[яею]?\b[\s,:-]*', '', low_u, flags=re.I).strip()
            is_self_portrait = bool(
                any(k in clean_user_intent for k in (
                    "себя", "твой портрет", "свой портрет", "твой образ", "свой образ",
                    "как ты выглядишь", "сделай селфи", "твое селфи", "твоё селфи", "автопортрет"
                ))
                or re.search(r'\b(нарисуй|покажи|изобрази)\s+элари[юея]\b', low_u, re.I)
                or re.search(r'\b(elaria|элария)\b', raw_prompt, re.I)
            )

            # Определение сида (Seed Lock)
            last_gen = getattr(self, "_last_art_meta", {}) or (
                self.current_session.get("last_generation", {}) if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else {}
            )
            base_seed = last_gen.get("seed", -1)
            is_seed_lock = bool(base_seed and base_seed > 0 and (
                any(k in low_u for k in [
                    "такую же", "такой же", "такое же", "ту же", "тот же",
                    "в той же позе", "в этой же позе", "в том же ракурсе",
                    "оставь как есть", "оставь позу", "оставь лицо",
                    "то же самое", "тоже самое"
                ]) or
                re.search(r'\bповтори\b', low_u)
            ))
            target_seed = base_seed if is_seed_lock else -1

            target_subject = TargetSubject.ELARIA if is_self_portrait else TargetSubject.SCENE_OBJECT

            v_intent = VisualIntent(
                prompt=raw_prompt,
                target_subject=target_subject,
                user_neg=custom_neg,
                suggested_model=effective_style,
                seed=target_seed,
                aspect_ratio=extracted_ar,
                raw_user_query=last_req,
                session_id=self.current_session.get("id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None,
                mode="assistant"
            )
            msg_widget.visual_intent = v_intent

            target_char = "Элария" if is_self_portrait else None

            auto_art = self.app_config.get("auto_generate_art", False)
            if auto_art and hasattr(self, "pill_forge") and self.pill_forge.is_online:
                self._on_scene_art_requested(visual_intent=v_intent, widget=msg_widget, preferred_style=effective_style, character_name=target_char)
            else:
                msg_widget.add_art_proposal_chip(
                    raw_prompt,
                    lambda v=v_intent, w=msg_widget, s=effective_style, c=target_char: self._on_scene_art_requested(visual_intent=v, widget=w, preferred_style=s, character_name=c)
                )

        self._turn_bubble = None
        if not extracted_image_prompt:
            self._trigger_assistant_memory_extraction()
        self._current_user_request = ""

    def _trigger_assistant_memory_extraction(self):
        """Асинхронно извлекает долгосрочные факты о пользователе в LanceDB (CPU ONNX)."""
        if getattr(self, "_is_initializing", False) or getattr(self, "_is_switching_session", False):
            return
        if not getattr(self, "chat_history", None) or len(self.chat_history) < 2:
            return

        messages = self.current_session.get("messages", []) if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else []
        if not messages or len(messages) < 2:
            return

        try:
            from services.memory_extractor import MemoryExtractor
            MemoryExtractor.extract_facts_async(messages, context=self)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[AssistantFlow] Ошибка вызова экстракции памяти: {e}")

"""
Avatar & Persona Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Handles avatar context menu actions, lightbox popups, avatar path resolution,
interactive cropping, permanent avatar updates, and turn-based emotional expression switching
across all 3 UI zones (Header, Chat Bubbles, Sidebar) and all 3 application modes.
"""

import shutil
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, Dict, Any, Union

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QPoint, QRect, QSize
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPixmap, QIcon, QAction, QCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QMenu, QFileDialog, QMessageBox, QApplication, QLabel

import config
from config import CHARACTERS_DIR
ASSETS_DIR = getattr(config, "ASSETS_DIR", getattr(config, "BASE_DIR", Path(".")) / "assets")
from services.session_manager import SessionManager
from ui.dialogs.avatar_lightbox_dialog import AvatarLightboxDialog
from ui.components.chat_bubble import render_circular_avatar

try:
    from ui.dialogs.avatar_crop_dialog import AvatarCropDialog
except ImportError:
    AvatarCropDialog = None

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.AvatarController")


class AvatarControllerMixin:
    """
    Единый миксин управления аватарами для MainWindow.
    Синхронизирует 3 зоны: Шапку (верх), Баблы (чат), Сайдбар (боковое меню диалогов).
    """

    # =========================================================================
    # 1. Разрешение путей к аватарам (Resolution)
    # =========================================================================

    def _get_current_avatar_path(self) -> Optional[Path]:
        """
        Строго сессионное разрешение аватарки собеседника для всех 3 режимов.
        Никогда не вызывает утечек между сессиями или режимами.
        """
        mode = getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant")
        sess = getattr(self, "current_session", None)

        # 1. Режим 'Ролевой чат'
        if mode == "roleplay":
            # А. Активный эмоциональный спрайт текущей сессии
            if sess and sess.get("current_emotion_avatar"):
                p_emo = Path(sess["current_emotion_avatar"])
                if p_emo.exists():
                    return p_emo
            # Б. Сессионный аватар карточки
            if sess and sess.get("character_data"):
                av = sess["character_data"].get("avatar_path")
                if av and Path(av).exists():
                    return Path(av)
            # В. Базовый аватар из объекта карточки
            if getattr(self, "active_character", None) and getattr(self.active_character, "avatar_path", None):
                p_card = Path(self.active_character.avatar_path)
                if p_card.exists():
                    return p_card
            return None

        # 2. Режим 'Инженер'
        is_eng = getattr(self, "_engineering_mode_active", False) or (
            hasattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active") and self.is_engineer_mode_active()
        )
        if is_eng:
            if sess:
                sess_av = sess.get("assistant_avatar_path")
                if sess_av and Path(sess_av).exists():
                    return Path(sess_av)
            for cand in (ASSETS_DIR / "elaria_engineer.png", ASSETS_DIR / "elaria_avatar.png", CHARACTERS_DIR / "elaria.png"):
                if cand.exists():
                    return cand
            return None

        # 3. Режим 'Ассистент' (Диалог)
        if sess:
            sess_av = sess.get("assistant_avatar_path")
            if sess_av and Path(sess_av).exists():
                return Path(sess_av)
        for cand in (ASSETS_DIR / "elaria_avatar.png", CHARACTERS_DIR / "elaria.png"):
            if cand.exists():
                return cand
        return None

    def _get_user_avatar_path(self) -> Optional[Path]:
        """Разрешает аватар активной персоны пользователя."""
        sess_persona_id = self.current_session.get("user_persona_id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None
        persona = SessionManager.get_active_user_persona(
            is_roleplay=(getattr(self, "current_mode", "") == "roleplay"),
            session_persona_id=sess_persona_id
        )
        av = persona.get("avatar_path")
        if av and Path(av).exists():
            return Path(av)

        for ext in (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"):
            cand = CHARACTERS_DIR / f"user_avatar{ext}"
            if cand.exists():
                return cand
        return None

    # =========================================================================
    # 2. Синхронизация аватаров по 3-м зонам UI
    # =========================================================================

    def _update_expression_avatar(self, sprite_path: Union[str, Path]):
        """
        Динамическое переключение эмоционального спрайта персонажа (Turn Expression):
        - Зона 1 (Шапка): мгновенно показывает текущую эмоцию.
        - Зона 2 (Чат): обновляет ТОЛЬКО текущий бабл сообщения (_turn_bubble). Прошлые баблы сохраняют свои эмоции!
        - Зона 3 (Сайдбар): обновляет иконку текущего диалога в левом списке.
        Базовый файл карточки на диске НЕ затрагивается.
        """
        if not sprite_path or not getattr(self, "current_session", None):
            return
        p = Path(sprite_path)
        if not p.exists():
            return

        str_path = str(p.resolve())
        is_rp = (getattr(self, "current_mode", "") == "roleplay" and getattr(self, "active_character", None))
        char_name = self.active_character.name if is_rp else "Элария"

        # Зона 1: Шапка (верхнее окно)
        if hasattr(self, "header_avatar_lbl") and self.header_avatar_lbl:
            round_pix = render_circular_avatar(str_path, char_name, size=48, is_user=False)
            self.header_avatar_lbl.setPixmap(round_pix)
            self.header_avatar_lbl.setText("")

        # Зона 2: Бабл сообщения текущего хода
        if getattr(self, "_turn_bubble", None) is not None:
            try:
                self._turn_bubble.update_avatar(str_path)
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Зона 3: Элемент диалога в левом сайдбаре
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id")
        if sess_id and hasattr(self, "_session_items") and sess_id in self._session_items:
            _, item_widget = self._session_items[sess_id]
            item_widget.update_mode(getattr(self, "current_mode", "roleplay"), char_name, str_path)

        # Сохранение активной эмоции СТРОГО в текущую сессию
        self.current_session["current_emotion_avatar"] = str_path
        if "messages" in self.current_session and self.current_session["messages"]:
            for m in reversed(self.current_session["messages"]):
                if not m.get("is_user"):
                    m["avatar_path"] = str_path
                    break
        self._save_current_session()

    # Алиас для обратной совместимости
    _update_companion_expression = _update_expression_avatar

    def _propagate_avatar_update(self, new_avatar_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]]):
        """
        Постоянная смена аватара в сессии (пользователь выбрал новый файл):
        - Зона 1: Шапка чата.
        - Зона 2: ВСЕ баблы сообщений собеседника в активном чате.
        - Зона 3: Иконка текущего диалога в левом сайдбаре.
        """
        p_str = str(Path(new_avatar_path).resolve()) if new_avatar_path and Path(new_avatar_path).exists() else None

        # Зона 1: Шапка
        if hasattr(self, "header_avatar_lbl") and self.header_avatar_lbl:
            title = self.header_name_lbl.text() if hasattr(self, "header_name_lbl") else "Элария"
            round_pix = render_circular_avatar(p_str, title, size=48, is_user=False)
            self.header_avatar_lbl.setPixmap(round_pix)
            self.header_avatar_lbl.setText("")

        if hasattr(self, "_update_header_for_current_state"):
            self._update_header_for_current_state()

        # Зона 2: Все баблы чата
        if hasattr(self, "chat_layout"):
            from ui.components.chat_bubble import ChatMessageWidget
            for i in range(self.chat_layout.count()):
                item = self.chat_layout.itemAt(i)
                w = item.widget() if item else None
                if w and isinstance(w, ChatMessageWidget) and not getattr(w, "is_user", True):
                    w.update_avatar(p_str)

        # Зона 3: Элемент в сайдбаре
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None
        if sess_id and hasattr(self, "_session_items") and sess_id in self._session_items:
            _, item_widget = self._session_items[sess_id]
            is_rp = (getattr(self, "current_mode", "") == "roleplay" and getattr(self, "active_character", None))
            char_name = self.active_character.name if is_rp else "Элария"
            item_widget.update_mode(getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant"), char_name, p_str)

        # Синхронизация сохранённых сообщений сессии
        if getattr(self, "current_session", None) and "messages" in self.current_session:
            for m in self.current_session["messages"]:
                if not m.get("is_user"):
                    m["avatar_path"] = p_str
            self._save_current_session()

    # =========================================================================
    # 3. Интерактивная смена и сброс аватара
    # =========================================================================

    def _on_change_avatar_clicked(self):
        try:
            self._change_character_avatar()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error in _on_change_avatar_clicked: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def _change_character_avatar(self):
        """Интерактивный выбор и кадрирование аватара строго в контексте текущей сессии."""
        if not getattr(self, "current_session", None):
            return

        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Выберите аватарку", "", "Изображения (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp)"
        )
        if not file_path:
            return
        p = Path(file_path)
        if not p.exists():
            return

        avatars_dir = CHARACTERS_DIR / "session_avatars"
        avatars_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id", "temp")
        is_rp = (getattr(self, "current_mode", "") == "roleplay" and getattr(self, "active_character", None))
        prefix = "rp" if is_rp else "asst"
        dest_path = (avatars_dir / f"sess_{sess_id}_{prefix}.png").resolve()

        cropped_saved = False
        try:
            from ui.dialogs.avatar_crop_dialog import AvatarCropDialog
            if AvatarCropDialog:
                crop_dlg = AvatarCropDialog(source_image_path=str(p), destination_path=str(dest_path), parent=self)
                if crop_dlg.exec():
                    if dest_path.exists() and dest_path.stat().st_size > 0:
                        cropped_saved = True
                else:
                    return
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Crop dialog fallback: {e}")

        if not cropped_saved or not dest_path.exists():
            try:
                pix = render_circular_avatar(str(p), size=256)
                pix.save(str(dest_path), "PNG")
                cropped_saved = True
            except Exception:
                shutil.copy2(p, dest_path)
                cropped_saved = True

        abs_dest_str = str(dest_path.resolve())

        if is_rp:
            char_name = self.active_character.name or "Персонаж"
            cd = self.current_session.setdefault("character_data", {})
            cd["avatar_path"] = abs_dest_str
            self.current_session["current_emotion_avatar"] = abs_dest_str
            self._save_current_session()
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Аватар для чата '{char_name}' обновлен.", 4000)
        else:
            self.current_session["assistant_avatar_path"] = abs_dest_str
            self._save_current_session()
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Аватар ассистента для этого чата обновлен.", 4000)

        if hasattr(self, "header_controller") and self.header_controller:
            self.header_controller.sync_context(self.current_mode, self.active_character, self.current_session)
        self._propagate_avatar_update(dest_path)

    def _on_reset_avatar_clicked(self):
        try:
            self._reset_character_avatar()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error in _on_reset_avatar_clicked: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def _reset_character_avatar(self):
        """Сброс аватара строго в рамках текущей сессии к дефолтному."""
        if not getattr(self, "current_session", None):
            return

        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id")
        self.current_session["current_emotion_avatar"] = None

        if getattr(self, "current_mode", "") == "roleplay":
            orig_av = None
            if getattr(self, "active_character", None) and getattr(self.active_character, "avatar_path", None):
                orig_av = str(Path(self.active_character.avatar_path).resolve())

            cd = self.current_session.setdefault("character_data", {})
            cd["avatar_path"] = orig_av
            self._save_current_session()

            char_name = self.active_character.name if self.active_character else "Персонаж"
            if sess_id and hasattr(self, "_session_items") and sess_id in self._session_items:
                _, item_w = self._session_items[sess_id]
                item_w.update_mode("roleplay", char_name, orig_av)

            self._propagate_avatar_update(Path(orig_av) if orig_av else None)
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Аватар персонажа '{char_name}' сброшен к исходному.", 4000)
        else:
            self.current_session["assistant_avatar_path"] = None
            self._save_current_session()

            if sess_id and hasattr(self, "_session_items") and sess_id in self._session_items:
                _, item_w = self._session_items[sess_id]
                item_w.update_mode("assistant", "Элария", None)

            self._propagate_avatar_update(None)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Аватар ассистента в этом чате сброшен.", 4000)

    # =========================================================================
    # 4. Меню и просмотр аватара
    # =========================================================================

    def _open_avatar_lightbox(self, avatar_path: Path):
        try:
            dlg = AvatarLightboxDialog(avatar_path, self)
            dlg.showFullScreen()
            dlg.exec()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error opening avatar lightbox: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def _on_header_avatar_mouse_press(self, event):
        if hasattr(self, "header_avatar_lbl") and hasattr(self.header_avatar_lbl, "reset_hover"):
            self.header_avatar_lbl.reset_hover()
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            av_path = self._get_current_avatar_path()
            if av_path and av_path.exists():
                self._open_avatar_lightbox(av_path)
            else:
                self._show_avatar_menu(QPoint(0, self.header_avatar_lbl.height()))
        elif event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.RightButton:
            self._show_avatar_menu(QPoint(0, self.header_avatar_lbl.height()))
        else:
            QLabel.mousePressEvent(self.header_avatar_lbl, event)

    def _show_avatar_menu(self, pos):
        try:
            menu = QMenu(self)
            self._active_avatar_menu = menu
            menu.setStyleSheet("""
                QMenu {
                    background-color: rgba(24, 26, 34, 0.94);
                    color: #F1F5F9;
                    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
                    border-radius: 8px;
                    padding: 6px;
                }
                QMenu::item {
                    padding: 6px 18px;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    font-size: 12px;
                }
                QMenu::item:selected {
                    background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.16);
                    color: #00F0FF;
                }
                QMenu::separator {
                    height: 1px;
                    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
                    margin: 4px 6px;
                }
            """)

            act_change = menu.addAction("🖼️ Изменить аватар...")
            act_change.triggered.connect(self._on_change_avatar_clicked)

            act_sampling = menu.addAction("⚙️ Настройки модели...")
            act_sampling.triggered.connect(self._open_model_sampling_dialog)

            act_search = menu.addAction("🔍 Поиск по сообщениям")
            act_search.triggered.connect(self._on_search_clicked)

            act_media = menu.addAction("🖼️ Медиа галерея")
            act_media.triggered.connect(self._on_media_clicked)

            act_files = menu.addAction("📂 Файлы чата в проводнике")
            act_files.triggered.connect(self._on_open_chat_files_clicked)

            menu.addSeparator()

            act_reset = menu.addAction("❌ Сбросить аватар")
            act_reset.triggered.connect(self._on_reset_avatar_clicked)

            if getattr(self, "current_mode", "") == "roleplay":
                act_rename = menu.addAction("✏️ Переименовать...")
                act_rename.triggered.connect(self._on_rename_clicked)

            target_widget = getattr(self, "header_avatar_lbl", None)
            if target_widget and hasattr(target_widget, "reset_hover"):
                target_widget.reset_hover()
            if isinstance(pos, QPoint) and target_widget:
                global_pos = target_widget.mapToGlobal(pos)
            else:
                global_pos = QCursor.pos()

            menu.exec(global_pos)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error opening avatar menu: {e}", exc_info=True)

    _show_header_context_menu = _show_avatar_menu

"""
Chat Flow & Generation Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Handles message dispatch, context & system prompt formulation, streaming chunk processing,
