        self.pill_tts.set_status(tts_ok, tts_msg)

    def _toggle_forge_server(self):
        if self.process_manager.is_forge_running() or self.pill_forge.is_online:
            self._forge_launching = False
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Остановка SD WebUI Forge и освобождение VRAM...")
            self.process_manager.stop_forge_async()
            self.btn_forge_toggle.setText("▶ Запустить Forge")
        else:
            self._forge_launching = True
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Запуск SD WebUI Forge (C:\\neyroGPD\\forge_launcher.bat)...")
            self.btn_forge_toggle.setText("⏳ Запуск Forge... (ожидание 7860)")
            self.btn_forge_toggle.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background-color: #2D2311;
                    color: #FBBF24;
                    border: 1px solid #F59E0B;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    padding: 2px 9px;
                    font-size: 11px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: #F59E0B;
                    color: #050B14;
                }
            """)
            self.process_manager.start_forge_async()

    def _toggle_lms_server(self):
        if self.process_manager.is_lm_studio_running() or self.pill_lm.is_online:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Остановка LM Studio сервера...")
            if hasattr(self, "_cancel_lms_reload") and callable(self._cancel_lms_reload):
                self._cancel_lms_reload()
            if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
                self.task_queue.abort_current()
                if hasattr(self.task_queue, "clear_queue") and callable(self.task_queue.clear_queue):
                    self.task_queue.clear_queue()
            if hasattr(self, "lm_client") and self.lm_client:
                self.lm_client.abort()
            self.process_manager.stop_lm_studio_async()
        else:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Запуск LM Studio сервера (lms server start)...")
            self.process_manager.start_lm_studio_async()

    def _on_process_action_completed(self, action_name: str, success: bool, message: str):
        if "lms_load" in action_name:
            if not self.is_busy:
                self.btn_send.setEnabled(True)
            if success:
                # Синхронизация состояния синглтона LMStudioClient для исключения повторного сброса
                if hasattr(self, "lm_client") and self.lm_client and getattr(self, "active_lms_model", ""):
                    self.lm_client._last_loaded_model_id = self.active_lms_model
                    self.lm_client._is_model_unloaded = False
                    is_rp = (getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant") == "roleplay")
                    is_eng = getattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active", lambda: False)()
                    m_key = "engineer" if is_eng else ("roleplay" if is_rp else "assistant")
                    def_ctx = 28672 if is_eng else (24576 if is_rp else 14336)
                    self.lm_client._current_loaded_ctx = self.app_config.get(f"context_length_{m_key}", def_ctx)
                self.statusBar().showMessage(f"✅ Модель '{self.active_lms_model}' готова к работе.", 5000)
            else:
                self.statusBar().showMessage(f"⚠️ {message}", 6000)
        elif action_name == "lms_load_fallback":
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"⚠️ {message}", 7000)
            self._append_message("Система", f"⚠️ **Внимание:** {message}", is_user=False, is_error=True)
            return
        elif action_name == "lms_stop":
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)
            self.pill_lm.set_status(False, "LM Studio Offline")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setText("⚡ Старт LLM")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background-color: #111A28;
                    color: #00F0FF;
                    border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    padding: 2px 7px;
                    font-size: 11px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: #00F0FF;
                    color: #050B14;
                }
            """)
        elif action_name == "lms_start" and success:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)
            QTimer.singleShot(1500, self._refresh_models)
        elif "lms" in action_name and success:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)
        elif "forge" in action_name:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)
            if not success:
                self._forge_launching = False
            else:
                QTimer.singleShot(3000, self._refresh_forge_models)
        else:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)

    def _on_hardware_stats(self, stats: dict):
        v_used = stats.get("vram_used_mb", 0)
        v_total = stats.get("vram_total_mb", 8192)
        v_pct = stats.get("vram_percent", 0.0)
        temp = stats.get("gpu_temp_c")
        temp_str = f" • {temp}°C" if temp else ""

        color = "#00FF66" if v_used < 5500 else ("#FFE600" if v_used < 7200 else "#FF007F")
        self.lbl_vram.setText(f"VRAM: {v_used} / {v_total} MB ({v_pct}%){temp_str}")
        self.lbl_vram.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 15px;")

        r_used = stats.get("ram_used_gb", 0.0)
        r_total = stats.get("ram_total_gb", 16.0)
        r_pct = stats.get("ram_percent", 0.0)
        self.lbl_ram.setText(f"RAM: {r_used} / {r_total} GB ({r_pct}%)")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Обнаружение, выбор и настройка моделей
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _refresh_models(self):
        if getattr(self, "_discovery_worker", None) and self._discovery_worker.isRunning():
            return
        self.btn_refresh_models.setEnabled(False)
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Поиск доступных моделей в фоне...", 2000)
        self._discovery_worker = ModelDiscoveryWorker(self.process_manager, self.lm_client, self.forge_client)
        self._discovery_worker.lms_models_ready.connect(self._on_lms_models_discovered)
        self._discovery_worker.forge_models_ready.connect(self._on_forge_models_discovered)
        self._discovery_worker.start()

    def _on_lms_models_discovered(self, all_models: list):
        self.btn_refresh_models.setEnabled(True)
        self._is_refreshing_models = True
        try:
            current_choice = self.lm_combo.currentText().strip()
            self.lm_combo.blockSignals(True)
            self.lm_combo.clear()
            if all_models:
                self.lm_combo.addItems(all_models)
                target = current_choice or self.active_lms_model or all_models[0]
                idx = self.lm_combo.findText(target)
                if idx >= 0:
                    self.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
                else:
                    self.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)
            else:
                self.lm_combo.addItem("default (авто)")
            self.lm_combo.blockSignals(False)
            if all_models:
                self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Список моделей LM Studio обновлен ({len(all_models)} доступно).", 2500)
        finally:
            self._is_refreshing_models = False
            if hasattr(self, "models_refreshed"):
                self.models_refreshed.emit()

    def _on_lms_model_activated(self, index: int):
        if self._is_refreshing_models:
            return
        model_name = self.lm_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not model_name or model_name.startswith("default"):
            return

        self.active_lms_model = model_name
        self.app_config["active_model"] = model_name
        ConfigManager.save_config(self.app_config)

        if self.current_session and not self.current_session.get("is_model_locked", False):
            self.current_session["model_id"] = model_name
            self._save_current_session()

        self.btn_send.setEnabled(False)
        self.statusBar().showMessage(f"⏳ Загрузка модели '{model_name}' в память...")
        device_mode = self.app_config.get("compute_device_mode", "Auto")
        self.process_manager.load_lms_model_async(model_name, device_mode=device_mode)

    def _refresh_forge_models(self):
        if getattr(self, "_discovery_worker", None) and self._discovery_worker.isRunning():
            return
        self._discovery_worker = ModelDiscoveryWorker(self.process_manager, self.lm_client, self.forge_client)
        self._discovery_worker.lms_models_ready.connect(self._on_lms_models_discovered)
        self._discovery_worker.forge_models_ready.connect(self._on_forge_models_discovered)
        self._discovery_worker.start()

    def _on_forge_model_changed(self, text: str):
        self.selected_forge_checkpoint = text
        if text.startswith("✨"):
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Режим генерации: ✨ Арт-директор (Авто)", 3000)
        else:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Модель для генерации зафиксирована: {text}", 4000)

    def _on_forge_models_discovered(self, items: list):
        base_choices = [
            "✨ Арт-директор (Авто)",
            "DreamShaper 8",
            "Realistic Vision v6.0",
            "CyberRealistic Classic",
            "MeinaHentai v5"
        ]
        combined = list(base_choices)
        if hasattr(self, "art_director") and self.art_director and hasattr(self.art_director, "router") and self.art_director.router:
            for prof in getattr(self.art_director.router, "profiles", []):
                if isinstance(prof, dict) and prof.get("active", True):
                    m_name = prof.get("name")
                    if m_name and m_name not in combined and not str(m_name).startswith("✨"):
                        combined.append(m_name)
        if items:
            for it in items:
                if it not in combined and not it.startswith("✨"):
                    combined.append(it)
        self.available_forge_checkpoints = combined
        if hasattr(self, "forge_combo"):
            cur = self.forge_combo.currentText()
            self.forge_combo.blockSignals(True)
            self.forge_combo.clear()
            self.forge_combo.addItems(combined)
            idx = self.forge_combo.findText(cur)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.forge_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            self.forge_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _select_forge_model_dialog(self):
        base_choices = [
            "✨ Арт-директор (Авто)",
            "DreamShaper 8",
            "Realistic Vision v6.0",
            "CyberRealistic Classic",
            "MeinaHentai v5"
        ]
        items = list(getattr(self, "available_forge_checkpoints", base_choices))
        for bc in base_choices:
            if bc not in items:
                items.append(bc)

        current_idx = 0
        if hasattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint") and self.selected_forge_checkpoint in items:
            current_idx = items.index(self.selected_forge_checkpoint)

        chosen, ok = QInputDialog.getItem(
            self,
            "Выбор чекпоинта SD WebUI Forge",
            "Выберите модель Forge (или оставьте Авто для Арт-директора):",
            items,
            current_idx,
            False
        )
        if ok and chosen:
            self.selected_forge_checkpoint = chosen
            if hasattr(self, "forge_combo"):
                self.forge_combo.blockSignals(True)
                idx = self.forge_combo.findText(chosen)
                if idx >= 0:
                    self.forge_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
                self.forge_combo.blockSignals(False)
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Выбрана модель Forge: {chosen}", 5000)


    def _open_models_manager_dialog(self):
        dialog = ModelsManagerDialog(self.forge_client, self)
        if dialog.exec():
            self.art_director.reload_models()
            self._refresh_forge_models()
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Конфигурация моделей Арт-директора обновлена.", 4000)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Генерация арта и жонглинг 8GB VRAM
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_action_art_clicked(self):
        try:
            target_widget = None
            for i in reversed(range(self.chat_layout.count())):
                item = self.chat_layout.itemAt(i)
                w = item.widget() if item else None
                if w and isinstance(w, ChatMessageWidget) and not getattr(w, "is_user", True):
                    target_widget = w
                    break
            if target_widget:
                v_intent = getattr(target_widget, "visual_intent", None)
                target_text = getattr(target_widget, "translated_text", None) or getattr(target_widget, "raw_text", "")
                if v_intent:
                    self._on_scene_art_requested(widget=target_widget, visual_intent=v_intent)
                elif target_text:
                    self._on_scene_art_requested(text=target_text, widget=target_widget)
                else:
                    os.startfile(str(OUTPUTS_DIR))
            else:
                os.startfile(str(OUTPUTS_DIR))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error on art action: {e}")

    def _on_forge_generation_progress(self, stage_name: str, percent: int):
        if hasattr(self, "header_controller"):
            self.header_controller.set_forge_progress(stage_name, percent)


    def _on_scene_art_requested(
        self,
        text: Optional[str] = None,
        widget: Optional[ChatMessageWidget] = None,
        preferred_style: Optional[str] = None,
        character_name: Optional[str] = None,
        visual_intent: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    ):
        if not self.pill_forge.is_online:
            if widget and hasattr(widget, "set_scene_art_busy"):
                widget.set_scene_art_busy(False)
            logger.warning("[SD Forge] Отклонен запрос иллюстрации сцены: сервер Forge офлайн (порт 7860 недоступен).")
            user_msg = (
                "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
            )
            sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
            self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("SD WebUI Forge недоступен. Запустите Forge в нижней панели.", 6000)
            return

        self._cancel_lms_reload()
        if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
            self.task_queue.abort_tasks_by_type("memory")

        v_intent = visual_intent or (getattr(widget, "visual_intent", None) if widget is not None else None)

        norm_combo = normalize_model_choice(getattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint", None))
        norm_pref = normalize_model_choice(preferred_style)
        active_pref_style = norm_combo or norm_pref

        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        sess_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(sess_id) if sess_id else None

        captured_mode = self.get_effective_mode() if hasattr(self, "get_effective_mode") else getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant")
        captured_char = self.active_character if (captured_mode == "roleplay" and hasattr(self, "active_character")) else None
        active_char_name = character_name
        if not active_char_name and captured_mode == "roleplay" and captured_char:
            active_char_name = getattr(captured_char, "name", None)

        raw_scene_text = (text or "").strip()
        needs_llm_gen = bool((captured_mode in ("roleplay", "rp") and not v_intent) or (not v_intent and re.search(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁ]", raw_scene_text)))

        def _scene_art_pipeline(v_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, scene_text: Optional[str] = None, ckpt: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            self._cancel_lms_reload()
            available_models = self.forge_client.get_models()
            if captured_mode in ("roleplay", "rp") and not v_payload:
                english_prompt = self._generate_ephemeral_rp_art_prompt(
                    sess_id=sess_id,
                    last_assistant_message=scene_text or "",
                    target_model_id=ckpt or "realistic"
                )
                from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
                VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()
                plan = self.art_director.plan_generation(
                    raw_prompt=english_prompt,
                    preferred_style=ckpt,
                    available_models=available_models,
                    session_id=sess_id,
                    mode=captured_mode
                )
            elif v_payload:
                plan = self.art_director.plan_from_visual_intent(
                    visual_intent=v_payload,
                    preferred_style=ckpt,
                    available_models=available_models,
                    character_name=active_char_name,
                    character=None,
                    session_id=sess_id,
                    mode=captured_mode
                )
            else:
                plan = self.art_director.plan_generation(
                    raw_prompt=scene_text or "",
                    preferred_style=ckpt,
                    lm_client=self.lm_client,
                    character=None,
                    available_models=available_models,
                    character_name=active_char_name,
                    session_id=sess_id,
                    mode=captured_mode
                )
                if plan.is_ambiguous:
                    return {"image_path": None, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": None, "is_ambiguous": True}
                from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
                VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()

            logger.info(f"Scene Art selected checkpoint: '{plan.target_checkpoint}'")

            kwargs = plan.to_forge_kwargs(output_dir=sess_images_dir, session_id=sess_id)
            img_path = self.forge_client.text_to_image(**kwargs)

            # text_to_image() guarantees cleanup in finally. Idempotent guard prevents duplicate requests.
            try:
                self.forge_client.unload_checkpoint()
                self.forge_client.free_vram()
            except Exception as _e_unl:
                logger.debug(f"[ForgeClient] Ошибка выгрузки чекпоинта: {_e_unl}")

            # Быстрый тихий возврат активной модели режима в VRAM
            self._reload_active_lms_model_async(delay=1.2)
            return {"image_path": img_path, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": plan.target_checkpoint}

        if widget and hasattr(widget, "set_scene_art_busy"):
            widget.set_scene_art_busy(True, "⏳ Генерация...")

        task = InferenceTask(
            name="🎨 Иллюстрация сцены",
            task_type="scene_art",
            func=_scene_art_pipeline,
            kwargs={
                "v_payload": v_intent,
                "scene_text": raw_scene_text,
                "ckpt": active_pref_style
            },
            abort_fn=self.forge_client.interrupt,
            metadata={
                "is_scene_art": True,
                "session_id": sess_id,
                "target_widget": widget,
                "preferred_style": active_pref_style,
                "visual_intent": v_intent,
                "needs_llm_prompt_gen": needs_llm_gen
            }
        )
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _enqueue_image_task(self, prompt: str):
        if not self.pill_forge.is_online:
            user_msg = (
                "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
            )
            sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
            self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Forge офлайн. Запустите сервер в нижней панели.", 6000)
            return

        checkpoint = normalize_model_choice(getattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint", None))
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        sess_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(sess_id) if sess_id else None

        captured_mode = self.get_effective_mode() if hasattr(self, "get_effective_mode") else getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant")
        captured_char = self.active_character if (captured_mode == "roleplay" and hasattr(self, "active_character")) else None
        active_char_name = None
        if captured_mode == "roleplay" and captured_char:
            active_char_name = getattr(captured_char, "name", None)

        def _image_worker(raw_prompt: str, ckpt: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            self._cancel_lms_reload()
            available_models = self.forge_client.get_models()
            plan = self.art_director.plan_generation(
                raw_prompt=raw_prompt,
                preferred_style=ckpt,
                lm_client=self.lm_client,
                character=captured_char if captured_mode == "roleplay" else None,
                available_models=available_models,
                character_name=active_char_name,
                session_id=sess_id,
                mode=captured_mode
            )
            if plan.is_ambiguous:
                return {"image_path": None, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": None, "is_ambiguous": True}

            from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
            VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()

            logger.info(
                f"Art Director Plan: style={plan.style}, target='{plan.model_title}', "
                f"size={plan.width}x{plan.height}, prompt='{plan.positive_prompt[:60]}...'"
            )

            kwargs = plan.to_forge_kwargs(output_dir=sess_images_dir, session_id=sess_id)
            img_path = self.forge_client.text_to_image(**kwargs)

            # text_to_image() guarantees cleanup in finally. Idempotent guard prevents duplicate requests.
            try:
                self.forge_client.unload_checkpoint()
                self.forge_client.free_vram()
            except Exception as _e_unl:
                logger.debug(f"[ForgeClient] Ошибка выгрузки чекпоинта: {_e_unl}")

            # Быстрый тихий возврат активной модели режима в VRAM
            self._reload_active_lms_model_async(delay=1.2)
            return {
                "image_path": img_path,
                "plan": plan,
                "checkpoint": plan.target_checkpoint
            }

        has_cyrillic = bool(re.search(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁ]", prompt))
        task = InferenceTask(
            name=f"🎨 Арт: {prompt[:25]}...",
            task_type="image",
            func=_image_worker,
            kwargs={"raw_prompt": prompt, "ckpt": checkpoint},
            abort_fn=self.forge_client.interrupt,
            metadata={"prompt": prompt, "needs_llm_prompt_gen": has_cyrillic}
        )
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _enqueue_direct_image_task(self, prompt: str):
        if not self.pill_forge.is_online:
            user_msg = (
                "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
            )
            sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
            self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Forge офлайн. Запустите сервер в нижней панели.", 6000)
            return

        checkpoint = normalize_model_choice(getattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint", None))
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        sess_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(sess_id) if sess_id else None

        def _direct_image_worker(raw_prompt: str, ckpt: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            self._cancel_lms_reload()
            available_models = self.forge_client.get_models()
            plan = self.art_director.build_direct_plan(
                raw_prompt=raw_prompt,
                preferred_style=ckpt,
                lm_client=self.lm_client,
                available_models=available_models
            )
            if plan.is_ambiguous:
                return {"image_path": None, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": None, "is_ambiguous": True}

            from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
            VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()

            logger.info(
                f"Direct Art Plan: style={plan.style}, target='{plan.model_title}', "
                f"size={plan.width}x{plan.height}, prompt='{plan.positive_prompt[:60]}...'"
            )

            kwargs = plan.to_forge_kwargs(output_dir=sess_images_dir, session_id=sess_id)
            img_path = self.forge_client.text_to_image(**kwargs)

            # text_to_image() guarantees cleanup in finally. Idempotent guard prevents duplicate requests.
            try:
                self.forge_client.unload_checkpoint()
                self.forge_client.free_vram()
            except Exception as _e_unl:
                logger.debug(f"[ForgeClient] Ошибка выгрузки чекпоинта: {_e_unl}")

            # Быстрый тихий возврат активной модели режима в VRAM
            self._reload_active_lms_model_async(delay=1.2)
            return {
                "image_path": img_path,
                "plan": plan,
                "checkpoint": plan.target_checkpoint
            }

        has_cyrillic = bool(re.search(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁ]", prompt))
        task = InferenceTask(
            name=f"⚡ Директ-арт: {prompt[:25]}...",
            task_type="image",
            func=_direct_image_worker,
            kwargs={"raw_prompt": prompt, "ckpt": checkpoint},
            abort_fn=self.forge_client.interrupt,
            metadata={"prompt": prompt, "is_direct": True, "needs_llm_prompt_gen": has_cyrillic}
        )
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Координация таймеров возврата LLM
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _reload_active_lms_model_async(self, delay: float = 3.0):
        self._sig_reload_lms.emit(delay)

    def _cancel_lms_reload(self):
        self._sig_cancel_lms.emit()

    @pyqtSlot(float)
    def _do_reload_active_lms_timer(self, delay: float):
        self._do_cancel_lms_reload()

        has_pending_art = self.task_queue.has_pending_tasks(("scene_art", "image", "scene_background")) if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue else False
        if has_pending_art:
            logger.info("[MainWindow] Возврат LLM отменён: в очереди ожидают задачи Forge.")
            return

        self._lms_reload_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._lms_reload_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._lms_reload_timer.timeout.connect(self._execute_lms_reload)
        self._lms_reload_timer.start(int(delay * 1000))

    @pyqtSlot()
    def _do_cancel_lms_reload(self):
        if hasattr(self, "_lms_reload_timer") and self._lms_reload_timer and self._lms_reload_timer.isActive():
            self._lms_reload_timer.stop()
            logger.info("[MainWindow] Отложенная загрузка LLM успешно отменена до выгрузки.")

    def _execute_lms_reload(self):
        if getattr(self, "is_busy", False):
            return

        if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
            if self.task_queue.current_task is not None:
                return
            if self.task_queue.has_pending_tasks(("scene_art", "image", "scene_background")):
                return

        is_rp = (getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant") == "roleplay")
        is_eng = (not is_rp) and (self.is_engineer_mode_active() if hasattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active") else False)

        # Точное определение целевой модели под текущий режим
        if is_eng:
            target_model = self.app_config.get("engineer_model_name") or self.app_config.get("engineer_model")
        elif is_rp:
            char_data = (self.current_session.get("character_data") or {}) if self.current_session else {}
            target_model = (
                char_data.get("character_model")
                or self.app_config.get("rp_model_name")
                or (self.current_session.get("model_id") if self.current_session else None)
                or self.app_config.get("active_model")
            )
        else:
            target_model = (
                self.app_config.get("assistant_model_name")
                or (self.current_session.get("model_id") if self.current_session else None)
                or self.app_config.get("active_model")
            )

        target_model = (target_model or "").strip()
        if not target_model or target_model.startswith("default"):
            target_model = getattr(self, "active_lms_model", "")

        if not target_model or target_model.startswith("default"):
            return

        # Определение целевого контекста: 28K для Инженера, 24K для РП, 14K для Ассистента
        if is_eng:
            ctx_len = self.app_config.get("context_length_engineer", 28672)
        elif is_rp:
            ctx_len = self.app_config.get("context_length_roleplay", 24576)
        else:
            ctx_len = self.app_config.get("context_length_assistant", 14336)

        if hasattr(self, "lm_client") and self.lm_client and hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
            from services.task_queue import PRIORITY_LOW
            task = InferenceTask(
                name="Возврат LLM в VRAM",
                task_type="llm",
                func=self.lm_client.ensure_model_loaded,
                kwargs={
                    "preferred_model": target_model,
                    "context_length": ctx_len,
                    "is_engineer": is_eng,
                    "is_roleplay": is_rp
                },
                priority=PRIORITY_LOW,
                metadata={"silent": True}
            )
            self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
            self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

import logging
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any
from pathlib import Path
from PyQt6.QtCore import QObject, pyqtSignal

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.HeaderController")


class HeaderStateController(QObject):
    """
    Управляет состоянием шапки чата (конечный автомат: имя, статус, неоновый цвет, аватар).
    Изолирует логику представления от главного окна MainWindow.
    """
    # title, status_text, status_color_hex, avatar_path
    state_updated = pyqtSignal(str, str, str, object)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._current_mode = "assistant"
        self._active_character: Optional[Any] = None
        self._current_session: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
        self._active_task_status: Optional[str] = None
        self._active_task_color: str = "#00F0FF"

    def sync_context(
        self,
        mode: str,
        character: Optional[Any],
        session: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    ):
        """Синхронизирует базовый контекст диалога (режим, персонаж, сессия)."""
        self._current_mode = mode
        self._active_character = character
        self._current_session = session
        self.refresh()

    def set_forge_progress(self, stage_name: str, percent: int):
        """Обновляет статус выполнения этапов SD WebUI Forge."""
        if percent > 0:
            self._active_task_status = f"{stage_name}: {percent}%"
        else:
            self._active_task_status = f"{stage_name}..."
        self._active_task_color = "#00F0FF"
        self.refresh()

    def set_task_state(self, task_type: str, action_text: str):
        """Устанавливает статус выполнения фоновой задачи."""
        self._active_task_status = f"{action_text}..."
        if task_type in ("scene_art", "image"):
            self._active_task_color = "#00F0FF"
        elif task_type == "llm":
            self._active_task_color = "#00F0FF"
        elif task_type == "file":
            self._active_task_color = "#FBBF24"
        elif task_type == "translation":
            self._active_task_color = "#38BDF8"
        else:
            self._active_task_color = "#00F0FF"
        self.refresh()

    def clear_active_task(self):
        """Сбрасывает состояние активной задачи при завершении или отмене."""
        self._active_task_status = None
        self.refresh()

    def refresh(self):
        """Вычисляет результирующее состояние и передает его в UI."""
        if self._active_task_status:
            title = self._get_base_title()
            avatar_path = self._get_avatar_path()
            self.state_updated.emit(title, self._active_task_status, self._active_task_color, avatar_path)
            return

        if self._current_mode == "roleplay":
            if self._active_character and getattr(self._active_character, "name", None):
                char_name = self._active_character.name
                user_name = "Игрок"
                if self._current_session:
                    from services.session_manager import SessionManager
                    sess_persona_id = self._current_session.get("user_persona_id")
                    persona = SessionManager.get_active_user_persona(is_roleplay=True, session_persona_id=sess_persona_id)
                    user_name = persona.get("name", "Игрок")

                status = f"🎭 {char_name} • Вы: {user_name}"
                color = "#A78BFA"
                # ВАЖНО: берем аватар через _get_avatar_path(), который учитывает сессионный оверрайд!
                avatar_path = self._get_avatar_path()
                self.state_updated.emit(char_name, status, color, avatar_path)
            else:
                self.state_updated.emit(
                    "Ролевой чат (Персонаж не выбран)",
                    "Загрузите карточку (.json)",
                    "#94A3B8",
                    None
                )
        else:
            # Ассистент: отображает аватар текущей сессии (или None для стандартного бейджа)
            self.state_updated.emit(
                "Элария",
                "Элария • В сети",
                "#38BDF8",
                self._get_avatar_path()
            )

    def _get_base_title(self) -> str:
        if self._current_mode == "roleplay" and self._active_character:
            return getattr(self._active_character, "name", "Персонаж")
        return "Элария"

    def _get_avatar_path(self) -> Optional[Any]:
        if self._current_mode == "roleplay":
            # 1. Индивидуальный аватар конкретного чата
            if self._current_session and self._current_session.get("character_data"):
                sess_av = self._current_session["character_data"].get("avatar_path")
                if sess_av and Path(sess_av).exists():
                    return Path(sess_av)
            # 2. Исходный аватар карточки персонажа из галереи
            if self._active_character and getattr(self._active_character, "avatar_path", None):
                p = Path(self._active_character.avatar_path)
                if p.exists():
                    return p
            return None

        # Режим ассистента: СТРОГО аватар текущей сессии. Если не задан — None (чистый бейдж)
        if self._current_session:
            sess_av = self._current_session.get("assistant_avatar_path")
            if sess_av and Path(sess_av).exists():
                return Path(sess_av)
        return None

"""
Reminder Controller for NeonRoute.
Periodically polls SQLite for due reminders and dispatches Windows Tray,
PowerShell Toasts, and in-app neon Toast widgets.
"""

import subprocess
import logging
from typing import List, Optional
from PyQt6.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QSystemTrayIcon, QStyle, QWidget
from ui.components.reminder_toast import ReminderToastWidget

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.ReminderController")


class ReminderController(QObject):
    reminder_triggered = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, parent_window: QWidget):
        super().__init__(parent_window)
        self.window = parent_window
        self._active_toasts: List[ReminderToastWidget] = []

        # System Tray Icon
        self.tray_icon = QSystemTrayIcon(self.window)
        app_icon = self.window.windowIcon()
        if not app_icon.isNull():
            self.tray_icon.setIcon(app_icon)
        else:
            self.tray_icon.setIcon(self.window.style().standardIcon(QStyle.StandardPixmap.SP_MessageBoxInformation))
        self.tray_icon.show()

        # Heartbeat timer (every 4 seconds)
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._check_reminders)
        self._timer.start(4000)

    def _check_reminders(self):
        try:
            from services.memory_db import memory_db
            due_list = memory_db.get_due_reminders()
            for item in due_list:
                r_id = item["id"]
                r_text = item["text"]
                r_time = item["remind_at"]
                memory_db.mark_reminder_done(r_id)

                self._dispatch_toast(r_text, r_time)
                self.reminder_triggered.emit(r_text)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"[ReminderController] Heartbeat error: {e}")

    def _dispatch_toast(self, text: str, remind_at: str):
        # 1. Native Windows Tray
        try:
            self.tray_icon.showMessage(
                "Элария • Напоминание",
                f"{text}\n({remind_at})",
                QSystemTrayIcon.MessageIcon.Information,
                12000
            )
        except Exception as te:
            logger.debug(f"[ReminderController] Tray error: {te}")

        # 2. PowerShell Toast Notification
        try:
            ps_cmd = (
                f'[Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] > $null; '
                f'$template = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::GetTemplateContent([Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastTemplateType]::ToastText02); '
                f'$textNodes = $template.GetElementsByTagName("text"); '
                f'$textNodes.Item(0).AppendChild($template.CreateTextNode("Элария • Напоминание")) > $null; '
                f'$textNodes.Item(1).AppendChild($template.CreateTextNode("{text}")) > $null; '
                f'$toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new($template); '
                f'[Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier("NeonRoute").Show($toast);'
            )
            subprocess.Popen(["powershell", "-WindowStyle", "Hidden", "-Command", ps_cmd], creationflags=0x08000000)
        except Exception:
            pass

        # 3. In-App Neon Toast Widget
        toast = ReminderToastWidget(text, remind_at, self.window)
        toast.adjustSize()
        toast.setFixedWidth(320)

        margin_x = 24
        margin_y = 48
        x = self.window.width() - toast.width() - margin_x
        y = self.window.height() - toast.height() - margin_y

        active = [t for t in self._active_toasts if t.isVisible()]
        if active:
            y -= len(active) * (toast.height() + 10)

        toast.move(max(10, x), max(10, y))
        toast.show()
        toast.raise_()
        self._active_toasts.append(toast)

"""
Roleplay & Companion Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Handles companions, scene backgrounds, characters gallery, campaign info dialogs,
character localization (_ru fields), and character state hydration.
"""

import logging
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, Dict, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QFileDialog, QMessageBox
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPixmap

from services.tavern_parser import CharacterCard, TavernParser
from services.session_manager import SessionManager
from services.task_queue import InferenceTask

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.RoleplayController")


class RoleplayControllerMixin:
    """
    Миксин управления ролевым режимом (RP), компаньонами и сценой для MainWindow.
    """

    def _apply_chat_background(self):
        """Применяет персональный фон сцены для текущего диалога с затемнением."""
        bg_path = None
        if self.current_session:
            bg_path = self.current_session.get("background_image")

        applied = False
        if bg_path:
            p = Path(bg_path).resolve()
            if p.exists() and p.is_file():
                pix = QPixmap(str(p))
                if not pix.isNull():
                    dim_alpha = int(255 * 0.70)
                    if hasattr(self, "chat_viewport") and self.chat_viewport:
                        self.chat_viewport.set_background(pix, alpha=dim_alpha)
                        applied = True

        if not applied:
            if hasattr(self, "chat_viewport") and self.chat_viewport:
                if hasattr(self, "background_pixmap") and self.background_pixmap and not self.background_pixmap.isNull():
                    self.chat_viewport.set_background(self.background_pixmap, alpha=self.background_dim_opacity)
                else:
                    self.chat_viewport.set_background(None)

        if hasattr(self, "chat_viewport") and self.chat_viewport:
            self.chat_viewport.update()
        if hasattr(self, "scroll_area") and self.scroll_area:
            self.scroll_area.update()

    def _on_choose_background_clicked(self):
        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Выберите фоновое изображение для сцены",
            "",
            "Images (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp)"
        )
        if not file_path:
            return
        norm_path = str(Path(file_path).resolve())
        if self.current_session:
            self.current_session["background_image"] = norm_path
            self._save_current_session()
        self._apply_chat_background()
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Фон сцены обновлен.", 3000)

    def _on_reset_background_clicked(self):
        if self.current_session:
            self.current_session["background_image"] = None
            self._save_current_session()
        self._apply_chat_background()
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Фон сцены сброшен.", 3000)

    def _on_generate_background_clicked(self):
        """Generates scene environment background without people using SD WebUI Forge pipeline."""
        sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
        if not self.pill_forge.is_online:
            logger.warning("[SD Forge] Отклонен запрос генерации фона сцены: сервер Forge офлайн.")
            user_msg = (
                "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
            )
            self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Forge офлайн. Запустите сервер в нижней панели.", 6000)
            return

        checkpoint = getattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint", "✨ Арт-директор (Авто)")
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        sess_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(sess_id) if sess_id else None

        loc_dna = ""
        if sess_id:
            from services.rp_cast_manager import RPCastManager
            cast_data = RPCastManager.load_cast(sess_id)
            loc_dna = (cast_data.get("environment") or {}).get("location_dna", "").strip()

        if loc_dna:
            prompt_seed = f"scenery, empty environment, {loc_dna}, masterpiece, detailed background, no humans"
        else:
            scene_desc = ""
            if self.active_character:
                scene_desc = self.active_character.scenario or self.active_character.description or self.active_character.name
            prompt_seed = f"scenery, empty environment, {scene_desc.strip()[:260]}, atmospheric lighting, no humans"

        def _bg_pipeline(raw_prompt: str, ckpt: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            self._cancel_lms_reload()
            available_models = self.forge_client.get_models()
            plan = self.art_director.plan_generation(
                raw_prompt=raw_prompt,
                preferred_style=ckpt,
                lm_client=self.lm_client,
                character=None,
                available_models=available_models
            )
            plan.positive_prompt = f"scenery, empty landscape, atmospheric lighting, no humans, {plan.positive_prompt}"
            human_neg = "human, person, 1girl, 1boy, woman, man, character, people, crowd, face, hands, body, portrait, "
            plan.negative_prompt = human_neg + (plan.negative_prompt or "")
            plan.width = 768
            plan.height = 512
            plan.enable_adetailer = False

            from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
            VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()

            kwargs = plan.to_forge_kwargs(output_dir=sess_images_dir, session_id=sess_id)
            img_path = self.forge_client.text_to_image(**kwargs)

            # Быстрый тихий возврат активной модели режима в VRAM
            if hasattr(self, "_reload_active_lms_model_async"):
                self._reload_active_lms_model_async(delay=1.2)

            if img_path and Path(img_path).resolve().exists():
                if self.current_session:
                    self.current_session["background_image"] = str(Path(img_path).resolve())
                    self._save_current_session()
                QTimer.singleShot(0, self, self._apply_chat_background)
            return {"image_path": img_path, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": plan.target_checkpoint, "is_scene_background": True}

        needs_llm_gen = bool(not loc_dna and re.search(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁ]", prompt_seed))
        task = InferenceTask(
            name="🖼️ Фон сцены",
            task_type="scene_background",
            func=_bg_pipeline,
            kwargs={"raw_prompt": prompt_seed, "ckpt": checkpoint},
            abort_fn=self.forge_client.interrupt,
            metadata={"is_scene_background": True, "needs_llm_prompt_gen": needs_llm_gen}
        )
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Генерация фона сцены запущена в Forge...", 5000)

    def _open_campaign_info_dialog(self):
        """Открывает интерактивное окно сводки кампании, правил мира и памяти ИИ."""
        if not self.active_character:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Сначала загрузите карточку персонажа или ДМ.", 3000)
            return
        try:
            from ui.dialogs.campaign_info_dialog import CampaignInfoDialog
            dlg = CampaignInfoDialog(
                character_card=self.active_character,
                current_session=self.current_session,
                parent=self
            )
            dlg.exec()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Ошибка открытия сводки кампании: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def _open_characters_gallery_dialog(self):
        """Opens Characters Gallery dialog for roleplay tavern."""
        from ui.dialogs.characters_gallery_dialog import CharactersGalleryDialog
        dlg = CharactersGalleryDialog(parent=self)
        dlg.start_session_requested.connect(lambda card: self._create_new_session(mode="roleplay", character_card=card))
        dlg.card_saved.connect(self._on_character_card_updated)
        dlg.exec()

    def _on_character_card_updated(self, card: CharacterCard):
        """Синхронизирует данные идентичности персонажа, локализацию и visual_dna в сессии и live-объекте."""
        if not card:
            return
        if hasattr(self, "current_session") and self.current_session:
            cd = self.current_session.get("character_data")
            card_id = getattr(card, "id", None)
            card_name = getattr(card, "name", None)
            if isinstance(cd, dict) and ((card_id and cd.get("id") == card_id) or (not cd.get("id") and card_name and cd.get("name") == card_name)):
                cd["name"] = card_name
                cd["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")

                identity_fields = (
                    "description",
                    "personality",
                    "scenario",
                    "system_prompt",
                    "mes_example",
                    "first_mes",
                    "description_ru",
                    "personality_ru",
                    "scenario_ru",
                    "system_prompt_ru",
                    "mes_example_ru",
                    "first_mes_ru",
                )
                for field in identity_fields:
                    if hasattr(card, field):
                        cd[field] = getattr(card, field)
                    elif field == "system_prompt_ru":
                        cd[field] = getattr(card, field, "")

                if hasattr(card, "avatar_path") and getattr(card, "avatar_path", None) is not None:
                    cd["avatar_path"] = str(card.avatar_path) if card.avatar_path else ""

                for greet_field in ("alternate_greetings", "alternate_greetings_ru"):
                    if hasattr(card, greet_field) and getattr(card, greet_field) is not None:
                        cd[greet_field] = getattr(card, greet_field)

                if hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character:
                    if (card_id and getattr(self.active_character, "id", None) == card_id) or (card_name and getattr(self.active_character, "name", None) == card_name):
                        self.active_character.name = card_name
                        self.active_character.visual_dna = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
                        for field in identity_fields:
                            if hasattr(card, field):
                                setattr(self.active_character, field, getattr(card, field))
                            elif field == "system_prompt_ru":
                                setattr(self.active_character, field, getattr(card, field, ""))

                        if hasattr(card, "avatar_path") and getattr(card, "avatar_path", None) is not None:
                            self.active_character.avatar_path = card.avatar_path

                        for greet_field in ("alternate_greetings", "alternate_greetings_ru"):
                            if hasattr(card, greet_field) and getattr(card, greet_field) is not None:
                                setattr(self.active_character, greet_field, getattr(card, greet_field))

                        if hasattr(self, "char_name_lbl") and self.char_name_lbl:
                            self.char_name_lbl.setText(f"🎭 {card_name}")
                if hasattr(self, "_save_current_session"):
                    self._save_current_session()
                try:
                    from services.rp_cast_manager import RPCastManager
                    sess_id = self.current_session.get("id")
                    if sess_id:
                        cast_data = RPCastManager.load_cast(sess_id)
                        if isinstance(cast_data, dict) and "companion_state" in cast_data:
                            cast_data["companion_state"]["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
                            RPCastManager.save_cast(sess_id, cast_data)
                except Exception as e_cast:
                    logger.debug(f"Could not update cast visual_dna on card save: {e_cast}")

    def _import_character(self):
        """Opens Characters Gallery dialog for companion selection."""
        self._open_characters_gallery_dialog()

    def _translate_character_card_task(self, card: CharacterCard, on_complete=None):
        """Пайплайн асинхронной локализации карточки персонажа на русский язык."""
        sections = [
            f"===DESCRIPTION===\n{card.description or ''}",
            f"===PERSONALITY===\n{card.personality or ''}",
            f"===SCENARIO===\n{card.scenario or ''}",
            f"===MES_EXAMPLE===\n{card.mes_example or ''}",
            f"===FIRST_MES===\n{card.first_mes or ''}"
        ]
        # Добавить ВСЕ альтернативные приветствия карточки:
        if hasattr(card, "alternate_greetings") and card.alternate_greetings:
            for idx, alt_greet in enumerate(card.alternate_greetings):
                sections.append(f"===ALT_GREETING_{idx+1}===\n{alt_greet}")

        raw_payload = "\n".join(sections)

        sys_prompt = (
            "Ты — профессиональный художественный переводчик литературной прозы и ролевых игр на русский язык.\n"
            "Переведи каждую секцию карточки персонажа на богатый, атмосферный русский язык, сохраняя стиль и характер.\n"
            "СТРОГО СОХРАНЯЙ ВСЕ РАЗДЕЛИТЕЛИ ===SECTION=== В СВОЕМ ОТВЕТЕ! Переведи все приветствия ===FIRST_MES=== и ===ALT_GREETING_X=== без исключений."
        )
        user_prompt = f"Переведи следующие секции карточки на русский язык:\n\n{raw_payload}"

        def _worker_fn(text: str) -> dict:
            resp = self.lm_client.chat_completion(
                messages=[{"role": "system", "content": sys_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}],
                temperature=0.25,
                max_tokens=8192,
                emit_signal=False,
                is_roleplay=False
            )
            return {"raw_reply": resp}

        def _on_done(task_id, result):
            reply = result.get("raw_reply", "") if isinstance(result, dict) else str(result)
            # Парсинг делимитеров
            parts = re.split(r'===([A-Za-z0-9_]+)===', reply)
            res_dict = {}
            if len(parts) >= 3:
                for i in range(1, len(parts), 2):
                    key = parts[i].strip().upper()
                    val = parts[i+1].strip()
                    res_dict[key] = val

            if "DESCRIPTION" in res_dict: card.description_ru = res_dict["DESCRIPTION"]
            if "PERSONALITY" in res_dict: card.personality_ru = res_dict["PERSONALITY"]
            if "SCENARIO" in res_dict: card.scenario_ru = res_dict["SCENARIO"]
            if "MES_EXAMPLE" in res_dict: card.mes_example_ru = res_dict["MES_EXAMPLE"]
            if "FIRST_MES" in res_dict: card.first_mes_ru = res_dict["FIRST_MES"]

            # Извлечение всех переведённых альтернативных приветствий:
            alt_ru = []
            if hasattr(card, "alternate_greetings") and card.alternate_greetings:
                for idx in range(len(card.alternate_greetings)):
                    key = f"ALT_GREETING_{idx+1}"
                    alt_ru.append(res_dict.get(key, ""))
            card.alternate_greetings_ru = alt_ru

            # Сохранить на диск и в активную сессию
            TavernParser.save_card_translations(card)
            if self.current_session:
                cd = self.current_session.get("character_data")
                if isinstance(cd, dict):
                    if cd.get("name") == card.name or cd.get("id") == getattr(card, "id", None):
                        cd["description_ru"] = card.description_ru
                        cd["personality_ru"] = card.personality_ru
                        cd["scenario_ru"] = card.scenario_ru
                        cd["mes_example_ru"] = card.mes_example_ru
                        cd["first_mes_ru"] = card.first_mes_ru
                        cd["alternate_greetings_ru"] = card.alternate_greetings_ru or []
                        if getattr(card, "visual_dna", ""):
                            cd["visual_dna"] = card.visual_dna
                        self._save_current_session()

            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Карточка персонажа '{card.name}' успешно переведена на русский язык!", 5000)
            if on_complete:
                try:
                    on_complete(True, res_dict)
                except TypeError:
                    on_complete(True)

        task = InferenceTask(
            name=f"🌐 Локализация карточки: {card.name}",
            task_type="translation",
            func=_worker_fn,
            kwargs={"text": raw_payload},
            abort_fn=self.lm_client.abort
        )
        if hasattr(self, "_active_tasks"):
            self._active_tasks[task.id] = task

        def _disconnect_handlers():
            try:
                self.task_queue.task_finished.disconnect(_on_done_wrapper)
            except (TypeError, RuntimeError):
                pass
            try:
                self.task_queue.task_failed.disconnect(_on_fail_wrapper)
            except (TypeError, RuntimeError):
                pass

        def _on_done_wrapper(tid: str, res: Any):
            if tid != task.id:
                return
            _disconnect_handlers()
            if hasattr(self, "_active_tasks"):
                self._active_tasks.pop(task.id, None)
            _on_done(tid, res)

        def _on_fail_wrapper(tid: str, err: str):
            if tid != task.id:
                return
            _disconnect_handlers()
            if hasattr(self, "_active_tasks"):
                self._active_tasks.pop(task.id, None)
            if on_complete:
                try:
                    on_complete(False, {})
                except TypeError:
                    on_complete(False)

        self.task_queue.task_finished.connect(_on_done_wrapper)
        self.task_queue.task_failed.connect(_on_fail_wrapper)
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _restore_roleplay_character_from_session(self, char_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Optional[CharacterCard]:
        """Восстанавливает объект CharacterCard через канонический from_dict()."""
        if not char_data or not isinstance(char_data, dict):
            return None

        card = CharacterCard.from_dict(char_data)

        # Защитная гидратация visual_dna из каста сессии, если поле пустое
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        if not card.visual_dna and sess_id:
            try:
                from services.rp_cast_manager import RPCastManager
                cast_data = RPCastManager.load_cast(sess_id)
                card.visual_dna = (cast_data.get("companion_state") or {}).get("visual_dna", "")
            except Exception:
                pass

        return card

"""
Chat Search Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Manages in-chat text query search, occurrence counting, match highlighting,
and smooth auto-scrolling between matches.
"""

import re
import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, List, Optional, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QLabel, QLineEdit, QScrollArea, QPushButton
from PyQt6.QtGui import QTextCursor, QTextDocument, QColor

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.ChatSearch")


class ChatSearchMixin:
    """
    Миксин внутричатового поиска для MainWindow.
    Изолирует всю механику поиска, подсветки совпадений и навигации.
    """

    def _on_search_clicked(self):
        try:
            self._toggle_search_bar()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error in _on_search_clicked: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def _show_search_bar(self):
        self.search_bar_widget.show_and_focus()

    def _toggle_search_bar(self):
        if self.search_bar_widget.isVisible():
            self._close_search_bar()
        else:
            self._show_search_bar()

    def _close_search_bar(self):
        self.search_bar_widget.setVisible(False)
        self._clear_search_highlight()
        self.input_box.setFocus()

    def _on_search_query_changed(self, query: str):
        query = query.strip()
        self._search_matching_widgets.clear()
        self._current_search_idx = -1

        if not query:
            self.search_bar_widget.set_match_info(0, 0)
            return

        q_lower = query.lower()
        for w in self._get_chat_message_widgets():
            txt = ""
            if hasattr(w, "text_browser") and w.text_browser:
                txt = w.text_browser.toPlainText()
            elif hasattr(w, "raw_text"):
                txt = w.raw_text or ""
            if q_lower in txt.lower():
                self._search_matching_widgets.append(w)

        total = len(self._search_matching_widgets)
        if total > 0:
            self._current_search_idx = 0
            self.search_bar_widget.set_match_info(1, total)
            self._navigate_search_match(0)
        else:
            self.search_bar_widget.set_match_info(0, 0)

    def _clear_search_highlight(self):
        self._search_matching_widgets.clear()
        self._current_search_idx = -1

"""
Session & History Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Handles session creation, switching, persistence, sidebar list updates,
and chat message serialization.
"""

import time
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, List, Dict, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, QPoint, QSize
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QMessageBox, QInputDialog, QListWidgetItem,
    QMenu, QApplication, QFileDialog
)
from PyQt6.QtGui import QIcon, QAction
from services.session_manager import SessionManager


if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.SessionController")


class SessionControllerMixin:
    """
    Миксин управления сессиями и историей диалогов для MainWindow.
    """

    def _on_new_chat_clicked(self):
        """Handler for '+ Новый' button in sidebar."""
        self._create_new_session(
            mode=self.current_mode,
            character_card=self.active_character if self.current_mode == "roleplay" else None,
            title=None
        )
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Создан новый диалог.", 4000)

    def _save_current_session(self, trigger_memory: bool = False):
        """Persists active session to disk."""
        if not self.current_session:
            return
        self.current_session["chat_history"] = list(self.chat_history)
        self.current_session["mode"] = self.current_mode
        if hasattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active") and self.is_engineer_mode_active():
            self.current_session["type"] = "engineering"
        else:
            self.current_session.pop("type", None)
        SessionManager.save_session(self.current_session, trigger_memory=trigger_memory)

    def _on_rename_session_requested(self, session_id: str):
        """Opens rename dialog for the session."""
        current_title = "Диалог"
        if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("id") == session_id:
            current_title = self.current_session.get("title", current_title)
        elif session_id in self._session_items:
            _, w = self._session_items[session_id]
            current_title = w.title_lbl.text()

        new_title, ok = QInputDialog.getText(
            self,
            "Переименование диалога",
            "Введите новое название диалога:",
            text=current_title
        )
        if ok and new_title.strip():
            clean_title = new_title.strip()
            SessionManager.rename_session(session_id, clean_title)
            if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("id") == session_id:
                self.current_session["title"] = clean_title
            if session_id in self._session_items:
                _, w = self._session_items[session_id]
                w.update_title(clean_title)
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Диалог переименован: '{clean_title}'", 3000)

    def _on_delete_session_requested(self, session_id: str):
        """Deletes a session from history and removes from sidebar with WinError 32 guard."""
        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Удаление диалога",
            "Вы действительно хотите удалить этот диалог из истории?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        # 1. Если удаляется активная сессия, останавливаем активные задачи очереди и переключаем UI
        is_active_session = bool(self.current_session and self.current_session.get("id") == session_id)
        if is_active_session:
            if getattr(self, "is_busy", False):
                self.task_queue.abort_current()

            # Освобождаем виджеты текущего чата и дескрипторы аудио/изображений
            self._clear_chat_widgets()

            next_id = None
            # Сначала ищем сессию того же режима (self.current_mode)
            target_m = getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant")
            for i in range(self.chat_list_widget.count()):
                cand_item = self.chat_list_widget.item(i)
                cid = cand_item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                if cid and cid != session_id:
                    cand_w = self.chat_list_widget.itemWidget(cand_item)
                    cand_mode = getattr(cand_w, "mode", None) if cand_w else None
                    if cand_mode == target_m:
                        next_id = cid
                        break

            # Если сессии того же режима нет, ищем любую доступную
            if not next_id:
                for i in range(self.chat_list_widget.count()):
                    cand_item = self.chat_list_widget.item(i)
                    cid = cand_item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                    if cid and cid != session_id:
                        next_id = cid
                        break

            self.current_session = None
            if next_id:
                self._switch_to_session(next_id)
            else:
                self._create_new_session(self.current_mode or "assistant")

        # 2. Удаляем сессию из списка UI
        if session_id in self._session_items:
            item, _ = self._session_items.pop(session_id)
            row = self.chat_list_widget.row(item)
            if row >= 0:
                self.chat_list_widget.takeItem(row)

        # 3. Полное удаление истории чата и папки outputs/sessions/<session_id>/
        SessionManager.delete_session(session_id)

FILE: ui\controllers\task_lifecycle_controller.py (463 lines)
