def render_square_poster(
    image_path: Optional[str] = None,
    name: str = "?",
    width: int = 120,
    height: int = 120,
    radius: int = 8
) -> QPixmap:
    """Генерирует квадратный постер со скругленными углами и центром кадрирования."""
    pix = QPixmap(width, height)
    pix.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)

    painter = QPainter(pix)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)

    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addRoundedRect(0.0, 0.0, float(width), float(height), float(radius), float(radius))
    painter.setClipPath(path)

    loaded = False
    if image_path:
        p = Path(image_path)
        if p.exists() and p.is_file():
            src_pix = QPixmap(str(p))
            if not src_pix.isNull():
                scaled = src_pix.scaled(
                    width, height,
                    Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
                    Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
                )
                x = (scaled.width() - width) // 2
                y = (scaled.height() - height) // 2
                painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, scaled, x, y, width, height)
                loaded = True

    if not loaded:
        painter.fillRect(0, 0, width, height, QColor("#121826"))
        initials = (name[:2] if name else "?").upper().strip()
        painter.setPen(QColor("#00F0FF"))
        font = painter.font()
        font.setPointSize(max(13, int(height * 0.22)))
        font.setBold(True)
        painter.setFont(font)
        painter.drawText(0, 0, width, height, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, initials)

    painter.setClipping(False)
    painter.setPen(QColor("rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)"))
    painter.drawRoundedRect(0, 0, width - 1, height - 1, radius, radius)
    painter.end()
    return pix


class ChubSearchWorker(QThread):
    results_ready = pyqtSignal(list, int)
    error_occurred = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, query: str, sort: str, nsfw: bool, max_tokens: Optional[int], page: int = 1, russian_only: bool = False):
        super().__init__()
        self.query = query
        self.sort = sort
        self.nsfw = nsfw
        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
        self.page = page
        self.russian_only = russian_only

    def run(self):
        try:
            client = ChubClient()
            cards, total = client.search_characters(
                query=self.query,
                page=self.page,
                sort=self.sort,
                nsfw=self.nsfw,
                max_tokens_limit=self.max_tokens,
                russian_only=self.russian_only
            )
            self.results_ready.emit(cards, total)
        except Exception as e:
            self.error_occurred.emit(str(e))


class ChubDownloadWorker(QThread):
    finished = pyqtSignal(object)
    error = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, full_path: str, card_title: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.full_path = full_path
        self.card_title = card_title

    def run(self):
        try:
            client = ChubClient()
            path = client.download_card(self.full_path, self.card_title)
            self.finished.emit(path)
        except Exception as e:
            self.error.emit(str(e))


class ChubAvatarsBatchWorker(QThread):
    avatar_loaded = pyqtSignal(int, str)

    def __init__(self, cards: List[Dict[str, Any]], session: requests.Session):
        super().__init__()
        self.cards = list(cards)
        self.session = session
        self._is_aborted = False
        self._executor: Optional[ThreadPoolExecutor] = None

    def abort(self):
        self._is_aborted = True
        if self._executor:
            try:
                self._executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _fetch_single_avatar(self, idx: int, card: Dict[str, Any]):
        if self._is_aborted:
            return

        url = card.get("avatar_url")
        if not url:
            return

        cache_key = hashlib.md5(url.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        cache_path = AVATAR_CACHE_DIR / f"{cache_key}.png"

        if not cache_path.exists():
            try:
                resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=5.0)
                if resp.status_code == 200 and len(resp.content) > 300:
                    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(resp.content))
                    img.save(cache_path, format="PNG")
            except Exception:
                return

        if cache_path.exists() and not self._is_aborted:
            self.avatar_loaded.emit(idx, str(cache_path))

    def run(self):
        try:
            self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4, thread_name_prefix="ChubAvatarWorker")
            futures = []
            for idx, card in enumerate(self.cards):
                if self._is_aborted:
                    break
                futures.append(self._executor.submit(self._fetch_single_avatar, idx, card))

            for f in futures:
                if self._is_aborted:
                    break
                try:
                    f.result()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        except Exception:
            pass
        finally:
            if self._executor:
                try:
                    self._executor.shutdown(wait=False)
                except Exception:
                    pass

    def _on_search_clicked(self, reset_page: bool = True):
        if reset_page:
            self.current_page = 1

        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        sort = self.combo_sort.currentData()
        nsfw = self.chk_nsfw.isChecked()
        max_tok = self.combo_tokens.currentData()
        russian_only = self.chk_russian.isChecked()

        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(False)

        self._search_worker = ChubSearchWorker(
            query=query,
            sort=sort,
            nsfw=nsfw,
            max_tokens=max_tok,
            page=self.current_page,
            russian_only=russian_only
        )
        self._search_worker.results_ready.connect(self._on_results_ready)
        self._search_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_search_error)
        self._search_worker.start()

    def _on_prev_page_clicked(self):
        if self.current_page > 1:
            self.current_page -= 1
            self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_next_page_clicked(self):
        if self.current_page < self.total_pages:
            self.current_page += 1
            self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_results_ready(self, cards: list, total: int):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.cards_data = cards
        self.list_results.clear()
        self._cached_avatar_paths.clear()

        self.total_items = total
        page_size = max(1, len(cards)) if cards else 40
        self.total_pages = max(1, (total + page_size - 1) // page_size)

        self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page} из {self.total_pages} (всего: {total})")
        self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(self.current_page > 1)
        self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(self.current_page < self.total_pages)

        if self._avatar_worker and self._avatar_worker.isRunning():
            self._avatar_worker.abort()
            self._avatar_worker.wait(150)

        for c in cards:
            tok = c.get("tokens", 0)
            badge = "🟢" if tok <= 1500 else ("🟡" if tok <= 2500 else "🔴")
            c_name = c.get("name", "Персонаж").strip()
            short_name = c_name[:15] + ("…" if len(c_name) > 15 else "")
            stars = c.get("star_count", 0)
            lang_badge = "🇷🇺" if c.get("lang") == "ru" else "🇬🇧"

            item_text = f"{short_name}\n{badge} {tok}t • {lang_badge} • ★{stars}"
            placeholder = render_square_poster(None, name=c_name, width=120, height=120)
            item = QListWidgetItem(QIcon(placeholder), item_text)
            self.list_results.addItem(item)

        if cards:
            client = ChubClient()
            self._avatar_worker = ChubAvatarsBatchWorker(cards, client.session)
            self._avatar_worker.avatar_loaded.connect(self._on_avatar_loaded)
            self._avatar_worker.start()

            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.list_results.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self.lbl_title.setText("Ничего не найдено")
            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.lbl_meta.setText("Измените запрос или фильтры токенов.")
            self.avatar_preview_lbl.setPixmap(render_square_poster(None, name="?", width=80, height=80))
            self.text_preview.clear()
            self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_avatar_loaded(self, row_idx: int, img_path: str):
        self._cached_avatar_paths[row_idx] = img_path
        item = self.list_results.item(row_idx)
        if item and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            poster = render_square_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=120, height=120)
            item.setIcon(QIcon(poster))

        if self.list_results.currentRow() == row_idx and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            preview_pix = render_square_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=80, height=80)
            self.avatar_preview_lbl.setPixmap(preview_pix)

    def _on_search_error(self, err: str):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.list_results.clear()

        err_lower = err.lower()
        if "подключение к интернету" in err_lower or "connection" in err_lower or "timeout" in err_lower:
            self.lbl_title.setText("🔌 Нет подключения к интернету")
            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #FF007F; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.lbl_meta.setText("Сетевое соединение недоступно")
            self.text_preview.setPlainText(
                "Не удалось связаться с сервером Chub.ai.\n\n"
                "• Проверьте подключение к сети.\n"
                "• Если используется VPN или прокси, проверьте их активность.\n"
                "• Нажмите «🔍 Найти» после восстановления связи."
            )
        else:
            self.lbl_title.setText("⚠️ Ошибка каталога")
            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #FFE600; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.lbl_meta.setText("Сбой обработки запроса")
            self.text_preview.setPlainText(f"Не удалось получить данные с сервера:\n{err}")

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_card_selected(self, current: Optional[QListWidgetItem]):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        self.lbl_title.setText(c["name"])
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
        tok = c["tokens"]
        lang_str = "🇷🇺 Русский язык" if c.get("lang") == "ru" else "🇬🇧 Английский язык"
        self.lbl_meta.setText(f"{lang_str} | ~{tok} tok | ★ {c['star_count']} | 📥 {c['download_count']}")

        preview_parts = []
        if c.get("tagline"):
            preview_parts.append(f"📌 {c['tagline']}")
        if c.get("topics"):
            preview_parts.append(f"🏷️ Теги: {', '.join(c['topics'][:8])}")
        if c.get("description"):
            preview_parts.append(f"📖 Описание:\n{c['description']}")

        self.text_preview.setPlainText("\n\n".join(preview_parts).strip())

        cached_path = self._cached_avatar_paths.get(row)
        pix = render_square_poster(cached_path, name=c["name"], width=80, height=80)
        self.avatar_preview_lbl.setPixmap(pix)
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(True)

    def _on_download_clicked(self):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_download.setText("⏳ Скачивание и регистрация...")

        self._download_worker = ChubDownloadWorker(c["full_path"], c["name"])
        self._download_worker.finished.connect(self._on_download_finished)
        self._download_worker.error.connect(self._on_download_error)
        self._download_worker.start()

    def _on_download_finished(self, saved_path: Optional[Path]):
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_download.setText("📥 Скачать в коллекцию")
        if saved_path and saved_path.exists():
            self.card_downloaded.emit(saved_path)
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Успешно", f"Карточка сохранена в коллекцию:\n{saved_path.name}")
            self.accept()
        else:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Ошибка", "Не удалось скачать карточку с Chub.ai.")

    def _on_download_error(self, err: str):
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_download.setText("📥 Скачать в коллекцию")
        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Ошибка загрузки", f"{err}")

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        if self._avatar_worker and self._avatar_worker.isRunning():
            self._avatar_worker.abort()
            self._avatar_worker.wait(200)
        super().closeEvent(event)

"""
Civitai / Civitai Red Catalog Browser & Chunked Downloader for NeonRoute.
Provides responsive grid browsing, tag/architecture filtering (SD 1.5 / SDXL / Pony),
and safe background streaming downloads directly into SD Forge models directory.
"""

import hashlib
import io
import time
import urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

import requests

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QThread, pyqtSignal, QSize

    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit,
    QPushButton, QComboBox, QCheckBox, QListWidget, QListWidgetItem,

CIVITAI_CACHE_DIR = DATA_DIR / "cache" / "civitai_thumbs"
CIVITAI_CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

CIVITAI_API_BASE = "https://civitai.com/api/v1"


def render_civitai_poster(
    image_path: Optional[str] = None,
    name: str = "?",
    width: int = 130,
    height: int = 150,
    radius: int = 8
) -> QPixmap:
    """Генерирует вертикальный постер модели со скругленными углами."""
    pix = QPixmap(width, height)
    pix.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)

    painter = QPainter(pix)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)

    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addRoundedRect(0.0, 0.0, float(width), float(height), float(radius), float(radius))
    painter.setClipPath(path)

    loaded = False
    if image_path:
        p = Path(image_path)
        if p.exists() and p.is_file():
            src_pix = QPixmap(str(p))
            if not src_pix.isNull():
                scaled = src_pix.scaled(
                    width, height,
                    Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
                    Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
                )
                x = (scaled.width() - width) // 2
                y = (scaled.height() - height) // 2
                painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, scaled, x, y, width, height)
                loaded = True

    if not loaded:
        painter.fillRect(0, 0, width, height, QColor("#121826"))
        initials = (name[:2] if name else "?").upper().strip()
        painter.setPen(QColor("#00F0FF"))
        font = painter.font()
        font.setPointSize(max(13, int(height * 0.18)))
        font.setBold(True)
        painter.setFont(font)
        painter.drawText(0, 0, width, height, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, initials)

    painter.setClipping(False)
    painter.setPen(QColor("rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)"))
    painter.drawRoundedRect(0, 0, width - 1, height - 1, radius, radius)
    painter.end()
    return pix


class CivitaiSearchWorker(QThread):
    results_ready = pyqtSignal(list, int, int, object)  # cards, total_pages, total_items, next_cursor
    error_occurred = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, query: str, model_type: Optional[str], base_model: Optional[str], sort: str, nsfw: bool, page: int, cursor: Optional[Any] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.query = query.strip()
        self.model_type = model_type
        self.base_model = base_model
        self.sort = sort
        self.nsfw = nsfw
        self.page = max(1, page)
        self.cursor = cursor

    def run(self):
        url = f"{CIVITAI_API_BASE}/models"
        params: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "limit": 20,
        }
        if self.sort:
            params["sort"] = self.sort
            if self.sort in ("Most Downloaded", "Highest Rated"):
                params["period"] = "AllTime"

        # Civitai строго запрещает 'page' при наличии 'query':
        if self.query:
            params["query"] = self.query
            if self.cursor is not None:
                params["cursor"] = self.cursor
        else:
            params["page"] = self.page

        if self.model_type:
            params["types"] = self.model_type
        if self.base_model:
            params["baseModels"] = self.base_model

        headers = {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            "Accept": "application/json"
        }

        try:
            resp = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=14.0)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                err_detail = ""
                try:
                    err_json = resp.json()
                    err_detail = err_json.get("message") or err_json.get("error") or str(err_json)
                except Exception:
                    err_detail = resp.text[:200]
                raise RuntimeError(f"Civitai вернул HTTP {resp.status_code}: {err_detail}")
            data = resp.json()
        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
            self.error_occurred.emit(f"Ошибка подключения: {e}")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            self.error_occurred.emit(f"Ошибка API Civitai: {e}")
            return

        items = data.get("items") or []
        meta = data.get("metadata") or {}
        next_cursor = meta.get("nextCursor")
        total_pages = meta.get("totalPages", 1) if not self.query else 0
        total_items = meta.get("totalItems", len(items)) if not self.query else len(items)

        cards = []
        for it in items:
            if not isinstance(it, dict):
                continue

            # Клиентский фильтр 18+: если чекбокс выключен, скрываем NSFW
            if not self.nsfw and it.get("nsfw", False):
                continue

            versions = it.get("modelVersions") or []
            primary_ver = versions[0] if versions else {}
            files = primary_ver.get("files") or []
            primary_file = next((f for f in files if f.get("primary")), files[0] if files else {})

            images = primary_ver.get("images") or []
            img_url = images[0].get("url") if images else None
            gen_meta = images[0].get("meta") if (images and isinstance(images[0].get("meta"), dict)) else {}

            size_kb = primary_file.get("sizeKB") or 0
            size_mb = size_kb / 1024.0

            file_hashes = primary_file.get("hashes") if isinstance(primary_file.get("hashes"), dict) else {}
            expected_sha256 = file_hashes.get("SHA256") or file_hashes.get("sha256")

            cards.append({
                "id": str(it.get("id", "")),
                "name": it.get("name", "Без названия").strip(),
                "type": it.get("type", "Checkpoint"),
                "nsfw": it.get("nsfw", False),
                "tags": it.get("tags") or [],
                "version_name": primary_ver.get("name", "v1.0"),
                "version_id": str(primary_ver.get("id", "")),
                "base_model": primary_ver.get("baseModel", "SD 1.5"),
                "trained_words": primary_ver.get("trainedWords") or [],
                "filename": primary_file.get("name", f"model_{it.get('id')}.safetensors"),
                "size_mb": size_mb,
                "download_url": primary_file.get("downloadUrl", ""),
                "sha256": expected_sha256,
                "preview_url": img_url,
                "meta": gen_meta,
                "description": it.get("description") or ""
            })

        self.results_ready.emit(cards, total_pages, total_items, next_cursor)


class CivitaiThumbnailsBatchWorker(QThread):
    thumb_loaded = pyqtSignal(int, str)

    def __init__(self, cards: List[Dict[str, Any]]):
        super().__init__()
        self.cards = list(cards)
        self._is_aborted = False
        self._executor: Optional[ThreadPoolExecutor] = None

    def abort(self):
        self._is_aborted = True
        if self._executor:
            try:
                self._executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _fetch_single(self, idx: int, url: Optional[str]):
        if self._is_aborted or not url:
            return
        cache_key = hashlib.md5(url.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        cache_path = CIVITAI_CACHE_DIR / f"{cache_key}.png"

        if not cache_path.exists():
            try:
                headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}
                resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=6.0)
                if resp.status_code == 200 and len(resp.content) > 300:
                    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(resp.content))
                    img.save(cache_path, format="PNG")
            except Exception:
                return

        if cache_path.exists() and not self._is_aborted:
            self.thumb_loaded.emit(idx, str(cache_path))

    def run(self):
        try:
            self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4, thread_name_prefix="CivitaiThumb")
            futures = []
            for idx, c in enumerate(self.cards):
                if self._is_aborted:
                    break
                futures.append(self._executor.submit(self._fetch_single, idx, c.get("preview_url")))

            for f in futures:
                if self._is_aborted:
                    break
                try:
                    f.result()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        except Exception:
            pass
        finally:
            if self._executor:
                try:
                    self._executor.shutdown(wait=False)
                except Exception:
                    pass



class CivitaiDownloadWorker(QThread):
    progress_updated = pyqtSignal(int, float, float)  # (percent, downloaded_mb, speed_mbps)
    finished_successfully = pyqtSignal(Path)
    error_occurred = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, download_url: str, dest_path: Path, api_token: Optional[str] = None, expected_sha256: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.download_url = download_url
        self.dest_path = dest_path
        self.api_token = api_token.strip() if api_token else None
        self.expected_sha256 = expected_sha256.strip().lower() if expected_sha256 else None
        self._is_aborted = False

    def abort(self):
        self._is_aborted = True

    def run(self):
        url = self.download_url
        if self.api_token:
            delim = "&" if "?" in url else "?"
            url = f"{url}{delim}token={self.api_token}"

        temp_part = self.dest_path.with_name(f"{self.dest_path.name}.part")

        headers = {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
        }

        try:
            # 1. Проверка расширения файла (строго .safetensors)
            if self.dest_path.suffix.lower() != ".safetensors":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Запрещенное расширение файла: {self.dest_path.suffix}. "
                    f"Разрешены строго безопасные веса .safetensors (.ckpt и .pt заблокированы)."
                )

            # 2. Проверка домена URL по белому списку (*.civitai.com) для защиты от SSRF
            parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
            hostname = (parsed_url.hostname or "").lower()
            if not (hostname == "civitai.com" or hostname.endswith(".civitai.com")):
                raise ValueError(f"SSRF защита: домен '{hostname}' не входит в белый список разрешенных хостов (*.civitai.com).")

            self.dest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with requests.get(url, headers=headers, stream=True, timeout=20.0, allow_redirects=True) as resp:
                if resp.status_code in (401, 403):
                    raise RuntimeError("Требуется авторизация Civitai. Укажите API-токен.")
                resp.raise_for_status()

                # Валидация хоста после перенаправлений (редиректов)
                final_hostname = (urllib.parse.urlparse(resp.url).hostname or "").lower()
                if not (final_hostname == "civitai.com" or final_hostname.endswith(".civitai.com")):
                    raise ValueError(f"SSRF защита: итоговый хост '{final_hostname}' не входит в белый список (*.civitai.com).")

                total_size = int(resp.headers.get("content-length", 0))
                downloaded = 0
                chunk_size = 1024 * 1024  # 1 MB chunk (zero RAM bloating)

                start_time = time.time()
                last_time = start_time
                last_downloaded = 0

                hasher = hashlib.sha256()

                with open(temp_part, "wb") as f:
                    for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
                        if self._is_aborted:
                            f.close()
                            temp_part.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                            self.error_occurred.emit("Загрузка отменена пользователем.")
                            return

                        if chunk:
                            f.write(chunk)
                            hasher.update(chunk)
                            downloaded += len(chunk)

                            now = time.time()
                            if now - last_time >= 0.4:
                                duration = now - last_time
                                speed_mbps = ((downloaded - last_downloaded) / (1024 * 1024)) / max(0.01, duration)
                                percent = int((downloaded / total_size) * 100) if total_size > 0 else 0
                                self.progress_updated.emit(percent, downloaded / (1024 * 1024), speed_mbps)
                                last_time = now
                                last_downloaded = downloaded

            # 3. Верификация SHA-256 хеша при наличии ожидаемого значения
            if self.expected_sha256:
                calc_hash = hasher.hexdigest().lower()
                if calc_hash != self.expected_sha256:
                    if temp_part.exists():
                        temp_part.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Ошибка целостности: не совпадает контрольная сумма SHA-256.\n"
                        f"Ожидалось: {self.expected_sha256}\nПолучено: {calc_hash}"
                    )

            if temp_part.exists():
                if self.dest_path.exists():
                    self.dest_path.unlink()
                temp_part.rename(self.dest_path)
                self.finished_successfully.emit(self.dest_path)

        except Exception as e:
            if temp_part.exists():
                temp_part.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            self.error_occurred.emit(str(e))

    def _on_search_clicked(self, reset_page: bool = True):
        if reset_page:
            self.current_page = 1
            self.current_cursor = None
            self.next_cursor = None
            self.cursor_stack.clear()

        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        m_type = self.combo_type.currentData()
        base_arch = self.combo_arch.currentData()
        sort = self.combo_sort.currentData()
        nsfw = self.chk_nsfw.isChecked()

        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(False)

        self._search_worker = CivitaiSearchWorker(
            query=query,
            model_type=m_type,
            base_model=base_arch,
            sort=sort,
            nsfw=nsfw,
            page=self.current_page,
            cursor=self.current_cursor
        )
        self._search_worker.results_ready.connect(self._on_results_ready)
        self._search_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_search_error)
        self._search_worker.start()

    def _on_prev_page_clicked(self):
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        if query:
            if self.cursor_stack:
                self.current_cursor = self.cursor_stack.pop()
                self.current_page = max(1, self.current_page - 1)
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)
        else:
            if self.current_page > 1:
                self.current_page -= 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_next_page_clicked(self):
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        if query:
            if self.next_cursor is not None:
                self.cursor_stack.append(self.current_cursor)
                self.current_cursor = self.next_cursor
                self.current_page += 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)
        else:
            if self.current_page < self.total_pages:
                self.current_page += 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_results_ready(self, cards: list, total_pages: int, total_items: int, next_cursor: Optional[Any]):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.cards_data = cards
        self.list_results.clear()
        self._cached_thumb_paths.clear()

        self.next_cursor = next_cursor
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()

        if query:
            self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page}")
            self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(len(self.cursor_stack) > 0)
            self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(bool(self.next_cursor))
        else:
            self.total_pages = max(1, total_pages)
            self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page} из {self.total_pages} (найдено: {total_items})")
            self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(self.current_page > 1)
            self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(self.current_page < self.total_pages or bool(self.next_cursor))

        if self._thumb_worker and self._thumb_worker.isRunning():
            self._thumb_worker.abort()
            self._thumb_worker.wait(150)

        for c in cards:
            c_name = c["name"]
            short_name = c_name[:15] + ("…" if len(c_name) > 15 else "")
            sz_str = f"{c['size_mb'] / 1024.0:.1f} GB" if c['size_mb'] > 1024 else f"{c['size_mb']:.0f} MB"
            type_tag = "📦" if c["type"] == "Checkpoint" else "⚡"

            item_text = f"{short_name}\n{type_tag} {c['base_model']} • {sz_str}"
            placeholder = render_civitai_poster(None, name=c_name, width=130, height=150)
            item = QListWidgetItem(QIcon(placeholder), item_text)
            self.list_results.addItem(item)

        if cards:
            self._thumb_worker = CivitaiThumbnailsBatchWorker(cards)
            self._thumb_worker.thumb_loaded.connect(self._on_thumb_loaded)
            self._thumb_worker.start()

            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.list_results.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self.lbl_title.setText("Ничего не найдено")
            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.lbl_meta.setText("Попробуйте изменить запрос или фильтры архитектуры.")
            self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(render_civitai_poster(None, name="?", width=90, height=110))
            self.text_preview.clear()
            self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_thumb_loaded(self, row_idx: int, img_path: str):
        self._cached_thumb_paths[row_idx] = img_path
        item = self.list_results.item(row_idx)
        if item and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            poster = render_civitai_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=130, height=150)
            item.setIcon(QIcon(poster))

        if self.list_results.currentRow() == row_idx and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            preview_pix = render_civitai_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=90, height=110)
            self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(preview_pix)

    def _on_search_error(self, err: str):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.list_results.clear()
        self.lbl_title.setText("🔌 Ошибка загрузки каталога")
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #FF007F; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
        self.lbl_meta.setText("Сбой запроса")
        self.text_preview.setPlainText(f"Не удалось получить данные с Civitai:\n{err}")
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_card_selected(self, current: Optional[QListWidgetItem]):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        self.lbl_title.setText(f"{c['name']} ({c['version_name']})")
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")

        sz_str = f"{c['size_mb'] / 1024.0:.2f} GB" if c['size_mb'] > 1024 else f"{c['size_mb']:.0f} MB"
        self.lbl_meta.setText(f"Тип: {c['type']} | Архитектура: {c['base_model']} | Размер: {sz_str}")

        triggers = c.get("trained_words") or []
        if triggers:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText(f"🏷️ Триггер-слова: {', '.join(triggers[:6])}")
        else:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText("🏷️ Триггер-слова: не требуются (стандартный чекпоинт)")

        # Рекомендованные параметры из метаданных превью
        meta = c.get("meta") or {}
        sampler = meta.get("sampler") or "DPM++ 2M Karras"
        steps = meta.get("steps") or 25
        cfg = meta.get("cfgScale") or 6.0

        desc_parts = [
            f"⚙️ Рекомендованные автором параметры:\n• Сэмплер: {sampler}\n• Шаги: {steps}\n• CFG Scale: {cfg}",
            f"📄 Имя файла: {c['filename']}",
            f"📖 Описание:\n{c.get('description', '')}"
        ]
        self.text_preview.setPlainText("\n\n".join(desc_parts).strip())

        cached_path = self._cached_thumb_paths.get(row)
        pix = render_civitai_poster(cached_path, name=c["name"], width=90, height=110)
        self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(pix)

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(bool(c.get("download_url")))
        self.btn_download.setText(f"📥 Скачать {c['type']} ({sz_str})")

    def _on_download_clicked(self):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        filename = c["filename"]

        # Папка назначения: checkpoints или lora
        if c["type"] == "LORA":
            save_dir = self.target_dir.parent / "Lora" if self.target_dir else Path(r"C:\neyroGPD\models\Lora")
        else:
            save_dir = self.target_dir

        dest_file = save_dir / filename

        if dest_file.suffix.lower() != ".safetensors":
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Запрещенный формат модели",
                f"Загрузка файлов с расширением '{dest_file.suffix}' заблокирована в целях безопасности.\n\n"
                f"Разрешены строго безопасные веса в формате .safetensors. Файлы .ckpt и .pt запрещены."
            )
            return

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_cancel_dl.setVisible(True)
        self.download_box.setVisible(True)
        self.dl_status_lbl.setText("Подключение к серверу загрузки...")
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(0)

        self._download_worker = CivitaiDownloadWorker(
            download_url=c["download_url"],
            dest_path=dest_file,
            expected_sha256=c.get("sha256")
        )
        self._download_worker.progress_updated.connect(self._on_download_progress)
        self._download_worker.finished_successfully.connect(self._on_download_success)
        self._download_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_download_error)
        self._download_worker.start()

    def _on_download_progress(self, percent: int, downloaded_mb: float, speed_mbps: float):
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(percent)
        self.dl_status_lbl.setText(f"Загрузка: {percent}% • {downloaded_mb:.1f} MB ({speed_mbps:.1f} MB/s)")

    def _on_cancel_download_clicked(self):
        if self._download_worker and self._download_worker.isRunning():
            self._download_worker.abort()
            self._download_worker.wait(300)
            self._reset_dl_ui()

    def _on_download_success(self, saved_path: Path):
        self._reset_dl_ui()
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        c = self.cards_data[row] if (0 <= row < len(self.cards_data)) else {}

        meta = c.get("meta") or {}
        triggers = c.get("trained_words") or []
        desc_text = f"{c.get('name', '')}. Теги: {', '.join(triggers[:8])}" if triggers else c.get('name', '')

        model_payload = {
            "id": c.get("id"),
            "name": c.get("name"),
            "filename": saved_path.name,
            "path": str(saved_path),
            "type": c.get("type"),
            "triggers": triggers,
            "description": desc_text,
            "guidance": f"Trigger words: {', '.join(triggers[:5])}" if triggers else "",
            "sampler": meta.get("sampler", "DPM++ 2M Karras"),
            "steps": int(meta.get("steps", 25)),
            "cfg_scale": float(meta.get("cfgScale", 6.0))
        }

        self.model_installed.emit(model_payload)
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Загрузка завершена",
            f"Модель успешно сохранена в папку Forge:\n{saved_path.name}\n\nОна автоматически зарегистрирована в роутере!"
        )
        self.accept()

    def _on_download_error(self, err: str):
        self._reset_dl_ui()
        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Ошибка загрузки", f"Не удалось завершить загрузку файла:\n{err}")

    def _reset_dl_ui(self):
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_cancel_dl.setVisible(False)
        self.download_box.setVisible(False)
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(0)

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        if self._thumb_worker and self._thumb_worker.isRunning():
            self._thumb_worker.abort()
            self._thumb_worker.wait(150)
        if self._download_worker and self._download_worker.isRunning():
            self._download_worker.abort()
            self._download_worker.wait(200)
        super().closeEvent(event)

"""
Civitai LoRA Search & Installation Dialog for NeonRoute.
Provides dedicated character LoRA discovery, SD 1.5 / SDXL / Pony compatibility evaluation,
and streaming downloads directly to Forge LoRA storage with automatic registry updates.
"""

import re

class CivitaiLoraDialog(QDialog):
    """
    Модальный диалог поиска и установки персонажных LoRA с Civitai
    с проверкой совместимости архитектур.
    """
    lora_installed = pyqtSignal(str, str, list)  # file_stem, character_name, trained_words

    @staticmethod
    def evaluate_compatibility(lora_base_model: str, active_forge_arch: str = "SD 1.5") -> dict:
        """
        Сравнивает семейство базовой модели LoRA с текущим активным чекпоинтом Forge.
        Возвращает словарь с флагом is_compatible, стилем бейджа и поясняющим текстом.
        """
        l_base = (lora_base_model or "").lower()
        a_base = (active_forge_arch or "").lower()

        is_sd15_lora = any(k in l_base for k in ["sd 1.5", "sd 1.4", "sd15"])
        is_sdxl_lora = any(k in l_base for k in ["sdxl", "pony", "illustrious"])

        is_current_sd15 = "1.5" in a_base
        is_current_sdxl = "xl" in a_base or "pony" in a_base

        if (is_sd15_lora and is_current_sd15) or (is_sdxl_lora and is_current_sdxl):
            return {
                "compatible": True,
                "badge": f"✅ {lora_base_model} (Совместимо)",
                "color": "#10B981",
                "warn_text": ""
            }
        else:
            return {
                "compatible": False,
                "badge": f"⚠️ {lora_base_model} (Несовместимо)",
                "color": "#F59E0B",
                "warn_text": (
                    f"Внимание: данная LoRA создана для архитектуры {lora_base_model}, "
                    f"в то время как ваш активный чекпоинт в Forge работает на {active_forge_arch}.\n"
                    f"Генерация артов с этой LoRA в текущем режиме вызовет визуальные артефакты или сбой."
                )
            }

    def __init__(
        self,
        character_name: str = "",
        initial_query: str = "",
        active_architecture: str = "SD 1.5",
        parent=None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.character_name = character_name.strip()
        if not initial_query and self.character_name:
            clean_q = re.sub(r'[\(\[].*?[\)\]]', '', self.character_name)
            clean_q = clean_q.split('-')[0].split('—')[0].strip()
            self.initial_query = clean_q
        else:
            self.initial_query = initial_query.strip()

        self.active_architecture = active_architecture or "SD 1.5"

        title_suffix = f" — {self.character_name}" if self.character_name else ""
        self.setWindowTitle(f"⚡ Поиск LoRA на Civitai{title_suffix}")
        self.resize(1180, 750)
        self.setMinimumSize(960, 600)

        self.cards_data: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.current_page: int = 1
        self.total_pages: int = 1

        self.next_cursor: Optional[Any] = None

        self._search_worker: Optional[CivitaiSearchWorker] = None
        self._thumb_worker: Optional[CivitaiThumbnailsBatchWorker] = None
        self._download_worker: Optional[CivitaiDownloadWorker] = None
        self._cached_thumb_paths: Dict[int, str] = {}

        self._setup_ui()
        self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=True)

    def _on_search_clicked(self, reset_page: bool = True):
        if reset_page:
            self.current_page = 1
            self.current_cursor = None
            self.next_cursor = None
            self.cursor_stack.clear()

        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        base_arch = self.combo_arch.currentData()
        sort = self.combo_sort.currentData()
        nsfw = self.chk_nsfw.isChecked()

        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(False)

        self._search_worker = CivitaiSearchWorker(
            query=query,
            model_type="LORA",
            base_model=base_arch,
            sort=sort,
            nsfw=nsfw,
            page=self.current_page,
            cursor=self.current_cursor
        )
        self._search_worker.results_ready.connect(self._on_results_ready)
        self._search_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_search_error)
        self._search_worker.start()

    def _on_prev_page_clicked(self):
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        if query:
            if self.cursor_stack:
                self.current_cursor = self.cursor_stack.pop()
                self.current_page = max(1, self.current_page - 1)
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)
        else:
            if self.current_page > 1:
                self.current_page -= 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_next_page_clicked(self):
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        if query:
            if self.next_cursor is not None:
                self.cursor_stack.append(self.current_cursor)
                self.current_cursor = self.next_cursor
                self.current_page += 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)
        else:
            if self.current_page < self.total_pages:
                self.current_page += 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_results_ready(self, cards: list, total_pages: int, total_items: int, next_cursor: Optional[Any]):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.cards_data = cards
        self.list_results.clear()
        self._cached_thumb_paths.clear()

        self.next_cursor = next_cursor
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()

        if query:
            self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page}")
            self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(len(self.cursor_stack) > 0)
            self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(bool(self.next_cursor))
        else:
            self.total_pages = max(1, total_pages)
            self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page} из {self.total_pages} (найдено: {total_items})")
            self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(self.current_page > 1)
            self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(self.current_page < self.total_pages or bool(self.next_cursor))

        if self._thumb_worker and self._thumb_worker.isRunning():
            self._thumb_worker.abort()
            self._thumb_worker.wait(150)

        for c in cards:
            c_name = c["name"]
            short_name = c_name[:15] + ("…" if len(c_name) > 15 else "")
            sz_str = f"{c['size_mb'] / 1024.0:.1f} GB" if c['size_mb'] > 1024 else f"{c['size_mb']:.0f} MB"
            comp_info = self.evaluate_compatibility(c.get("base_model", ""), self.active_architecture)

            item_text = f"{short_name}\n{comp_info['badge']} • {sz_str}"
            placeholder = render_civitai_poster(None, name=c_name, width=130, height=150)
            item = QListWidgetItem(QIcon(placeholder), item_text)
            item.setToolTip(f"{c_name}\nАрхитектура: {c.get('base_model', '')}\n{comp_info['badge']}\nРазмер: {sz_str}")
            self.list_results.addItem(item)

        if cards:
            self._thumb_worker = CivitaiThumbnailsBatchWorker(cards)
            self._thumb_worker.thumb_loaded.connect(self._on_thumb_loaded)
            self._thumb_worker.start()

            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.list_results.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self.lbl_title.setText("LoRA не найдены")
            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.lbl_compat_badge.setText("Совместимость: --")
            self.lbl_compat_badge.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px;")
            self.lbl_meta.setText("Попробуйте изменить поисковый запрос или фильтр архитектур.")
            self.lbl_warn_box.setVisible(False)
            self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(render_civitai_poster(None, name="?", width=90, height=110))
            self.text_preview.clear()
            self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_thumb_loaded(self, row_idx: int, img_path: str):
        self._cached_thumb_paths[row_idx] = img_path
        item = self.list_results.item(row_idx)
        if item and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            poster = render_civitai_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=130, height=150)
            item.setIcon(QIcon(poster))

        if self.list_results.currentRow() == row_idx and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            preview_pix = render_civitai_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=90, height=110)
            self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(preview_pix)

    def _on_search_error(self, err: str):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.list_results.clear()
        self.lbl_title.setText("🔌 Ошибка каталога Civitai")
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #FF007F; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
        self.lbl_compat_badge.setText("")
        self.lbl_meta.setText("Сбой запроса")
        self.lbl_warn_box.setVisible(False)
        self.text_preview.setPlainText(f"Не удалось получить список LoRA с Civitai:\n{err}")
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_card_selected(self, current: Optional[QListWidgetItem]):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        self.lbl_title.setText(f"{c['name']} ({c['version_name']})")
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")

        sz_str = f"{c['size_mb'] / 1024.0:.2f} GB" if c['size_mb'] > 1024 else f"{c['size_mb']:.0f} MB"
        self.lbl_meta.setText(f"Архитектура: {c['base_model']} | Размер: {sz_str}")

        # Бейдж совместимости
        comp_info = self.evaluate_compatibility(c.get("base_model", ""), self.active_architecture)
        self.lbl_compat_badge.setText(comp_info["badge"])
        self.lbl_compat_badge.setStyleSheet(f"color: {comp_info['color']}; font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px;")

        if not comp_info["compatible"]:
            self.lbl_warn_box.setText(comp_info["warn_text"])
            self.lbl_warn_box.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.lbl_warn_box.setVisible(False)

        triggers = c.get("trained_words") or []
        if triggers:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText(f"🏷️ Триггер-слова: {', '.join(triggers[:6])}")
        else:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText("🏷️ Триггер-слова: не указаны автором")

        meta = c.get("meta") or {}
        sampler = meta.get("sampler") or "DPM++ 2M Karras"
        steps = meta.get("steps") or 25
        cfg = meta.get("cfgScale") or 6.0

        desc_parts = [
            f"⚙️ Рекомендованные автором параметры:\n• Сэмплер: {sampler}\n• Шаги: {steps}\n• CFG Scale: {cfg}",
            f"📄 Имя файла: {c['filename']}",
            f"📖 Описание:\n{c.get('description', '')}"
        ]
        self.text_preview.setPlainText("\n\n".join(desc_parts).strip())

        cached_path = self._cached_thumb_paths.get(row)
        pix = render_civitai_poster(cached_path, name=c["name"], width=90, height=110)
        self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(pix)

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(bool(c.get("download_url")))
        self.btn_download.setText(f"📥 Скачать LoRA ({sz_str})")

    def _on_download_clicked(self):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        comp_info = self.evaluate_compatibility(c.get("base_model", ""), self.active_architecture)

        if not comp_info["compatible"]:
            resp = QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Несовпадение архитектуры",
                f"{comp_info['warn_text']}\n\nВы действительно хотите скачать этот файл?",
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
            )
            if resp != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
                return

        filename = c["filename"]
        dest_file = DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR / filename
        DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_cancel_dl.setVisible(True)
        self.download_box.setVisible(True)
        self.dl_status_lbl.setText("Подключение к серверу загрузки...")
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(0)

        self._download_worker = CivitaiDownloadWorker(
            download_url=c["download_url"],
            dest_path=dest_file
        )
        self._download_worker.progress_updated.connect(self._on_download_progress)
        self._download_worker.finished_successfully.connect(self._on_download_success)
        self._download_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_download_error)
        self._download_worker.start()

    def _on_download_progress(self, percent: int, downloaded_mb: float, speed_mbps: float):
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(percent)
        self.dl_status_lbl.setText(f"Загрузка LoRA: {percent}% • {downloaded_mb:.1f} MB ({speed_mbps:.1f} MB/s)")

    def _on_cancel_download_clicked(self):
        if self._download_worker and self._download_worker.isRunning():
            self._download_worker.abort()
            self._download_worker.wait(300)
            self._reset_dl_ui()

    def _on_download_success(self, saved_path: Path):
        self._reset_dl_ui()
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        c = self.cards_data[row] if (0 <= row < len(self.cards_data)) else {}

        trained_words = c.get("trained_words") or []
        file_stem = saved_path.stem
        char_name = self.character_name or file_stem

        # Регистрация LoRA в lora_registry.json
        LoraManager.register_character_lora(char_name, file_stem, trained_words)
        self.lora_installed.emit(file_stem, char_name, trained_words)
        self.accept()

    def _on_download_error(self, err: str):
        self._reset_dl_ui()
        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Ошибка загрузки", f"Не удалось завершить загрузку LoRA:\n{err}")

    def _reset_dl_ui(self):
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_cancel_dl.setVisible(False)
        self.download_box.setVisible(False)
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(0)

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        if self._thumb_worker and self._thumb_worker.isRunning():
            self._thumb_worker.abort()
            self._thumb_worker.wait(150)
        if self._download_worker and self._download_worker.isRunning():
            self._download_worker.abort()
            self._download_worker.wait(200)
        super().closeEvent(event)

"""
Clean Cache and Temporary Files Dialog for NeonRoute
Calculates disk usage and safely cleans Forge/Gradio cache, app logs, and generated outputs
using background QThreads without blocking the PyQt6 GUI event loop.
"""

import os
import shutil
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QThread, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor
import json
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QCheckBox,
    QPushButton, QProgressBar, QMessageBox, QFrame, QWidget
)

from config import FORGE_ROOT_DIR, HISTORY_DIR, BASE_DIR, LOGS_DIR, DATA_DIR, OUTPUTS_DIR, BACKGROUNDS_DIR, CONFIG_PATH, WORKSPACE_DIR

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.CleanCacheDialog")


def get_protected_background_paths() -> set[Path]:
    """
    Returns a set of resolved absolute Paths for backgrounds that must not be deleted:
    - Active background from config.json ('background_path')
    - Any background_image or background_path referenced in any chat history JSON
    """
    protected = set()
    try:
        if CONFIG_PATH.exists():
            with open(CONFIG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                cfg = json.load(f)
                bg_cfg = cfg.get("background_path")
                if bg_cfg:
                    p = Path(bg_cfg)
                    if not p.is_absolute():
                        p = BASE_DIR / p
                    if p.exists():
                        protected.add(p.resolve())
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Error reading config.json for protected backgrounds: {e}")

    try:
        if HISTORY_DIR.exists():
            for chat_file in HISTORY_DIR.glob("chat_*.json"):
                try:
                    with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        session_data = json.load(f)
                    for key in ("background_path", "background_image"):
                        bg_val = session_data.get(key)
                        if bg_val:
                            p = Path(bg_val)
                            if not p.is_absolute():
                                p = BASE_DIR / p
                            if p.exists():
                                protected.add(p.resolve())
                except Exception:
                    pass
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Error scanning history for protected backgrounds: {e}")

    return protected


def _get_orphan_cast_files() -> List[Path]:
    """Finds cast_*.json files in history/ that do not have a matching chat_*.json."""
    orphans = []
    try:
        if HISTORY_DIR.exists():
            for cast_file in HISTORY_DIR.glob("cast_*.json"):
                stem = cast_file.stem
                s_id = stem[5:] if stem.startswith("cast_") else ""
                if s_id and not (HISTORY_DIR / f"chat_{s_id}.json").exists():
                    orphans.append(cast_file)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Error finding orphan cast files: {e}")
    return orphans


def _get_orphan_workspace_project_dirs() -> List[Path]:
    """Finds project folders in WORKSPACE_DIR / 'projects' without matching chat_<id>.json in HISTORY_DIR."""
    orphans = []
    try:
        projects_dir = WORKSPACE_DIR / "projects"
        if projects_dir.exists() and projects_dir.is_dir():
            for p in projects_dir.iterdir():
                if p.is_dir():
                    s_id = p.name
                    if not (HISTORY_DIR / f"chat_{s_id}.json").exists():
                        orphans.append(p)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Error finding orphan workspace projects: {e}")
    return orphans


def format_size(size_bytes: int) -> str:
    """Formats bytes into human-readable B, KB, MB, GB."""
    if size_bytes <= 0:
        return "0 MB"
    val = float(size_bytes)
    for unit in ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB']:
        if val < 1024.0 or unit == 'TB':
            return f"{val:.1f} {unit}"
        val /= 1024.0
    return f"{val:.1f} GB"


def get_dir_size(path: Path) -> int:
    """Calculates total size in bytes of a directory recursively."""
    total = 0
    if not path.exists():
        return 0
    try:
        if path.is_file():
            return path.stat().st_size
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(str(path)):
            for f in files:
                try:
                    fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                    total += os.path.getsize(fp)
                except (OSError, PermissionError):
                    pass
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug(f"Error calculating size for {path}: {e}")
    return total


class CacheScanWorker(QThread):
    """Calculates disk sizes for cache categories in background."""
    scan_completed = pyqtSignal(dict)  # category_key -> size_in_bytes

    def __init__(self, targets: Dict[str, List[Path]], parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.targets = targets

    def run(self):
        try:
            results = {}
            protected_bgs = get_protected_background_paths()
            for key, paths in self.targets.items():
                total = 0
                if key == "backgrounds":
                    for p in paths:
                        if p.is_file() and p.resolve() not in protected_bgs:
                            total += get_dir_size(p)
                        elif p.is_dir():
                            for f in p.rglob("*"):
                                if f.is_file() and f.resolve() not in protected_bgs:
                                    total += get_dir_size(f)
                else:
                    for p in paths:
                        total += get_dir_size(p)
                results[key] = total
            self.scan_completed.emit(results)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error in CacheScanWorker: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.scan_completed.emit({})



class CacheCleanWorker(QThread):
    """Deletes selected cache files and directories in background."""
    progress_updated = pyqtSignal(str)
    clean_completed = pyqtSignal(int, list)  # freed_bytes, list of cleared description strings

    def __init__(self, selected_targets: Dict[str, List[Path]], parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.selected_targets = selected_targets

    def run(self):
        total_freed = 0
        cleared_summary = []
        protected_bgs = get_protected_background_paths()

        for category, paths in self.selected_targets.items():
            self.progress_updated.emit(f"Очистка: {category}...")
            cat_freed = 0

            if "backgrounds" in category.lower() or "обои" in category.lower():
                for p in paths:
                    if not p.exists():
                        continue
                    files_to_check = [p] if p.is_file() else list(p.rglob("*"))
                    for f in files_to_check:
                        if f.is_file() and f.resolve() not in protected_bgs:
                            try:
                                sz = f.stat().st_size
                                f.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                                cat_freed += sz
                            except Exception as e:
                                logger.warning(f"Failed to delete background {f}: {e}")
                total_freed += cat_freed
                cleared_summary.append(f"{category} ({format_size(cat_freed)})")
                continue

            for p in paths:
                if not p.exists():
                    continue

                cat_freed += get_dir_size(p)

                try:
                    if p.is_file():
                        p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    elif p.is_dir():
                        # Delete contents or entire dir and recreate empty
                        current_active_log = (LOGS_DIR / "neonroute.log").resolve()
                        for item in p.iterdir():
                            if item.resolve() == current_active_log:
                                try:
                                    with open(item, "r+", encoding="utf-8") as f_trunc:
                                        f_trunc.truncate(0)
                                except (PermissionError, OSError):
                                    pass
                                continue
                            try:
                                if item.is_file() or item.is_symlink():
                                    item.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                                elif item.is_dir():
                                    shutil.rmtree(item, ignore_errors=True)
                            except (PermissionError, OSError) as e:
                                logger.warning(f"Файл заблокирован процессом Windows, пропуск: {item} ({e})")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Error cleaning {p}: {e}")

            total_freed += cat_freed
            cleared_summary.append(f"{category} ({format_size(cat_freed)})")

        # Компактная очистка и оптимизация версий LanceDB
        try:
            self.progress_updated.emit("Оптимизация базы векторов LanceDB...")
            from services.memory_db import _get_embedding_engine, _LANCE_LOCK
            embed_model, facts_t, rp_t = _get_embedding_engine()
            for tbl in (facts_t, rp_t):
                if tbl:
                    with _LANCE_LOCK:
                        try:
                            if hasattr(tbl, "compact_files"):
                                tbl.compact_files()
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] compact_files error: {e}")
                        try:
                            if hasattr(tbl, "cleanup_old_versions"):
                                tbl.cleanup_old_versions()
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] cleanup_old_versions error: {e}")

            # Если в HISTORY_DIR нет ни одного РП-чата — полная очистка таблицы rp_memories
            has_rp_chats = False
            if HISTORY_DIR.exists():
                for cf in HISTORY_DIR.glob("chat_*.json"):
                    try:
                        with open(cf, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f_chat:
                            c_data = json.load(f_chat)
                            if c_data.get("mode") == "roleplay":
                                has_rp_chats = True
                                break
                    except Exception:
                        pass

            if not has_rp_chats:
                import lancedb
                from config import DATA_DIR
                lance_path = DATA_DIR / "vector_memory"
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    db = lancedb.connect(str(lance_path))
                    tables = db.list_tables() if hasattr(db, "list_tables") else db.table_names()
                    if "rp_memories" in tables:
                        try:
                            # Удаление директории таблицы или drop_table
                            rp_dir = lance_path / "rp_memories.lance"
                            if rp_dir.exists():
                                shutil.rmtree(rp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
                            else:
                                db.drop_table("rp_memories")
                        except Exception as e_drop:
                            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] Drop table error: {e_drop}")

                    if embed_model:
                        try:
                            dummy_vec = list(embed_model.embed(["init"]))[0].tolist()
                            db.create_table(
                                "rp_memories",
                                data=[{
                                    "id": "init_id",
                                    "session_id": "init_sess",
                                    "text": "init",
                                    "vector": dummy_vec,
                                    "timestamp": "0"
                                }]
                            )
                        except Exception as e_cr:
                            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] Recreate table error: {e_cr}")

                cleared_summary.append("Векторная память РП (LanceDB сброшена)")
        except Exception as e_lance:
            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] Ошибка очистки LanceDB: {e_lance}")

        from ui.components.chat_bubble import _IMAGE_CACHE_LOCK, _IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE
        from PyQt6.QtGui import QPixmapCache
        with _IMAGE_CACHE_LOCK:
            _IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE.clear()
        QPixmapCache.clear()

        self.clean_completed.emit(total_freed, cleared_summary)

        self.chk_backgrounds.setChecked(True)
        row_bg.addWidget(self.chk_backgrounds, stretch=1)
        self.lbl_size_backgrounds = QLabel("⏳ Подсчет...", card)
        self.lbl_size_backgrounds.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-weight: bold;")
        row_bg.addWidget(self.lbl_size_backgrounds)
        card_layout.addLayout(row_bg)

        # 5. Generated Images Outputs (UNCHECKED by default for safety!)
        row3 = QHBoxLayout()
        self.chk_outputs = QCheckBox("Сгенерированные изображения (C:\\NeonRoute\\outputs\\)", card)
        self.chk_outputs.setChecked(False)
        self.chk_outputs.setToolTip("Внимание: удалит все ранее сгенерированные изображения в папке outputs!")
        row3.addWidget(self.chk_outputs, stretch=1)
        self.lbl_size_outputs = QLabel("⏳ Подсчет...", card)
        self.lbl_size_outputs.setStyleSheet("color: #F87171; font-weight: bold;")
        row3.addWidget(self.lbl_size_outputs)
        card_layout.addLayout(row3)

        main_layout.addWidget(card)

        # Status and Progress Bar
        self.lbl_status = QLabel("Подсчет занятого дискового пространства...", self)
        self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px;")
        main_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_status)

        self.progress_bar = QProgressBar(self)
        self.progress_bar.setFixedHeight(8)
        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)  # indeterminate animation during scan
        self.progress_bar.setTextVisible(False)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.progress_bar)

        # Bottom Action Buttons
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout.addStretch()

        self.btn_cancel = QPushButton("Отмена", self)
        self.btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_cancel)

        self.btn_clean = QPushButton("🗑️ Очистить выбранное", self)
        self.btn_clean.setObjectName("BtnClean")
        self.btn_clean.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.btn_clean.clicked.connect(self._on_clean_clicked)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_clean)

        main_layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _start_size_scan(self):
        """Launches non-blocking size calculation."""
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.scan_worker = CacheScanWorker(self.target_paths, self)
        self.scan_worker.scan_completed.connect(self._on_scan_completed)
        self.scan_worker.start()

    def _on_scan_completed(self, sizes: dict):
        self.category_sizes = sizes
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.lbl_status.setText("Подсчет завершен. Выберите элементы и нажмите 'Очистить'.")

        self.lbl_size_forge.setText(format_size(sizes.get("forge_cache", 0)))
        self.lbl_size_logs.setText(format_size(sizes.get("app_logs", 0)))
        self.lbl_size_chub.setText(format_size(sizes.get("chub_cache", 0)))
        self.lbl_size_backgrounds.setText(format_size(sizes.get("backgrounds", 0)))
        self.lbl_size_outputs.setText(format_size(sizes.get("outputs", 0)))

    def _on_clean_clicked(self):
        # Prepare selected targets
        selected: Dict[str, List[Path]] = {}
        if self.chk_forge.isChecked():
            selected["Кэш Forge/Gradio"] = self.target_paths["forge_cache"]
        if self.chk_logs.isChecked():
            # For history dir, only clean temporary .tmp and .bak files and orphan cast files, never chat_*.json
            paths_to_clean = [
                LOGS_DIR,
                BASE_DIR / "neonroute.log",
                *list(HISTORY_DIR.glob("*.tmp")),
                *list(HISTORY_DIR.glob("*.bak")),
                *_get_orphan_cast_files()
            ]
            selected["Логи и временные файлы"] = paths_to_clean
        if self.chk_chub.isChecked():
            selected["Кэш каталога Chub.ai"] = self.target_paths["chub_cache"]
        if self.chk_backgrounds.isChecked():
            selected["Неиспользуемые обои рабочего пространства"] = self.target_paths["backgrounds"]
        if self.chk_outputs.isChecked():
            # Extra confirmation if deleting user generated images
            reply = QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Подтверждение удаления изображений",
                "Вы выбрали удаление всех сгенерированных изображений из C:\\NeonRoute\\outputs\\.\n\n"
                "Вы уверены, что хотите удалить их?",
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
            )
            if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
                return
            selected["Сгенерированные изображения"] = self.target_paths["outputs"]

        if not selected:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Очистка", "Не выбрано ни одной категории для очистки.")
            return

        # Disable buttons and start progress
        self.btn_clean.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_cancel.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_forge.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_logs.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_chub.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_backgrounds.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_outputs.setEnabled(False)

        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.lbl_status.setText("Выполняется безопасное удаление файлов...")

        self.clean_worker = CacheCleanWorker(selected, self)
        self.clean_worker.progress_updated.connect(lambda msg: self.lbl_status.setText(msg))
        self.clean_worker.clean_completed.connect(self._on_clean_completed)
        self.clean_worker.start()

    def _on_clean_completed(self, freed_bytes: int, summary: list):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.lbl_status.setText("Очистка успешно завершена.")

        freed_str = format_size(freed_bytes)
        summary_text = "\n• " + "\n• ".join(summary) if summary else ""

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Очистка завершена",
            f"Очистка успешно выполнена!\nОсвобождено дискового пространства: {freed_str}{summary_text}"
        )
        self.accept()
