from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton,
    QCheckBox, QScrollArea, QWidget, QFrame, QMessageBox, QProgressBar
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from services.environment_doctor import EnvironmentDoctor, PipInstallWorker
from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager

class DependencyDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Проверка компонентов NeonRoute")
        self.resize(640, 520)
        self.setModal(True)
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1f; color: #ffffff; }
            QLabel { color: #ffffff; }
            QScrollArea { border: 1px solid #2d2d38; background: transparent; }
            QScrollBar:vertical { border: none; background: #1a1a1f; width: 8px; }
            QScrollBar::handle:vertical { background: #3d3d4d; border-radius: 4px; }
        """)

        self.missing_items = EnvironmentDoctor.check_missing()
        self.checkboxes = {}
        self.worker = None

        self._init_ui()

    def _init_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setSpacing(14)
        layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20)

        h_lbl = QLabel("Дополнительные компоненты для режима Инженер")
        h_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #00e5ff;")
        layout.addWidget(h_lbl)

        sub_lbl = QLabel("Для полной автономной работы модулей Инженера рекомендуются следующие библиотеки:")
        sub_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; color: #a0a0b0;")
        sub_lbl.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(sub_lbl)

        scroll = QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        container = QWidget()
        c_layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        c_layout.setSpacing(10)
        c_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)

        if not self.missing_items:
            all_ok_lbl = QLabel("✅ Все необходимые компоненты и библиотеки уже установлены!")
            all_ok_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 14px; color: #00e676; padding: 20px;")
            c_layout.addWidget(all_ok_lbl)
        else:
            for item in self.missing_items:
                card = QFrame()
                card.setStyleSheet("background-color: #22222c; border: 1px solid #323242; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px;")
                card_l = QVBoxLayout(card)

                cb = QCheckBox(item["name"])
                cb.setStyleSheet("font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff;")
                if item["type"] == "python":
                    cb.setChecked(True)
                    self.checkboxes[item["package"]] = cb
                else:
                    cb.setChecked(False)
                    cb.setEnabled(False)

                desc = QLabel(item["description"])
                desc.setStyleSheet("font-size: 12px; color: #c0c0d0; margin-left: 20px;")
                desc.setWordWrap(True)

                conseq = QLabel(f"Если не ставить: {item['consequence']}")
                conseq.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #ffb74d; margin-left: 20px;")
                conseq.setWordWrap(True)

                card_l.addWidget(cb)
                card_l.addWidget(desc)
                card_l.addWidget(conseq)

                if item["type"] == "binary" and "install_guide" in item:
                    guide = QLabel(f"Подсказка: {item['install_guide']}")
                    guide.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #80cbc4; margin-left: 20px;")
                    guide.setWordWrap(True)
                    card_l.addWidget(guide)

                c_layout.addWidget(card)

        c_layout.addStretch()
        scroll.setWidget(container)
        layout.addWidget(scroll)

        # Прогресс-бар
        self.progress_bar = QProgressBar()
        self.progress_bar.setStyleSheet("""
            QProgressBar { border: 1px solid #3d3d4d; border-radius: 4px; text-align: center; color: white; background: #15151a; height: 18px; }
            QProgressBar::chunk { background-color: #00e5ff; }
        """)
        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        self.progress_bar.hide()
        layout.addWidget(self.progress_bar)

        self.status_lbl = QLabel("")
        self.status_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 12px; color: #00e5ff;")
        self.status_lbl.hide()
        layout.addWidget(self.status_lbl)

        # Чекбокс «Больше не показывать»
        self.cb_dont_show = QCheckBox("Больше не показывать это окно при запуске")
        self.cb_dont_show.setStyleSheet("color: #a0a0b0; font-size: 12px;")
        layout.addWidget(self.cb_dont_show)

        # Кнопки
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout.addStretch()

        self.btn_skip = QPushButton("Пропустить")
        self.btn_skip.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton { background-color: #2d2d38; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; }
            QPushButton:hover { background-color: #3d3d4d; }
        """)
        self.btn_skip.clicked.connect(self._on_skip)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_skip)

        self.btn_install = QPushButton("Установить выбранное")
        self.btn_install.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton { background-color: #00b0ff; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 13px; }
            QPushButton:hover { background-color: #40c4ff; }
            QPushButton:disabled { background-color: #555566; color: #888888; }
        """)
        self.btn_install.setEnabled(bool(self.checkboxes))
        self.btn_install.clicked.connect(self._on_install)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_install)

        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _on_skip(self):
        if self.cb_dont_show.isChecked():
            cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
            cfg["check_dependencies_on_startup"] = False
            ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)

            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Проверка компонентов",
                "Договорились, больше не буду беспокоить при старте!\n\n"
                "Если компоненты понадобятся позже — вы всегда можете запустить эту проверку вручную через верхнее меню:\n"
                "«Справка» → «Проверка компонентов...»."
            )
        self.reject()

    def _on_install(self):
        to_install = [pkg for pkg, cb in self.checkboxes.items() if cb.isChecked()]
        if not to_install:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Внимание", "Не выбран ни один компонент для установки.")
            return

        self.btn_install.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_skip.setEnabled(False)
        self.progress_bar.show()
        self.status_lbl.show()

        self.worker = PipInstallWorker(to_install)
        self.worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        self.worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        self.worker.start()

    def _on_progress(self, msg: str):
        self.status_lbl.setText(msg)

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, msg: str):
        self.progress_bar.hide()
        self.status_lbl.hide()
        self.btn_skip.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_install.setEnabled(True)

        if success:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Успех", msg)
            self.accept()
        else:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Ошибка установки", msg)

"""
Engineer Settings Dialog for NeonRoute.
Allows selecting and persisting a dedicated LLM model for the autonomous Engineer Mode,
with immediate model switching and VRAM reload when Engineer Mode is active.
"""

import logging
from typing import Optional, List

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QComboBox,
    QPushButton, QWidget
)

from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.EngineerSettingsDialog")


class EngineerSettingsDialog(QDialog):
    """
    Модальное окно настройки выделенной модели для режима «Инженер» (NeonRoute glassmorphism стиль).
    """

    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):

                border-bottom-right-radius: 6px;
            }
            QComboBox QAbstractItemView {
                background-color: #121824;
                color: #E2E8F0;
                selection-background-color: #1C273C;
                selection-color: #00F0FF;
                border: 1px solid #1E283D;
            }
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #172133;
                color: #E2E8F0;
                border: 1px solid #283954;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 7px 16px;
                font-size: 12px;
                font-weight: 500;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #202D45;
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
            QPushButton#btn_save {
                background-color: #004D54;
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                color: #FFFFFF;
                font-weight: bold;
            }
            QPushButton#btn_save:hover {
                background-color: #00737D;
            }
            QPushButton#btn_refresh {
                padding: 6px 12px;
                font-size: 13px;
            }
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(22, 18, 22, 18)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        self.lbl_title = QLabel("🛠️ НАСТРОЙКИ РЕЖИМА «ИНЖЕНЕР»", self)
        self.lbl_title.setObjectName("header_title")
        layout.addWidget(self.lbl_title)

        # Поясняющий текст
        self.lbl_desc = QLabel(
            "Выберите модель, которая будет гарантированно активироваться при включении режима «Инженер»",
            self
        )
        self.lbl_desc.setObjectName("header_sub")
        self.lbl_desc.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.lbl_desc)

        # Поле выбора модели и кнопка обновления
        model_row = QHBoxLayout()
        model_row.setSpacing(8)

        self.combo_models.setEditable(False)
        model_row.addWidget(self.combo_models, stretch=1)

        self.btn_refresh.setObjectName("btn_refresh")
        self.btn_refresh.setToolTip("Обновить список моделей через LM Studio")
        self.btn_refresh.setFixedWidth(40)

        self.btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        btn_row.addWidget(self.btn_cancel)

        self.btn_save = QPushButton("💾 Сохранить", self)
        self.btn_save.setObjectName("btn_save")
        self.btn_save.clicked.connect(self._on_save_clicked)
        btn_row.addWidget(self.btn_save)

        layout.addLayout(btn_row)

        # Начальная загрузка настроек
        self._load_models_and_settings()

    def _get_available_models(self) -> List[str]:
        """Получает список доступных моделей через parent.lm_client.get_models() с fallback на lm_combo."""
        models: List[str] = []
        parent_win = getattr(self, "_parent_ref", None) or self.parent()

        if parent_win and hasattr(parent_win, "lm_client") and parent_win.lm_client:
            try:
                models = parent_win.lm_client.get_models() or []
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Ошибка получения моделей от lm_client: {e}")

        # Fallback на варианты из parent.lm_combo, если lm_client пуст
        if not models and parent_win and hasattr(parent_win, "lm_combo"):
            combo = parent_win.lm_combo
            if hasattr(combo, "count"):
                for i in range(combo.count()):
                    txt = combo.itemText(i).strip()
                    if txt and not txt.startswith("default") and txt not in models:
                        models.append(txt)

        return models

    def _load_models_and_settings(self) -> None:
        """Считывает сохранённую модель из config.json и заполняет список."""
        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        saved_model = (cfg.get("engineer_model_name") or cfg.get("engineer_model", "")).strip()

        models = self._get_available_models()

        self.combo_models.blockSignals(True)
        self.combo_models.clear()

        for m in models:
            self.combo_models.addItem(m)

        if saved_model:
            idx = self.combo_models.findText(saved_model)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.combo_models.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            else:
                self.combo_models.addItem(saved_model)
                self.combo_models.setCurrentIndex(self.combo_models.count() - 1)
        elif self.combo_models.count() > 0:
            self.combo_models.setCurrentIndex(0)

        self.combo_models.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_refresh_clicked(self) -> None:
        """Обновляет список моделей при нажатии на 🔄."""
        curr_selected = self.combo_models.currentText().strip()
        models = self._get_available_models()

        self.combo_models.blockSignals(True)
        self.combo_models.clear()

        for m in models:
            self.combo_models.addItem(m)

        if curr_selected:
            idx = self.combo_models.findText(curr_selected)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.combo_models.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            else:
                self.combo_models.addItem(curr_selected)
                self.combo_models.setCurrentIndex(self.combo_models.count() - 1)
        elif self.combo_models.count() > 0:
            self.combo_models.setCurrentIndex(0)

        self.combo_models.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_save_clicked(self) -> None:
        """
        Сохраняет выбранную модель в config.json под ключом 'engineer_model'.
        При активном режиме «Инженер» немедленно переключает модель и производит сброс/загрузку VRAM.
        """
        selected_model = self.combo_models.currentText().strip()

        # 1. Запись в config.json
        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        cfg["engineer_model_name"] = selected_model
        cfg["engineer_model"] = selected_model
        ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)

        parent_win = getattr(self, "_parent_ref", None) or self.parent()
        if parent_win:
            if hasattr(parent_win, "app_config") and isinstance(parent_win.app_config, dict):
                parent_win.app_config["engineer_model_name"] = selected_model
                parent_win.app_config["engineer_model"] = selected_model

            # 2. Проверка активности режима «Инженер»
            is_eng_active = False
            if hasattr(parent_win, "is_engineer_mode_active"):
                try:
                    is_eng_active = bool(parent_win.is_engineer_mode_active())
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug(f"is_engineer_mode_active check: {e}")

            if is_eng_active and selected_model:
                # Переключение parent_win.lm_combo
                if hasattr(parent_win, "lm_combo"):
                    idx = parent_win.lm_combo.findText(selected_model)
                    if idx >= 0:
                        parent_win.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
                    else:
                        parent_win.lm_combo.addItem(selected_model)
                        parent_win.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(parent_win.lm_combo.count() - 1)

                # Обновление активной модели окна
                parent_win.active_lms_model = selected_model

                # Обновление model_id текущей сессии
                if getattr(parent_win, "current_session", None):
                    parent_win.current_session["model_id"] = selected_model
                    if hasattr(parent_win, "_save_current_session"):
                        try:
                            parent_win._save_current_session()
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.warning(f"Ошибка сохранения сессии при смене модели инженера: {e}")



        self.accept()

"""
Local LoRA Picker Dialog for NeonRoute.
Scans SD WebUI Forge models/Lora directory, provides quick filtering,
weight tuning, and trigger tags injection.
"""

import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any, Tuple

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QSize
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit,
    QListWidget, QListWidgetItem, QPushButton, QDoubleSpinBox,
    QFileDialog, QMessageBox, QFrame
)

from config import DATA_DIR, BASE_DIR, FORGE_LORA_DIRS, DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR, LORA_REGISTRY_PATH

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.LocalLoraDialog")


def get_forge_lora_dirs() -> List[Path]:
    """Возвращает список существующих путей поиска моделей LoRA в Forge."""
    existing = [p.resolve() for p in FORGE_LORA_DIRS if p.exists() and p.is_dir()]
    if not existing:
        DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        existing.append(DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR.resolve())
    return existing


class LocalLoraDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, character_name: str = "", parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Выбор локальной LoRA — NeonRoute")
        self.setModal(True)
        self.resize(580, 480)
        self.character_name = character_name.strip()
        self.selected_lora_stem: Optional[str] = None
        self.selected_triggers: List[str] = []

        self._lora_registry = self._load_registry()
        self._all_lora_files: List[Path] = []

        self._setup_ui()
        self._scan_loras()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""

                color: #F8FAFC;
                border: 1px solid #1E2B42;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 6px 8px;
                font-size: 12px;
            }
            QLineEdit:focus, QDoubleSpinBox:focus {
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;

            }

                border-color: #00F0FF;

            }
            QListWidget::item:selected {
                background-color: #16253D;

                font-weight: bold;
            }
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #172133;
                color: #E2E8F0;
                border: 1px solid #283954;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 6px 12px;
                font-size: 12px;
                font-weight: 600;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #202D45;
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
            QPushButton#btn_primary {
                background-color: #004D54;
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
            QPushButton#btn_primary:hover {
                background-color: #00737D;
                color: #FFFFFF;
            }
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(16, 16, 16, 16)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        # Header
        hdr = QLabel(f"📁 ЛОКАЛЬНЫЕ LoRA ФАЙЛЫ (SD WebUI Forge)")
        hdr.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
        layout.addWidget(hdr)

        # Search bar
        self.search_input = QLineEdit()
        self.search_input.setPlaceholderText("🔍 Быстрый поиск по имени файла...")
        self.search_input.textChanged.connect(self._filter_list)
        layout.addWidget(self.search_input)

        # List
        self.list_widget = QListWidget()
        self.list_widget.itemDoubleClicked.connect(self._on_item_double_clicked)
        self.list_widget.currentItemChanged.connect(self._on_item_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self.list_widget, stretch=1)

        # Triggers Preview
        self.lbl_triggers = QLabel("Активационные слова: (не заданы)")
        self.lbl_triggers.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 11px;")
        layout.addWidget(self.lbl_triggers)

        # Weight Controls & Custom File
        row_controls = QHBoxLayout()
        row_controls.addWidget(QLabel("Сила LoRA (вес):"))

        self.spin_weight = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.spin_weight.setRange(0.10, 1.50)
        self.spin_weight.setSingleStep(0.05)
        self.spin_weight.setValue(0.85)
        row_controls.addWidget(self.spin_weight)

        btn_browse = QPushButton("📂 Выбрать другой файл...")
        btn_browse.clicked.connect(self._browse_custom_file)
        row_controls.addWidget(btn_browse)

        row_controls.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(row_controls)

        # Buttons
        btn_box = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_box.addStretch()

        self.btn_apply = QPushButton("Привязать LoRA")
        self.btn_apply.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        self.btn_apply.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_apply.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        btn_box.addWidget(self.btn_apply)

        btn_cancel = QPushButton("Отмена")
        btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        btn_box.addWidget(btn_cancel)

        layout.addLayout(btn_box)

    def _load_registry(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        reg_path = LORA_REGISTRY_PATH
        if reg_path.exists():
            try:
                with open(reg_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    return json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(f"Failed to read lora_registry: {e}")
        return {}

    def _scan_loras(self):
        self._all_lora_files.clear()
        dirs = get_forge_lora_dirs()
        for d in dirs:
            for f in d.rglob("*.safetensors"):
                if f.is_file() and f not in self._all_lora_files:
                    self._all_lora_files.append(f)

        # Сортировка: подходящие под имя персонажа — наверх
        name_clean = "".join(c for c in self.character_name.lower() if c.isalnum())
        def _sort_key(p: Path):
            stem = p.stem.lower()
            is_match = bool(name_clean and name_clean in "".join(c for c in stem if c.isalnum()))
            return (0 if is_match else 1, stem)

        self._all_lora_files.sort(key=_sort_key)
        self._filter_list(self.search_input.text())

    def _filter_list(self, query: str):
        self.list_widget.clear()
        q = query.strip().lower()
        name_clean = "".join(c for c in self.character_name.lower() if c.isalnum())

        for p in self._all_lora_files:
            stem = p.stem
            if q and q not in stem.lower():
                continue

            size_mb = p.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)
            is_match = bool(name_clean and name_clean in "".join(c for c in stem.lower() if c.isalnum()))

            prefix = "⭐ [Рекомендуется] " if is_match else "📦 "
            item = QListWidgetItem(f"{prefix}{stem}  ({size_mb:.1f} MB)")
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, str(p))
            if is_match:
                item.setForeground(Qt.GlobalColor.cyan)
            self.list_widget.addItem(item)

        if self.list_widget.count() > 0:
            self.list_widget.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _on_item_changed(self, current: Optional[QListWidgetItem], previous=None):
        if not current:
            self.btn_apply.setEnabled(False)
            self.lbl_triggers.setText("Активационные слова: (не заданы)")
            return

        p_str = current.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        p = Path(p_str)
        self.selected_lora_stem = p.stem
        self.btn_apply.setEnabled(True)

        # Поиск триггеров в реестре
        reg_info = self._lora_registry.get(p.stem, {})
        triggers = reg_info.get("trained_words", []) or reg_info.get("activation_tags", [])
        self.selected_triggers = list(triggers)

        if triggers:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText(f"Активационные слова: {', '.join(triggers[:5])}")
        else:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText("Активационные слова: (в реестре не найдены)")

    def _on_item_double_clicked(self, item: QListWidgetItem):
        self._on_item_changed(item)
        if self.selected_lora_stem:
            self.accept()

    def _browse_custom_file(self):
        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Выберите файл LoRA", "", "LoRA (*.safetensors *.pt *.ckpt)"
        )
        if not file_path:
            return
        p = Path(file_path)
        self.selected_lora_stem = p.stem
        self.selected_triggers = []
        self.accept()

    def get_result(self) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
        """Возвращает строку инъекции тега LoRA и список триггеров."""
        stem = self.selected_lora_stem or ""
        weight = self.spin_weight.value()
        lora_tag = f"<lora:{stem}:{weight:.2f}>"
        return lora_tag, self.selected_triggers

"""
Chat Media Gallery Dialog for NeonRoute.
Displays responsive thumbnail grid of all images generated in the current conversation,
with full-size modal preview on click and quick access to Explorer folder.
"""

import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QSize
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPixmap, QIcon, QCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton,
    QLabel, QScrollArea, QWidget, QGridLayout, QFrame
)

from ui.components.chat_bubble import ImagePreviewDialog

class ThumbnailButton(QPushButton):
    """Clickable thumbnail image button with hover animation and glowing border."""
    def __init__(self, image_path: Path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.image_path = Path(image_path)
        self.setFixedSize(140, 140)
        self.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.setToolTip(f"{self.image_path.name}\n(Клик для полноразмерного просмотра)")

        # Render thumbnail
        pix = QPixmap(str(self.image_path))
        if not pix.isNull():
            thumb = pix.scaled(
                130, 130,
                Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
            )
            self.setIcon(QIcon(thumb))
            self.setIconSize(QSize(130, 130))

        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #0E1422;
                border: 1px solid #1E2B42;
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 4px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                background-color: #162035;
            }
            QPushButton:pressed {
                border-color: #FF0055;
            }
        """)


class ChatMediaGalleryDialog(QDialog):
    """
    Dialog displaying all images generated or attached in the active chat session.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        session_images_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
        image_paths: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        session_title: Optional[str] = None,
        parent=None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.session_id = session_id
        self.session_title = session_title or "Диалог"
        if session_images_dir is not None:
            self.session_images_dir = Path(session_images_dir)
        elif session_id == "all_sessions":
            from config import OUTPUTS_DIR
            self.session_images_dir = OUTPUTS_DIR
        else:
            self.session_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(session_id)

        found_paths = []
        if self.session_images_dir.exists():
            for ext in ("*.png", "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.webp"):
                found_paths.extend(list(self.session_images_dir.glob(ext)))

        if image_paths:
            for p in image_paths:
                p_path = Path(p)
                if p_path.exists() and p_path not in found_paths:
                    found_paths.append(p_path)

        # Sort newest first
        found_paths.sort(key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime if x.exists() else 0, reverse=True)
        self.image_paths = found_paths

        if self.session_id == "all_sessions":
            self.setWindowTitle(f"Медиа галерея — все изображения ({len(self.image_paths)})")
        else:
            title_suffix = f" • {self.session_title}" if self.session_title else ""
            self.setWindowTitle(f"Медиа галерея диалога — {len(self.image_paths)} изображений{title_suffix}")
        self.resize(760, 560)
        self.setMinimumSize(540, 400)

        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QDialog {
                background-color: #090C12;
                color: #CBD5E1;
            }
            QScrollArea {
                background: transparent;
                border: 1px solid #1A2438;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #151E2E;
                color: #E2E8F0;
                border: 1px solid #25354F;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 6px 16px;
                font-weight: 500;
                font-size: 13px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #1F2D45;
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
            QPushButton:pressed {
                background-color: #121A28;
            }
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(16, 16, 16, 16)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        # Header bar
        hdr_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        header_text = f"🖼️ Медиа галерея ({len(self.image_paths)})" if self.session_id == "all_sessions" else f"🖼️ Медиафайлы текущего диалога ({len(self.image_paths)})"
        title_lbl = QLabel(header_text)
        title_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; color: #00F0FF;")
        hdr_layout.addWidget(title_lbl)
        hdr_layout.addStretch()

        layout.addLayout(hdr_layout)

        # Grid of Thumbnails
        if not self.image_paths:
            empty_lbl = QLabel("В этом диалоге пока нет сгенерированных изображений.\nПопросите Ассистента создать арт или фото, и они появятся здесь!")
            empty_lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            empty_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 13px; margin: 40px;")
            layout.addWidget(empty_lbl, stretch=1)
        else:
            scroll = QScrollArea(self)
            scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
            scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

            grid_container = QWidget()
            grid_container.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
            grid_layout = QGridLayout(grid_container)
            grid_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)
            grid_layout.setSpacing(12)

            columns = 4
            for idx, img_p in enumerate(self.image_paths):
                row = idx // columns
                col = idx % columns
                btn = ThumbnailButton(img_p, grid_container)
                btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked, p=img_p: self._preview_image(p))
                grid_layout.addWidget(btn, row, col)

            scroll.setWidget(grid_container)
            layout.addWidget(scroll, stretch=1)

        # Bottom Action Bar
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()

        btn_open_folder = QPushButton("📂 Открыть папку в Проводнике")
        btn_open_folder.clicked.connect(self._open_folder)
        btn_layout.addWidget(btn_open_folder)

        btn_layout.addStretch()

        btn_close = QPushButton("Закрыть")
        btn_close.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        btn_layout.addWidget(btn_close)

        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _preview_image(self, image_path: Path):
        dialog = ImagePreviewDialog(image_path, self)
        dialog.exec()

    def _open_folder(self):
        target_dir = self.session_images_dir
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            if hasattr(os, "startfile"):
                os.startfile(str(target_dir))
            else:
                subprocess.Popen(["explorer", str(target_dir)])
        except Exception as e:
            pass

"""
Model Sampling Parameters Dialog for NeonRoute.
Modal dialog in Glassmorphism style for configuring LLM sampling parameters:
Temperature, Min-P, Repetition Penalty, Max Tokens, and DM Mode toggle.
Modernized with QFluentWidgets components under Agentrules.md.
"""

from typing import Dict, Any
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtGui import QColor, QMouseEvent
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QFrame,
    QDoubleSpinBox, QSpinBox
)
from qfluentwidgets import (
    Slider,
    DoubleSpinBox,
    SpinBox,
    CheckBox,
    PushButton,
    PrimaryPushButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
)

from services.session_manager import get_default_sampling_params


class SamplingSlider(Slider):
    """
    Кастомный слайдер для параметров сэмплинга:
    - Плавное и естественное перетаскивание бегунка зажатой ЛКМ (нативная логика Slider)
    - Включен трекинг реального времени self.setTracking(True)
    - Защита от смещения значения при простом движении мыши (hover) без нажатия
    - ClickFocus и отключение wheelEvent
    """
    def __init__(self, orientation=Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, parent=None):
        super().__init__(orientation, parent=parent)
        self.setTracking(True)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        self.handle.installEventFilter(self)

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):
        if watched == self.handle:
            if event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonPress:
                if event.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    return True
                self._pressedPos = self.handle.mapToParent(event.pos())
            elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseMove:
                if event.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    slider_pos = self.handle.mapToParent(event.pos())
                    self.setValue(self._posToValue(slider_pos))
                    self._pressedPos = slider_pos
                    self.sliderMoved.emit(self.value())
                    return True
                return True
            elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease:
                if event.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    return True
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        if e.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mousePressEvent(e)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        # Реагируем на перемещение СТРОГО при зажатой левой кнопке мыши
        if not (e.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton):
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mouseMoveEvent(e)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        if e.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(e)

    def wheelEvent(self, e):
        # Отключаем случайное изменение значений колесиком мыши
        e.ignore()


class SamplingDoubleSpinBox(DoubleSpinBox):
    """
    Поле числового ввода с плавающей точкой (Temperature, Min-P, Repetition Penalty):
    - Стрелки вверх/вниз гарантированно инкрементируют/декрементируют значение с точным шагом
    - Границы minimum / singleStep строго соблюдаются
    - Отключение wheelEvent во избежание случайного скролла значений
    - ClickFocus
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        try:
            self.downButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.downButton.clicked.connect(self.stepDown)
        try:
            self.upButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.upButton.clicked.connect(self.stepUp)

    def stepDown(self):
        new_val = max(self.minimum(), self.value() - self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(round(new_val, self.decimals()))

    def stepUp(self):
        new_val = min(self.maximum(), self.value() + self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(round(new_val, self.decimals()))

    def wheelEvent(self, e):
        e.ignore()


class SamplingSpinBox(SpinBox):
    """
    Поле целочисленного ввода (Max Tokens):
    - Стрелки вверх/вниз гарантированно инкрементируют/декрементируют значение с точным шагом (64)
    - Нижняя граница minimum (256) и верхняя maximum (4096) строго соблюдаются
    - Отключение wheelEvent
    - ClickFocus
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        try:
            self.downButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.downButton.clicked.connect(self.stepDown)
        try:
            self.upButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.upButton.clicked.connect(self.stepUp)

    def stepDown(self):
        new_val = max(self.minimum(), self.value() - self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(int(new_val))

    def stepUp(self):
        new_val = min(self.maximum(), self.value() + self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(int(new_val))

    def wheelEvent(self, e):
        e.ignore()

    def _on_user_input_changed(self):
        if not getattr(self, "_is_resetting", False):
            self.was_reset_to_defaults = False

    def _on_temp_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_temp.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_temp.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_temp.setValue(target)
            self.spin_temp.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_temp_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_temp.value() != target:
            self.slider_temp.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_temp.setValue(target)
            self.slider_temp.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_min_p_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_min_p.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_min_p.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_min_p.setValue(target)
            self.spin_min_p.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_min_p_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_min_p.value() != target:
            self.slider_min_p.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_min_p.setValue(target)
            self.slider_min_p.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_rep_pen_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_rep_pen.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_rep_pen.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_rep_pen.setValue(target)
            self.spin_rep_pen.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_rep_pen_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_rep_pen.value() != target:
            self.slider_rep_pen.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_rep_pen.setValue(target)
            self.slider_rep_pen.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_max_tokens_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        snapped = round(val / 64) * 64
        snapped = max(256, min(4096, snapped))
        if self.spin_max_tokens.value() != snapped:
            self.spin_max_tokens.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_max_tokens.setValue(snapped)
            self.spin_max_tokens.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_max_tokens_spin_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        if self.slider_max_tokens.value() != val:
            self.slider_max_tokens.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_max_tokens.setValue(val)
            self.slider_max_tokens.blockSignals(False)

    def _reset_defaults(self):
        self._is_resetting = True
        try:
            active_mode = "engineer" if self.is_engineer_mode else self.mode
            from services.session_manager import get_default_sampling_params
            defaults = get_default_sampling_params(active_mode)

            if self.is_engineer_mode:
                self.spin_temp.setValue(0.15)
                self.slider_temp.setValue(15)
            else:
                self.spin_temp.setValue(defaults["temperature"])
                self.slider_temp.setValue(int(round(defaults["temperature"] * 100)))
            self.spin_min_p.setValue(defaults["min_p"])
            self.slider_min_p.setValue(int(round(defaults["min_p"] * 100)))
            self.spin_rep_pen.setValue(defaults["repeat_penalty"])
            self.slider_rep_pen.setValue(int(round(defaults["repeat_penalty"] * 100)))
            self.spin_max_tokens.setValue(defaults["max_tokens"])
            self.slider_max_tokens.setValue(defaults["max_tokens"])

            if "top_p" in defaults:
                self.current_params["top_p"] = defaults["top_p"]

            if hasattr(self, "chk_dm_mode") and self.mode == "roleplay":
                self.chk_dm_mode.setChecked(bool(defaults.get("is_dm_mode", False)))
        finally:
            self._is_resetting = False
            self.was_reset_to_defaults = True

    def get_sampling_params(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        params = {
            "temperature": round(self.spin_temp.value(), 2),
            "min_p": round(self.spin_min_p.value(), 2),
            "repeat_penalty": round(self.spin_rep_pen.value(), 2),
            "max_tokens": int(self.spin_max_tokens.value())
        }
        if "top_p" in getattr(self, "current_params", {}):
            params["top_p"] = self.current_params["top_p"]
        if self.is_engineer_mode:
            params["temperature"] = 0.15
        if hasattr(self, "chk_dm_mode") and self.mode == "roleplay":
            params["is_dm_mode"] = self.chk_dm_mode.isChecked()
        return params

        sub_lbl.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True)
        card_layout.addWidget(sub_lbl)

        btn.clicked.connect(on_click)
        return btn

        self.selected_mode = mode
        self.accept()

    def _create_assistant_tab(self) -> QWidget:
        widget = QWidget()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(widget)
        layout.setContentsMargins(14, 14, 14, 14)

        top_row = QHBoxLayout()

        self.asst_bio_input.setPlaceholderText("Краткая выжимка о вас. Например:\nРазработчик. Предпочитаю лаконичные ответы.")
        layout.addWidget(self.asst_bio_input)

        layout.addWidget(QLabel("МОДЕЛЬ ДЛЯ ЭЛАРИИ (LM STUDIO):"))
        self.combo_asst_model = QComboBox(widget)
        layout.addWidget(self.combo_asst_model)

        layout.addWidget(QLabel("ГЕНЕРАЦИЯ ИЛЛЮСТРАЦИЙ ЭЛАРИЕЙ:"))
        self.bg_art_mode = QButtonGroup(widget)
        self.rb_art_manual = QRadioButton("Вручную (кнопка подтверждения под сообщением)", widget)
        self.rb_art_auto = QRadioButton("Автоматически (сразу запускать SD Forge)", widget)
        self.bg_art_mode.addButton(self.rb_art_manual, 0)
        self.bg_art_mode.addButton(self.rb_art_auto, 1)

    def _load_assistant_fields(self):
        asst = self.profiles.get("assistant_user", {})
        if not isinstance(asst, dict):
            asst = {}
        self.asst_name_input.setText(asst.get("name", "Пользователь"))
        self.asst_bio_input.setPlainText(asst.get("bio", ""))
        self._update_assistant_avatar_preview()

        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        auto_art = cfg.get("auto_generate_art", DEFAULT_AUTO_GENERATE_ART)
        if auto_art:
            self.rb_art_auto.setChecked(True)
        else:
            self.rb_art_manual.setChecked(True)

        self.combo_asst_model.blockSignals(True)
        self.combo_asst_model.clear()

        parent_window = self.parent()
        parent_combo = getattr(parent_window, "lm_combo", None) if parent_window else None
        active_model = cfg.get("active_model", "")

        if parent_combo and hasattr(parent_combo, "count") and parent_combo.count() > 0:
            for i in range(parent_combo.count()):
                m_text = parent_combo.itemText(i).strip()
                if m_text and self.combo_asst_model.findText(m_text) == -1:
                    self.combo_asst_model.addItem(m_text)
            curr_parent_model = parent_combo.currentText().strip()
            if curr_parent_model:
                active_model = curr_parent_model

        if active_model:
            idx = self.combo_asst_model.findText(active_model)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.combo_asst_model.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            else:
                self.combo_asst_model.addItem(active_model)
                self.combo_asst_model.setCurrentIndex(self.combo_asst_model.count() - 1)

        self.combo_asst_model.blockSignals(False)

    def _choose_assistant_avatar(self):
        f, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(self, "Выберите аватар для Ассистента", "", "Images (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp)")
        if f:

            shutil.copy2(f, dest)
            self.assistant_avatar_temp = str(dest)
            self._update_assistant_avatar_preview()

    def _update_assistant_avatar_preview(self):
        p = Path(self.assistant_avatar_temp) if self.assistant_avatar_temp and Path(self.assistant_avatar_temp).exists() else None

        pix = render_circular_avatar(p, name or "User", size=52, is_user=True)
        self.asst_avatar_lbl.setPixmap(pix)

    def _create_rp_tab(self) -> QWidget:
        widget = QWidget()

    def _get_personas_dict(self) -> dict:
        rp_settings = self.profiles.get("rp_settings")
        if not isinstance(rp_settings, dict):
            self.profiles["rp_settings"] = rp_settings = {}
        personas = rp_settings.get("personas")
        if not isinstance(personas, dict):
            rp_settings["personas"] = personas = {}
        return personas

    def _load_rp_personas_list(self):
        self._is_populating = True
        rp_settings = self.profiles.get("rp_settings")
        if not isinstance(rp_settings, dict):
            self.profiles["rp_settings"] = rp_settings = {}
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if not personas:
            personas["persona_default"] = {"name": "Игрок", "avatar_path": None, "bio": ""}
            rp_settings["active_persona_id"] = "persona_default"

        active_id = rp_settings.get("active_persona_id")
        if active_id not in personas:
            active_id = next(iter(personas.keys()))
            rp_settings["active_persona_id"] = active_id

        self.active_primary_persona_id = active_id
        self.active_persona_id = active_id

        self.list_personas.blockSignals(True)
        self.list_personas.clear()
        selected_row = 0
        for idx, (pid, pdata) in enumerate(personas.items()):
            p_name = pdata.get("name", "Персонаж")
            label = f"👤 {p_name} ★ [Основной]" if pid == self.active_primary_persona_id else f"👤 {p_name}"
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, pid)
            self.list_personas.addItem(item)
            if pid == active_id:
                selected_row = idx

        self.list_personas.setCurrentRow(selected_row)
        self.list_personas.blockSignals(False)

        self._populate_persona_fields(active_id)
        self._is_populating = False

    def _populate_persona_fields(self, pid: str):
        personas = (self.profiles.get("rp_settings") or {}).get("personas") or {}
        pdata = personas.get(pid, {}) if isinstance(personas, dict) else {}

        self.rp_name_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_name_input.setText(pdata.get("name", ""))
        self.rp_name_input.blockSignals(False)

        gender = str(pdata.get("gender", "male")).lower()
        self.combo_rp_gender.blockSignals(True)
        self.combo_rp_gender.setCurrentIndex(1 if gender == "female" else 0)
        self.combo_rp_gender.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_personality_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_personality_input.setPlainText(pdata.get("personality", ""))
        self.rp_personality_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_backstory_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_backstory_input.setPlainText(pdata.get("backstory", "") or pdata.get("bio", ""))
        self.rp_backstory_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_inventory_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_inventory_input.setText(pdata.get("inventory", ""))
        self.rp_inventory_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_visual_dna_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_visual_dna_input.setPlainText(pdata.get("visual_dna", ""))
        self.rp_visual_dna_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_outfit_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_outfit_input.setText(pdata.get("outfit", ""))
        self.rp_outfit_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_avatar_temp = pdata.get("avatar_path")
        self._update_rp_avatar_preview()

    def _on_persona_row_changed(self, row: int):
        if self._is_populating or row < 0 or row >= self.list_personas.count():
            return
        item = self.list_personas.item(row)
        if not item:
            return
        new_pid = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if not new_pid or new_pid == self.active_persona_id:
            return

        self._sync_current_persona_fields()
        self.active_persona_id = new_pid
        self._populate_persona_fields(new_pid)

    def _on_rp_name_changed(self, text: str):
        if self._is_populating or not self.active_persona_id:
            return
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if self.active_persona_id in personas:
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["name"] = text
            row = self.list_personas.currentRow()
            if row >= 0:
                item = self.list_personas.item(row)
                if item:
                    display = text.strip() or "Персонаж"
                    is_pri = (self.active_persona_id == getattr(self, "active_primary_persona_id", None))
                    item.setText(f"👤 {display} ★ [Основной]" if is_pri else f"👤 {display}")
            self._update_rp_avatar_preview()

    def _sync_current_persona_fields(self):
        if self._is_populating or not getattr(self, "active_persona_id", None):
            return
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if self.active_persona_id in personas:
            name = self.rp_name_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_name_input") else ""
            gender = "female" if (hasattr(self, "combo_rp_gender") and self.combo_rp_gender.currentIndex() == 1) else "male"
            pers = self.rp_personality_input.toPlainText().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_personality_input") else ""
            back = self.rp_backstory_input.toPlainText().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_backstory_input") else ""
            inv = self.rp_inventory_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_inventory_input") else ""
            dna = self.rp_visual_dna_input.toPlainText().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_visual_dna_input") else ""
            outfit = self.rp_outfit_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_outfit_input") else ""

            bio = f"{pers}\n{back}".strip() if (pers or back) else ""

            personas[self.active_persona_id]["name"] = name or "Персонаж"
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["gender"] = gender
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["personality"] = pers
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["backstory"] = back
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["bio"] = bio
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["inventory"] = inv
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["visual_dna"] = dna
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["outfit"] = outfit
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["avatar_path"] = self.rp_avatar_temp

    def _set_current_as_primary(self):
        if not getattr(self, "active_persona_id", None):
            return
        self.active_primary_persona_id = self.active_persona_id
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        rp_settings = self.profiles.get("rp_settings")
        if isinstance(rp_settings, dict):
            rp_settings["active_persona_id"] = self.active_primary_persona_id

        for i in range(self.list_personas.count()):
            it = self.list_personas.item(i)
            if it:
                pid = it.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                name = (personas.get(pid) or {}).get("name", "Персонаж")
                is_pri = (pid == self.active_primary_persona_id)
                it.setText(f"👤 {name} ★ [Основной]" if is_pri else f"👤 {name}")

    def _create_new_persona(self):
        self._sync_current_persona_fields()
        new_id = f"persona_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        personas[new_id] = {
            "name": f"Персонаж {len(personas) + 1}",
            "gender": "male",
            "avatar_path": None,
            "bio": "",
            "personality": "",
            "backstory": "",
            "inventory": "",
            "visual_dna": "",
            "outfit": ""
        }
        self.active_persona_id = new_id
        self._load_rp_personas_list()

    def _delete_current_persona(self):
        if not getattr(self, "active_persona_id", None):
            return
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if len(personas) <= 1:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Внимание", "Нельзя удалить единственного персонажа.")
            return

        del_id = self.active_persona_id
        self._is_populating = True

        if del_id in personas:
            del personas[del_id]

        if self.active_primary_persona_id == del_id:
            self.active_primary_persona_id = next(iter(personas.keys()))
            rp_settings = self.profiles.get("rp_settings")
            if isinstance(rp_settings, dict):
                rp_settings["active_persona_id"] = self.active_primary_persona_id

        next_pid = self.active_primary_persona_id
        if next_pid not in personas:
            next_pid = next(iter(personas.keys()))
        self.active_persona_id = next_pid

        for widget in (self.rp_name_input, self.rp_personality_input, self.rp_backstory_input, self.rp_inventory_input, self.rp_visual_dna_input, self.rp_outfit_input):
            widget.blockSignals(True)
            widget.clear()
            widget.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_avatar_temp = None
        self._load_rp_personas_list()

    def _choose_rp_avatar(self):
        f, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(self, "Выберите аватар для RP персонажа", "", "Images (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp)")
        if f:
            dest = CHARACTERS_DIR / f"user_rp_{Path(f).name}"
            shutil.copy2(f, dest)
            self.rp_avatar_temp = str(dest)
            self._update_rp_avatar_preview()

    def _update_rp_avatar_preview(self):
        p = Path(self.rp_avatar_temp) if self.rp_avatar_temp and Path(self.rp_avatar_temp).exists() else None
        name = self.rp_name_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_name_input") else "Hero"
        pix = render_circular_avatar(p, name or "Hero", size=52, is_user=True)
        self.rp_avatar_lbl.setPixmap(pix)

    def _save_all_profiles(self):
        self.profiles["assistant_user"] = {
            "name": self.asst_name_input.text().strip() or "Пользователь",
            "avatar_path": self.assistant_avatar_temp,
            "bio": self.asst_bio_input.toPlainText().strip()
        }

        self._sync_current_persona_fields()

        rp_s = self.profiles.setdefault("rp_settings", {})
        rp_s["active_persona_id"] = getattr(self, "active_primary_persona_id", None) or self.active_persona_id

        SessionManager.save_user_profiles(self.profiles)

        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        cfg["user_name"] = self.asst_name_input.text().strip() or "Пользователь"
        cfg["auto_generate_art"] = self.rb_art_auto.isChecked()
        selected_model = self.combo_asst_model.currentText().strip()
        if selected_model:
            cfg["active_model"] = selected_model
        ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)

        new_config = ConfigManager.load_config()
        self.settings_applied.emit(new_config)
        self.profiles_updated.emit()

    def _save_all_and_close(self):
        self._save_all_profiles()
        self.accept()
